# MiniDev UI

> 557 free, MIT-licensed React + Tailwind CSS v4 components (406 components, 43 blocks, 108 motion pieces) for product UI: forms, data tables, charts, billing, auth, settings, overlays, and AI surfaces (chat, reasoning, tool calls). Built on Base UI. Every component is one TypeScript file you own, installed with the shadcn CLI or imported from npm. Semantic OKLCH tokens, light + dark from one token set.

## Quick start (follow exactly)

1. A React project with Tailwind CSS v4 and the `@/*` import alias. Run `npx shadcn@latest init` once.
2. Tokens: `curl -o app/minidev.css https://ui.minidev.pro/r/styles.css`, then make `app/globals.css` start with `@import "tailwindcss";` followed by `@import "./minidev.css";`. Delete the `:root`, `.dark` and `@theme inline` blocks that shadcn init generated: they override MiniDev's tokens.
3. Add components: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/button @minidev/dialog` (long form: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/<name>.json`). Files land in `components/ui/<name>.tsx`; import from `@/components/ui/<name>`. Registry dependencies install automatically.
4. Or npm: `npm i minidev-ui-kit @base-ui/react class-variance-authority clsx tailwind-merge lucide-react motion`; CSS `@import "minidev-ui-kit/styles.css";` and `@source "../node_modules/minidev-ui-kit";`; import `minidev-ui-kit/ui/<name>`, `minidev-ui-kit/blocks/<name>` or `minidev-ui-kit/premium/<name>`. Next.js also needs `transpilePackages: ["minidev-ui-kit"]`.
5. Dark mode: the `dark` class on `<html>`. Components never branch on theme.

## Machine-readable

- Per-component Markdown (purpose, when to use, install, props, examples): `https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/<name>.md`
- Catalog JSON, every component with category, install, imports, props, deps and related: https://ui.minidev.pro/components.json
- shadcn registry index: https://ui.minidev.pro/r/registry.json; one item per component at `https://ui.minidev.pro/r/<name>.json` (source inlined)
- Everything in one file: https://ui.minidev.pro/llms-full.txt
- Agent setup (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot): https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/ai; rules files https://ui.minidev.pro/AGENTS.md, https://ui.minidev.pro/rules/minidev-ui.mdc, https://ui.minidev.pro/skill/minidev-ui/SKILL.md

## Rules for generating code with MiniDev UI

- Built on Base UI, not Radix: to render a component as another element pass `render={<a href="/pricing" />}` (or a Next.js `<Link />`). There is no `asChild`.
- Use semantic tokens only: bg, surface, raised, sunken, border, border-strong, fg, fg-muted, fg-subtle, ink, on-ink, accent, accent-soft, accent-fg, success, warning, danger, info. Never raw hex, palette steps like blue-500, bg-white or bg-black.
- Primary actions use <Button> (ink). Brand-coloured actions use <Button variant="accent">, at most once per screen. Secondary: variant="outline". Quiet: variant="ghost". Icon-only buttons need aria-label.
- Depth: shadow-xs, shadow-sm, shadow-raised (cards), shadow-key, shadow-ink, shadow-md, shadow-lg, shadow-overlay (menus, dialogs). No other shadows, and no backdrop-blur on surfaces.
- Radius: controls rounded-lg (8px), cards rounded-xl (12px), overlays rounded-2xl. Nested radius = outer minus padding. Sizes and gaps are even numbers (2px grid).
- Numbers are tabular (tabular-nums). Headings use negative tracking; body text does not.
- Motion: springs from the presets only. snappy `{ type: "spring", bounce: 0.18, duration: 0.42 }` (toggles, tabs), morph `{ type: "spring", bounce: 0.16, duration: 0.5 }` (panels, size changes), roll `{ type: "spring", stiffness: 260, damping: 28, mass: 0.9 }` (numbers), release `{ type: "spring", stiffness: 400, damping: 40 }` (after drag), data `{ type: "spring", bounce: 0.12, duration: 0.7 }` (charts). Always `transition={useReducedMotion() ? { duration: 0 } : PRESET}`. Nothing animates on page load in product UI.
- Overlays (Dialog, Sheet, Drawer) always get a title for their accessible name. Form fields get a visible label.

## Components (406)

### Accordion

Stacked disclosure sections: each item has a header button that shows or hides its panel.

Use for FAQs, settings groups and long detail pages where readers scan headings first. Prefer `Tabs` when exactly one view is shown at a time and all are peers, and `Collapsible` for a single show/hide region. Built on Base UI: full keyboard support (Enter/Space toggle, focus moves with Tab), `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` wired for you.

Key props (on `Accordion`): `value` / `defaultValue` (array of open item values), `onValueChange`, `multiple` (allow several open at once), `disabled`.

- Name: `accordion` (component, Layout)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/accordion` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionPanel } from "@/components/ui/accordion"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/accordion"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react, lucide-react
- Related: tabs, collapsible, expandable-row, faq-list, faq-section, faq-accordion-motion
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/accordion (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/accordion.md)

Props: AccordionPrimitive.Root props.

```tsx
<Accordion defaultValue={["billing"]}>
  <AccordionItem value="billing">
    <AccordionTrigger>How does billing work?</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionPanel>Invoices go out on the 1st of each month.</AccordionPanel>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

### AccountSetupProgress

An onboarding checklist summary: a labelled progress bar with "2/4" steps and the next step.

Use at the top of a dashboard or settings page while setup is incomplete. Prefer `Stepper` when the user moves through the steps in place, and `Progress` alone for non-setup progress.

- Name: `account-setup-progress` (component, Dashboard)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/account-setup-progress` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { AccountSetupProgress } from "@/components/ui/account-setup-progress"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/account-setup-progress"`)
- Uses: progress
- Related: stepper, progress
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/account-setup-progress (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/account-setup-progress.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| stepsDone? | `number` | `2` | Steps finished. Clamped to 0…stepsTotal. |
| stepsTotal? | `number` | `4` | Total steps in the setup. |
| title? | `React.ReactNode` | `"Account setup"` | Heading above the bar. |
| next? | `React.ReactNode` | `"Next: connect billing · then invite ...` | What to do next, shown under the bar. Pass `null` to hide. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<AccountSetupProgress stepsDone={3} stepsTotal={5} next="Invite your team" />
```

### ActivityFeed

A compact feed of who did what, with avatars and timestamps, for dashboards and detail panes.

Use for a short "recent activity" card. Prefer `AuditTrail` for compliance logs with exact timestamps, and `Timeline` for a dated sequence of milestones. Renders as a list for screen readers.

- Name: `activity-feed` (component, Dashboard)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/activity-feed` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ActivityFeed } from "@/components/ui/activity-feed"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/activity-feed"`)
- Uses: avatar, list-item
- Related: audit-trail, timeline, audit-log-entry, comment-thread, admin-overview, dashboard-home, notification-center, project-detail
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/activity-feed (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/activity-feed.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| items? | `ActivityItem[]` | `SAMPLE_ITEMS` | Rows, newest first. Omit for sample data. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<ActivityFeed items={[{ id: "1", user: "Maya Chen", action: "paid invoice INV-2041", time: "2m ago" }]} />
```

### AddCardForm

A payment card form: card number, expiry and CVC with the right autofill hints, and a save button.

Use in billing settings or checkout when you collect card details yourself. If you use a hosted payment element (Stripe Elements and similar), render that instead and keep only the layout. Field ids are generated, so several forms can share a page.

Fields are submitted as `cc-number`, `cc-exp` and `cc-csc` in the FormData.

- Name: `add-card-form` (component, Billing)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/add-card-form` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { AddCardForm } from "@/components/ui/add-card-form"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/add-card-form"`)
- Uses: button, form-field, input
- Related: credit-card-input
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/add-card-form (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/add-card-form.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onSubmit? | `(data: FormData) => void` |  | Called on submit with the form's FormData. The page does not reload. |
| submitLabel? | `React.ReactNode` | `"Save card"` | Text on the submit button. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<AddCardForm onSubmit={(data) => saveCard(Object.fromEntries(data))} />
```

### AdminStatStrip

A row of admin KPIs with label, value and a percentage delta, four up on desktop.

Use at the top of an admin or analytics page. Set `invert` on a stat that is better going down (churn, failed sign-ins), so a fall shows green. Use `StatCard` for a single larger KPI and `StatSparkline` for one with a trend. Marked up as a description list (label → value) so screen readers pair them.

- Name: `admin-stat-strip` (component, Dashboard)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/admin-stat-strip` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { AdminStatStrip } from "@/components/ui/admin-stat-strip"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/admin-stat-strip"`)
- Uses: metric-delta
- Related: stat-card, stat-sparkline, admin-overview
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/admin-stat-strip (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/admin-stat-strip.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| stats? | `Stat[]` | `SAMPLE_STATS` | KPIs to show, in order. Omit for sample data. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<AdminStatStrip stats={[{ label: "MRR", value: "$48,200", delta: 8 }, { label: "Churn", value: "2.1%", delta: -3 }]} />
```

### AdminUserRow

One member row for an admin user list: avatar with presence, name, email, permission level and an actions menu.

Stack rows inside a bordered container for a members table. Prefer `DataTable` when you need sorting, selection or many columns. Put a `DropdownMenu` in `actions` for real row actions.

- Name: `admin-user-row` (component, Settings)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/admin-user-row` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { AdminUserRow } from "@/components/ui/admin-user-row"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/admin-user-row"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: avatar, icon-button, permission-chip, status-dot
- Related: stack, data-table, dropdown-menu, team-member-row, admin-console
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/admin-user-row (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/admin-user-row.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name? | `string` | `"Maya Chen"` | Full name; initials are derived for the avatar. |
| email? | `string` | `"maya.chen@northwind.com"` |  |
| role? | `"admin" \| "write" \| "read"` | `"read"` | Permission level shown as a chip. |
| online? | `boolean` |  | Presence dot: true for online, false for offline, omit to hide. |
| actions? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Replaces the default "more" button, e.g. with a `DropdownMenu`. |
| onActionsClick? | `() => void` |  | Called when the default "more" button is pressed. Ignored when `actions` is set. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<AdminUserRow name="Theo Okafor" email="theo@northwind.com" role="write" online
  actions={<DropdownMenu>…</DropdownMenu>} />
```

### AgentPlan

An AI agent's live to-do list: tasks with statuses, subtasks, tools and a progress bar.

Use it while an agent works through a plan, fed from a todo or plan tool call (Claude Code's `TodoWrite`, Codex's `update_plan`, or your own AI SDK tool). Statuses are `pending`, `in_progress`, `completed`, `failed` and `skipped`. The active row is highlighted and announced; when the agent moves on, the highlight glides to the next row and the check pops in. For a log of tool calls that already ran use AgentTrace; for a checklist the user ticks use OnboardingChecklist.

- Name: `agent-plan` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/agent-plan` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { AgentPlan } from "@/components/ui/agent-plan"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/agent-plan"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react, lucide-react, motion
- Related: agent-trace, onboarding-checklist
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/agent-plan (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/agent-plan.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title? | `string` | `"Plan"` | Header label. |
| tasks? | `AgentPlanTask[]` | `SAMPLE_TASKS` | Tasks in plan order. |
| defaultOpen? | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the task list starts expanded. |
| onTaskClick? | `(task: AgentPlanTask) => void` |  | Makes each task title a button. Fires with the clicked task, e.g. to scroll to its output. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<AgentPlan
  title="Migrate billing to Stripe"
  tasks={[
    { id: "1", title: "Read the current billing module", status: "completed" },
    { id: "2", title: "Write the webhook handler", status: "in_progress", tools: ["edit_file"] },
    { id: "3", title: "Run the test suite", status: "pending" },
  ]}
/>
```

### AgentTrace

An AI agent run as a timeline of tool calls and steps.

A hairline rail connects the steps; the running step spins, finished steps report their time, and steps with `detail` fold out (arguments, output, errors). Use it to show what an agent did. Prefer `ToolCallCard` for a single call, and `BuildPipeline` for CI stages in a row. Each step announces its status to screen readers; details are disclosure buttons.

- Name: `agent-trace` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/agent-trace` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { AgentTrace } from "@/components/ui/agent-trace"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/agent-trace"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Related: tool-call-card, build-pipeline, agent-plan, trace-waterfall
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/agent-trace (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/agent-trace.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| steps | `Step[]` |  | Steps in run order. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| title? | `string` | `"Agent run"` | Header label. |
| meta? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Right-aligned summary, e.g. "4 tools · 3.1s · $0.012". Defaults to "done/total steps". |

```tsx
<AgentTrace
  meta="3 tools · 2.4s"
  steps={[
    { id: "1", name: "search_invoices", status: "done", duration: "0.8s", detail: '{ "customer": "Northwind" }' },
    { id: "2", name: "draft_email", status: "running" },
    { id: "3", name: "send_email", status: "pending" },
  ]}
/>
```

### AiComposer

A chat input for AI apps: multiline prompt, suggestion chips, model picker, attach, and a send button that becomes stop while streaming.

Use as the input of a chat or assistant panel. Prefer `PromptInput` for a composer that grows with its text and takes your own `toolbar`, and `Textarea` for plain forms. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, and Enter during IME composition is left alone. Works controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled (`defaultValue`; it clears itself after `onSubmit`).

- Name: `ai-composer` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/ai-composer` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { AiComposer } from "@/components/ui/ai-composer"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/ai-composer"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: icon-button, model-picker, suggestion-chips
- Related: prompt-input, textarea, chat-thread, comment-composer, speech-input, stop-generating, chat-page
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/ai-composer (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/ai-composer.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled prompt text. |
| defaultValue? | `string` | `""` | Initial text when uncontrolled. |
| onChange? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called on every edit and when a suggestion chip is picked. |
| onSubmit? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called on Enter or the send button with the trimmed prompt. Not called when empty or streaming. |
| onStop? | `() => void` |  | Called by the stop button while `streaming`. |
| streaming? | `boolean` |  | While true the send button becomes a stop button. |
| suggestions? | `string[]` |  | Prompt starters shown above the input; picking one fills the input. |
| models? | `AiComposerModel[]` | `DEFAULT_MODELS` | Models offered in the picker. |
| model? | `string` |  | Controlled model id. |
| onModelChange? | `(id: string) => void` |  |  |
| onAttach? | `() => void` |  | Called by the paperclip button, which only renders when this is set. Wire it to a file input or picker. |
| placeholder? | `string` | `"Ask anything…"` |  |
| label? | `string` | `"Message"` | Accessible name for the text area. |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
const [msg, setMsg] = React.useState("")
<AiComposer value={msg} onChange={setMsg} onSubmit={(text) => { send(text); setMsg("") }}
  streaming={isStreaming} onStop={stop} suggestions={["Summarize INV-2041"]} />
```

### AlertDialog

A modal confirmation for destructive or irreversible actions; renders a demo trigger and content when given no children.

Use when the user must confirm before something cannot be undone (delete, revoke, cancel plan). Unlike `Dialog`, it cannot be dismissed by clicking outside, and screen readers announce it as an alert dialog. Focus is trapped inside and returns to the trigger on close; Escape cancels. Always give it an `AlertDialogTitle` and `AlertDialogDescription`.

Key props (on `AlertDialog`): `open` / `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange(open)`.

- Name: `alert-dialog` (component, Overlays)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/alert-dialog` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogTrigger, AlertDialogClose, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogActions } from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/alert-dialog"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react
- Uses: button
- Related: dialog, approval-card, cancel-flow, confirm-destructive, cookie-banner, delete-account-confirm, downgrade-warning, workflow-board
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/alert-dialog (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/alert-dialog.md)

Props: AD.Root props.

```tsx
<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" />}>Delete invoice</AlertDialogTrigger>
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <AlertDialogTitle>Delete invoice INV-2041?</AlertDialogTitle>
    <AlertDialogDescription>This cannot be undone.</AlertDialogDescription>
    <AlertDialogActions>
      <AlertDialogClose render={<Button variant="outline" />}>Cancel</AlertDialogClose>
      <AlertDialogClose render={<Button variant="destructive" />} onClick={remove}>Delete</AlertDialogClose>
    </AlertDialogActions>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>
```

### AnnouncementBar

A full-width strip above the site header for one short announcement (launch, sale, maintenance).

Use for site-wide news on marketing pages. Prefer `Banner` for in-app notices with tones and an action, and `Callout` for notes inside content. Exposed as a labelled region; the dismiss button only renders when `onDismiss` is given (persist the dismissal yourself).

- Name: `announcement-bar` (component, Landing pages)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/announcement-bar` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { AnnouncementBar } from "@/components/ui/announcement-bar"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/announcement-bar"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: icon-button
- Related: banner, callout, cookie-banner, cta-banner, impersonation-banner, incident-banner, inline-alert, trial-banner
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/announcement-bar (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/announcement-bar.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `React.ReactNode` |  | The message; may include a link. Keep it to one line. |
| onDismiss? | `() => void` |  | Shows a dismiss button and is called when it is pressed. |
| label? | `string` | `"Announcement"` | Accessible name of the region. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<AnnouncementBar onDismiss={() => setHidden(true)}>
  Lumen 2.4 is out. <a href="/changelog">See what's new</a>
</AnnouncementBar>
```

### ApiKeyList

A card listing API keys by name with a masked preview, creation date, and create and rotate actions.

Use on a developer settings page. Never pass full secrets: show a masked `preview` and reveal a new key once, in a dialog, after `onCreate`. Prefer `CreateApiKey` or `SecretReveal` for the one-time reveal and `DataTable` for large key inventories with scopes and last-used columns.

- Name: `api-key-list` (component, Dev tools)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/api-key-list` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ApiKeyList } from "@/components/ui/api-key-list"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/api-key-list"`)
- Uses: badge, button
- Related: create-api-key, secret-reveal, data-table, ip-allowlist, session-list, webhook-list, api-docs-page
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/api-key-list (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/api-key-list.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| keys? | `Key[]` |  | Keys to list. Omit for sample data. |
| title? | `React.ReactNode` | `"API keys"` | Heading of the card. |
| onCreate? | `() => void` |  | Called by "Create key". |
| onRotate? | `(key: Key) => void` |  | Called by a row's "Rotate" button with that key. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<ApiKeyList
  keys={[{ id: "k1", name: "Production", preview: "md_live_••••8f2a", created: "Aug 12" }]}
  onCreate={openCreateDialog}
  onRotate={(key) => rotate(key.id)}
/>
```

### AppShell

A product layout frame: optional sidebar on the left (from md up), optional top bar, and a scrolling `<main>` content area.

Use as the outer frame of an app page or an app preview. Prefer `Sidebar` for the navigation itself (pass it as `sidebar`) and `Topbar` for the header. Below md the sidebar is hidden, so also render a mobile menu (for example a `Sheet`) inside `topbar`.

- Name: `app-shell` (component, Layout)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/app-shell` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { AppShell } from "@/components/ui/app-shell"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/app-shell"`)
- Related: sidebar, topbar, sheet, collapsible-sidebar
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/app-shell (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/app-shell.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| sidebar? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Left column content, usually navigation. Hidden below the md breakpoint. |
| sidebarLabel? | `string` | `"Sidebar"` | Accessible name of the sidebar landmark. |
| topbar? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Rendered above the content, full width of the main column. |
| children? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Page content, rendered inside the `<main>` landmark; this area scrolls. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<AppShell sidebar={<Sidebar />} topbar={<Topbar />} sidebarLabel="Workspace">
  <PageHeader title="Invoices" />
</AppShell>
```

### ApprovalCard

A request card with the requester, a summary and approve or reject actions.

Use for human-in-the-loop steps: refunds, access requests, an agent asking permission before a tool call. Prefer `AlertDialog` when the decision must block the page. The card is an `article` named by its title, so a stack of requests reads as separate items.

- Name: `approval-card` (component, Workflow)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/approval-card` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ApprovalCard } from "@/components/ui/approval-card"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/approval-card"`)
- Uses: avatar, button
- Related: alert-dialog, workflow-board
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/approval-card (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/approval-card.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title? | `string` | `"Refund $1,240 on INV-2041"` | What is being requested. Also the card's accessible name. |
| requester? | `string` | `"Theo Okafor"` | Who asked; initials are derived for the avatar. |
| summary? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional context under the requester line. |
| onApprove? | `() => void` |  |  |
| onReject? | `() => void` |  |  |
| approveLabel? | `string` | `"Approve"` | Text on the approve button. |
| rejectLabel? | `string` | `"Reject"` | Text on the reject button. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<ApprovalCard title="Refund $1,240 on INV-2041" requester="Theo Okafor"
  summary="Customer was double charged in October." onApprove={approve} onReject={reject} />
```

### AreaChart

A smooth area chart with a hairline grid and gradient wash; strokes stay 1.5px at any size and a highlight can pin one value.

Use for a single trend over time in a card or KPI tile (no axes, no tooltip). Prefer `InteractiveAreaChart` for hover tooltips and axes, `LineChart` for several series, and `BarChart` for discrete periods. Screen readers get `label` plus a summary (count, first, last, peak). It fills its container: size it with `className` (default `h-32 w-full`).

- Name: `area-chart` (component, Charts)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/area-chart` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { AreaChart } from "@/components/ui/area-chart"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/area-chart"`)
- Related: interactive-area-chart, line-chart, bar-chart, chart-card, horizontal-bar-chart, stacked-bar-chart
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/area-chart (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/area-chart.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data? | `number[]` | `SAMPLE_DATA` | Series values, left to right. Omit for sample data. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| label? | `string` | `"Area chart"` | Accessible name; a short data summary is appended for screen readers. |
| grid? | `boolean` | `true` | Three dashed hairlines at 25/50/75%. |
| smooth? | `boolean` | `true` | Monotone curve (never overshoots the data) instead of straight segments. |
| highlight? | `number` |  | Index of a point to mark with a dot and a hairline crosshair. |
| tone? | `AreaChartTone` | `"accent"` | Stroke and wash colour, from the status tokens. |

```tsx
<AreaChart data={[18, 22, 27, 31, 36, 45, 52]} label="Weekly revenue, $k" tone="success" highlight={6} />
```

### ArtifactPreview

A framed preview of something an AI produced (a snippet, a chart, a draft) with a title bar, copy and expand actions.

Use inside a chat thread to show a generated artifact inline. Prefer `CodeBlock` for code that needs syntax highlighting and line numbers, and `ToolResultPanel` for raw tool output. The copy button only appears with `copyValue`, the expand button only with `onExpand`.

- Name: `artifact-preview` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/artifact-preview` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ArtifactPreview } from "@/components/ui/artifact-preview"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/artifact-preview"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: copy-button, icon-button
- Related: code-block, tool-result-panel
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/artifact-preview (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/artifact-preview.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `string` |  | File or artifact name in the title bar; also names the region. |
| children | `React.ReactNode` |  | The rendered preview. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| copyValue? | `string` |  | Text copied by the copy button (usually the source). Omit to hide the button. |
| onExpand? | `() => void` |  | Called by the expand button, e.g. to open a full-screen dialog. Omit to hide the button. |

```tsx
<ArtifactPreview title="pricing-table.tsx" copyValue={source} onExpand={() => setOpen(true)}>
  <PricingTable />
</ArtifactPreview>
```

### AspectRatio

A box that keeps a fixed width-to-height ratio, for images, video and embeds.

Use it for cover images, video and map embeds and card thumbnails, so the space is reserved before the media loads and nothing below it jumps. Children should fill it absolutely (`absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover`); content taller than the ratio is clipped. Uses the native CSS `aspect-ratio`, so it works in server components and needs no JavaScript. For a screenshot in a window frame use BrowserMockup or WindowChrome.

- Name: `aspect-ratio` (component, Layout)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/aspect-ratio` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { AspectRatio } from "@/components/ui/aspect-ratio"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/aspect-ratio"`)
- Related: browser-mockup, window-chrome
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/aspect-ratio (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/aspect-ratio.md)

Props (also accepts <div>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ratio? | `number` | `16 / 9` | Width divided by height: 16 / 9, 4 / 3, 1 for a square. |

```tsx
<AspectRatio ratio={16 / 9} className="rounded-xl bg-sunken">
  <img src="/cover.jpg" alt="" className="absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover" />
</AspectRatio>
```

### AssignPicker

A list of teammates to assign something to, with the current assignee highlighted.

Use inline in a popover or side panel to pick one owner for a task, ticket or invoice. Prefer `Combobox` when the team is long enough to need search. Follows the WAI-ARIA listbox pattern: one Tab stop, Arrow Up/Down and Home/End move, Enter or Space (or click) selects.

- Name: `assign-picker` (component, Workflow)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/assign-picker` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| people? | `Person[]` | `SAMPLE_PEOPLE` | People to choose from. Omit for sample data. |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled selection. Leave undefined for an uncontrolled picker. |
| defaultValue? | `string` | `"theo"` | Initial selection for the uncontrolled picker. |
| onChange? | `(id: string) => void` |  | Called with the chosen person's id. |
| label? | `string` | `"Assignee"` | Accessible name of the list. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
const [assignee, setAssignee] = React.useState("theo")
<AssignPicker value={assignee} onChange={setAssignee}
  people={[{ id: "maya", name: "Maya Chen" }, { id: "theo", name: "Theo Okafor" }]} />
```

### AttachmentChip

A small chip for one attached file, with an optional remove button.

Use in a composer or form to list files the user has attached. Prefer `FileDropzone` for picking and uploading files, and `PromptInputAttachments` for the AI prompt input. The remove button only renders with `onRemove` and its name is "Remove" followed by the file name.

- Name: `attachment-chip` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/attachment-chip` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name | `string` |  | File name; truncated to fit. |
| meta? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional detail after the name, e.g. the file size. |
| onRemove? | `() => void` |  | Shows a remove button and is called when it is pressed. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<AttachmentChip name="INV-2041.pdf" meta="240 KB" onRemove={() => remove(file)} />
```

### AudioPlayer

A compact, controlled audio row: play/pause button, title, subtitle and a progress bar.

It renders no `<audio>` element: you own playback and pass `playing` and `progress`. Use it for podcast lists, voice notes and call recordings. Prefer `AudioRecorder` to capture audio, and `VideoPlayerChrome` for video.

- Name: `audio-player` (component, Media)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/audio-player` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { AudioPlayer } from "@/components/ui/audio-player"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/audio-player"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: icon-button
- Related: audio-recorder, video-player-chrome, waveform-hero
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/audio-player (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/audio-player.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `string` |  | Track name. Also used in the button's label ("Play Northwind kickoff"). |
| subtitle? | `string` |  |  |
| playing? | `boolean` |  | Whether audio is playing; switches the icon and label. |
| onToggle? | `() => void` |  | Called by the play/pause button. |
| progress? | `number` | `0` | Playback position in percent, 0 to 100. Clamped. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
const ref = React.useRef<HTMLAudioElement>(null)
<audio ref={ref} src={url} onTimeUpdate={(e) => setPct((e.currentTarget.currentTime / e.currentTarget.duration) * 100)} />
<AudioPlayer title="Northwind kickoff" subtitle="12 min" playing={playing}
  progress={pct} onToggle={() => (playing ? ref.current?.pause() : ref.current?.play())} />
```

### AudioRecorder

A microphone recorder with start, pause and stop, an elapsed timer, live waveform bars, playback with a progress bar and a download button.

Use to capture a voice note or memo in the browser (MediaRecorder + Web Audio, no dependencies). Prefer `AudioPlayer` to play existing audio. The finished waveform is a keyboard slider (Arrow keys seek 1s, Shift 5s, Space plays). Without a microphone or permission it stays idle with a plain-language hint. You own upload: take the Blob from `onRecorded`.

- Name: `audio-recorder` (component, Media)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/audio-recorder` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { AudioRecorder } from "@/components/ui/audio-recorder"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/audio-recorder"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react, motion
- Related: audio-player, speech-input
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/audio-recorder (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/audio-recorder.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| maxDuration? | `number` | `120` | Longest recording in seconds. Recording stops by itself when it is reached. |
| onRecorded? | `(blob: Blob, meta: { duration: number; url: string; mimeType: string }) => void` |  | Called with the finished recording and its object URL. |
| title? | `string` | `"Voice note"` | Heading of the card. |
| description? | `string` | `"Attach to invoice INV-2041 for North...` | Shown under the title. |
| fileName? | `string` | `"voice-note"` | Base name of the downloaded file. The extension follows the recording format. |
| bars? | `number` | `48` | Number of waveform bars. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<AudioRecorder maxDuration={60} title="Voice note" description="Attach to INV-2041"
  onRecorded={(blob, { duration }) => upload(blob, duration)} />
```

### AuditFilterBar

A filter toolbar for an audit log: free-text search, an actor chip filter and a date range.

Put it above `AuditTrail` or an audit `DataTable`. Prefer `TableToolbar` for generic tables and `FacetFilter` when several filters can be on at once. Every control works uncontrolled; read the values through the `on*Change` callbacks, or control the actor with `actor` + `onActorChange`.

- Name: `audit-filter-bar` (component, Tables)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/audit-filter-bar` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { AuditFilterBar } from "@/components/ui/audit-filter-bar"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/audit-filter-bar"`)
- Uses: chip-filter, date-range-picker, search-input
- Related: audit-trail, data-table, table-toolbar, facet-filter, filter-bar, admin-console
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/audit-filter-bar (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/audit-filter-bar.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onSearchChange? | `(query: string) => void` |  | Called with the search text on every keystroke. |
| actorOptions? | `ChipOption[]` | `ACTOR_OPTIONS` | Actor chips. The first is the "everyone" option by convention. |
| actor? | `string` |  | Controlled actor value. |
| defaultActor? | `string` |  | Initial actor when uncontrolled. |
| onActorChange? | `(actor: string) => void` |  | Called with the chosen actor's value. |
| onRangeChange? | `(range: { from?: string; to?: string }) => void` |  | Called with ISO day strings when either end of the range changes. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<AuditFilterBar
  onSearchChange={setQuery}
  onActorChange={setActor}
  onRangeChange={(r) => setRange(r)}
/>
```

### AuthCard

A centred card frame for sign in, sign up and password reset forms: title, description, body and footer.

It is layout only; put your `FormField`s and `Button`s inside. Use `footer` for the switch link ("No account? Sign up"). Prefer `Card` for anything that is not an auth screen. The card is a section named by its title.

### Autocomplete

A text field that suggests matching options as you type, with the first eight matches in a listbox.

Free text is allowed: the value is whatever is typed, and picking a suggestion fills it in. Use for "type or pick" fields (customer, city, tag). Prefer `Combobox` when the value must be one of the options, and `Select` for a short fixed list. Follows the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern: Arrow Down/Up move through suggestions, Enter picks, Escape closes, focus stays in the input.

- Name: `autocomplete` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/autocomplete` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Autocomplete } from "@/components/ui/autocomplete"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/autocomplete"`)
- Uses: input
- Related: combobox, select
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/autocomplete (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/autocomplete.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| options? | `string[]` | `SAMPLE_OPTIONS` | Suggestions, matched case-insensitively anywhere in the string. Omit for sample data. |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled text. |
| defaultValue? | `string` | `""` | Initial text when uncontrolled. |
| onChange? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called with the text on every keystroke and when a suggestion is picked. |
| placeholder? | `string` | `"Search…"` |  |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |
| className? | `string` |  | Classes for the wrapper (sets the width; default `w-64`). |
| id? | `string` |  | Input id, for an external `<label htmlFor>`. |
| name? | `string` |  | Form field name. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name when there is no visible label. Falls back to the placeholder. |

```tsx
const [customer, setCustomer] = React.useState("")
<Autocomplete options={["Northwind Traders", "Acme Industries"]} value={customer}
  onChange={setCustomer} placeholder="Bill to" aria-label="Customer" />
```

### AvatarGroup

Overlapping avatars for a team, with name tooltips, a "+N" overflow popover and a "Maya, Theo and 7 others" summary.

Each avatar is ringed in the surface colour so the stack reads cleanly on cards; hovering or focusing one lifts it above its neighbours without moving the layout. Initials on token-tinted backgrounds stand in for missing photos. Data-driven: pass `people`. Prefer the `AvatarGroup` exported from `avatar` (a plain flex wrapper) when you compose `Avatar` children by hand.

- Name: `avatar-group` (component, Layout)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/avatar-group` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { AvatarGroup } from "@/components/ui/avatar-group"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/avatar-group"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react
- Uses: popover, tooltip
- Related: avatar, live-cursors-bar, user-chip, animated-tooltip
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/avatar-group (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/avatar-group.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| people? | `AvatarGroupPerson[]` | `TEAM` | Everyone in the group, in display order. Omit for sample data. |
| max? | `number` | `5` | Avatars shown before the "+N" chip. If only one person would overflow, they are shown instead of "+1". |
| size? | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` | Avatar diameter: sm 24px, md 32px, lg 40px. |
| label? | `string` | `"Northwind team"` | Accessible name for the group, also the overflow popover title. |
| summary? | `boolean` | `true` | Show a "Maya, Theo and 7 others" line after the stack. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<AvatarGroup label="Northwind team" max={4} size="sm"
  people={[{ name: "Maya Chen", role: "Head of Finance", src: "/maya.jpg" }, { name: "Theo Okafor" }]} />
```

A profile photo picker: the current avatar with an Upload button that opens the file chooser and previews the pick.

Use in profile and team settings. It previews locally and hands you the `File`; uploading is yours. Prefer `ImageUpload` for larger images with drag and drop, and `FileDropzone` for any file.

### Avatar

A round user picture with an initials fallback while the image loads or if it fails.

Compose `Avatar` > `AvatarImage` + `AvatarFallback`. Add `AvatarBadge` for a status dot, and wrap several in this file's `AvatarGroup` for a simple overlapping stack. Prefer the data-driven `AvatarGroup` from `avatar-group` for tooltips and a "+N" overflow. Give `AvatarImage` an `alt` with the person's name, or `alt=""` when the name is printed next to it.

- Name: `avatar` (component, Media)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/avatar` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Avatar, AvatarImage, AvatarFallback, AvatarGroup, AvatarGroupCount, AvatarBadge } from "@/components/ui/avatar"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/avatar"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react
- Related: avatar-group
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/avatar (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/avatar.md)

Props (also accepts AvatarPrimitive.Root props):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| size? | `"default" \| "sm" \| "lg"` | `"default"` | Diameter: sm 24px, default 32px, lg 40px. Override with a `size-*` class for others. |

```tsx
<Avatar size="lg">
  <AvatarImage src="/maya.jpg" alt="Maya Chen" />
  <AvatarFallback>MC</AvatarFallback>
</Avatar>
```

### BackLink

A quiet "← Back" link to the parent page, placed above a page title.

Use on detail pages ("← Invoices"). Prefer `Breadcrumb` when the hierarchy is deeper than one level. It is a real link (`<a href>`), so it works without JavaScript and opens in a new tab; for Next.js client navigation pass `onClick` with `router.push`, or wrap your own `Link`. The arrow nudges left on hover.

- Name: `back-link` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/back-link` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { BackLink } from "@/components/ui/back-link"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/back-link"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Related: breadcrumb, link
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/back-link (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/back-link.md)

Props (also accepts <a>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| href? | `string` | `"#"` | Parent page URL. |
| children? | `React.ReactNode` | `"Back"` | Link text; name the destination ("Invoices"), not just "Back". |

```tsx
<BackLink href="/invoices">Invoices</BackLink>
```

### BackToTop

A floating back to top button that appears after the reader scrolls, with a ring that fills as they progress.

Use on long docs, articles and changelogs. Fixed bottom-right; move it with `className`. Scrolls smoothly unless reduced motion is on, then moves focus to `<main>` (or the first `<h1>`) so keyboard users land at the top too. While hidden it is out of the tab order.

- Name: `back-to-top` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/back-to-top` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { BackToTop } from "@/components/ui/back-to-top"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/back-to-top"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/back-to-top (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/back-to-top.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| threshold? | `number` | `400` | Show after this many pixels of scroll. |
| target? | `React.RefObject<HTMLElement \| null>` |  | Element to scroll; defaults to the window. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<BackToTop threshold={600} />
// inside a scrolling panel:
<BackToTop target={panelRef} className="absolute" />
```

### Badge

A small pill label for status, counts and categories ("Paid", "Beta", "3 new").

Use next to text or in table cells. Prefer `StatusBadge` for a status with a dot, `TagsInput` for editable tags, and `Kbd` for keyboard keys. `render={<a href="…" />}` makes it a link (hover styles turn on automatically). Add an icon with `data-icon="inline-start"` on the svg.

Variants: default (ink), accent, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link.

- Name: `badge` (component, Feedback)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/badge` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

- Related: status-badge, tags-input, kbd, permission-chip, version-badge
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/badge (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/badge.md)

Props (also accepts <span>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

```tsx
<Badge variant="accent">Beta</Badge>
<Badge variant="destructive">Overdue</Badge>
<Badge render={<a href="/changelog" />} variant="outline">v2.4</Badge>
```

### Banner

A full-width, tinted notice bar for in-app messages, with an optional action and dismiss button.

Use at the top of an app or a page section for state the user should know about (trial ending, degraded service, unpaid invoice). Prefer `AnnouncementBar` for marketing news, `InlineAlert` or `Callout` inside content, and `Toast` for transient feedback. It is a polite live region, so a banner that appears later is announced. `danger` uses `role="alert"` and interrupts.

- Name: `banner` (component, Feedback)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/banner` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Banner } from "@/components/ui/banner"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/banner"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: icon-button
- Related: announcement-bar, inline-alert, callout, toast, cta-banner, pinned-message
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/banner (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/banner.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `React.ReactNode` |  | The message. Keep it to one sentence. |
| tone? | `BannerTone` | `"accent"` | Colour and urgency. `danger` is announced assertively. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| action? | `React.ReactNode` |  | A button or link shown before the dismiss button. |
| onDismiss? | `() => void` |  | Shows a dismiss button and is called when it is pressed. |

```tsx
<Banner tone="warning" action={<Button size="sm" variant="outline">Update card</Button>} onDismiss={hide}>
  Your card ending 4242 expires this month.
</Banner>
```

### BarChart

Rounded-top bars on a hairline baseline; hovering one bar dims its siblings and surfaces the value, and the peak is marked by default.

Use for one value per period or category (monthly revenue, signups per day). Prefer `StackedBarChart` for parts of a whole, `HorizontalBarChart` for long category names, and `AreaChart` for a continuous trend. Screen readers get `label` followed by every label and value. Size it with `className` (default `h-40 w-full`).

- Name: `bar-chart` (component, Charts)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/bar-chart` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { BarChart } from "@/components/ui/bar-chart"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/bar-chart"`)
- Related: stacked-bar-chart, horizontal-bar-chart, area-chart, chart-card, pie-chart, scatter-chart, dashboard-home, report-builder
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/bar-chart (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/bar-chart.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data? | `{ label: string; value: number }[]` | `SAMPLE_DATA` | One bar per item, left to right. `label` is printed under the bar. Omit for sample data. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| label? | `string` | `"Bar chart"` | Accessible name; every label and formatted value is appended for screen readers. |
| format? | `(n: number) => string` | `(n: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-US")` | Formats values in the hover bubble and the accessible summary. |

```tsx
<BarChart label="Revenue by month" format={(n) => `$${(n / 1000).toFixed(1)}k`}
  data={[{ label: "Sep", value: 56100 }, { label: "Oct", value: 61400 }]} />
```

A responsive bento grid: feature tiles of different spans on a six column grid that collapse to one column on phones.

Use on landing pages to show four to seven product features. Each tile has an icon, title, copy and an optional `visual`; tiles with `href` become links. Prefer `FeatureGrid` for equal tiles. Server component friendly, no motion, no client JavaScript.

### BillingAddress

Billing address fields (street, city, state, postal code) with browser autofill hints, for checkout and billing settings.

Drop it inside your own `<form>`; it renders fields only, no submit button. Field names are `address`, `city`, `state` and `postal-code`, so `new FormData(form)` reads them directly. Ids are generated, so it can appear twice on a page (billing and shipping) with different `section`s.

- Name: `billing-address` (component, Billing)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/billing-address` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { BillingAddress } from "@/components/ui/billing-address"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/billing-address"`)
- Uses: form-field, input, textarea
- Related: shipping-address, tax-fields

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| section? | `"billing" \| "shipping"` | `"billing"` | Autofill section, e.g. "billing" or "shipping". Becomes the autocomplete token prefix. |
| required? | `boolean` |  | Marks every field required. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<form onSubmit={save}>
  <BillingAddress section="billing" />
  <Button type="submit">Save</Button>
</form>
```

### BlogCard

A linked article card: cover image, tag, relative date, title and a two-line excerpt.

Use in blog indexes, changelogs and "related posts". The whole card is one link, so do not nest other links or buttons inside. Prefer `Card` for non-link content. Without `image` the 16:9 slot shows a sunken placeholder, so grids stay aligned.

- Name: `blog-card` (component, Landing pages)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/blog-card` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { BlogCard } from "@/components/ui/blog-card"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/blog-card"`)
- Uses: aspect-ratio, relative-time
- Related: card, blog-home
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/blog-card (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/blog-card.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `string` |  | Post title (an `h3`); also the link's name. |
| excerpt | `string` |  | Summary, clamped to two lines. |
| href? | `string` | `"#"` | Post URL. |
| image? | `string` |  | Cover image URL, cropped to 16:9. Decorative: the title names the link. |
| date? | `string \| Date` |  | Publish date, shown as "3d ago" with the exact time for machines. |
| tag? | `string` |  | Category shown above the title. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<BlogCard href="/blog/close-books-faster" title="Close the books in two days"
  excerpt="How Northwind cut month-end from a week to two days." image="/covers/close.jpg"
  tag="Finance" date="2026-11-02" />
```

### BreadcrumbEllipsis

A "…" marker for collapsed middle levels in a breadcrumb trail.

Use it when a trail is deeper than about four levels and the middle ones matter less than the root and the current page. `Breadcrumb` takes string labels only, so build that trail by hand (a `nav` with an `ol`) and put this between the items. Decorative by default (hidden from screen readers). To let people open the hidden levels, wrap it in a `DropdownMenuTrigger` and give that trigger `aria-label="Show more pages"`.

- Name: `breadcrumb-ellipsis` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/breadcrumb-ellipsis` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

- Related: breadcrumb, dropdown-menu
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/breadcrumb-ellipsis (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/breadcrumb-ellipsis.md)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| className? | `string` |  |  |


### Breadcrumb

A navigation trail of links with chevron separators; the last item is the current page.

Use at the top of nested pages (Customers › Northwind › INV-2041). Prefer `BackLink` when there is only one level to go back. Follows the WAI-ARIA breadcrumb pattern: a labelled `nav` with an ordered list, separators hidden from screen readers, and `aria-current="page"` on the last item. Long trails wrap and each label truncates. Labels are strings, so to collapse the middle levels build the trail by hand with `BreadcrumbEllipsis` instead.

- Name: `breadcrumb` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/breadcrumb` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Breadcrumb } from "@/components/ui/breadcrumb"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/breadcrumb"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Related: back-link, breadcrumb-ellipsis
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/breadcrumb (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/breadcrumb.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| items? | `Crumb[]` | `SAMPLE_ITEMS` | Steps from the root to the current page. Omit for sample data. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<Breadcrumb items={[{ label: "Customers", href: "/customers" }, { label: "Northwind", href: "/customers/northwind" }, { label: "INV-2041" }]} />
```

### BuildPipeline

CI/CD stages in a row (Install → Typecheck → Test → Deploy), each with a status icon.

Use on deploy and PR pages for a glanceable pipeline. Prefer `AgentTrace` for a vertical log with details, and `Stepper` for a user-driven multi-step flow. Wraps on narrow screens; each stage announces its status, and the running stage is marked `aria-current="step"`.

- Name: `build-pipeline` (component, Dev tools)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |

```tsx
<BuildPipeline stages={[
  { name: "Install", status: "success" },
  { name: "Test", status: "running" },

```

### BulkActionsBar

A floating bar that appears when table rows are selected: "3 selected", your action buttons and Clear.

Render it under a `Table` with `RowSelection` checkboxes, or a selectable card list, and pass the selection size as `count`; it renders nothing at 0. `DataTable` with `selectable` has its own bar, so do not add this one there. Sticky to the bottom of its scroll container. The count is a live region, so changes are announced; the bar itself is a labelled region.

- Name: `bulk-actions-bar` (component, Tables)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/bulk-actions-bar` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { BulkActionsBar } from "@/components/ui/bulk-actions-bar"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/bulk-actions-bar"`)

- Related: table, row-selection, data-table
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/bulk-actions-bar (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/bulk-actions-bar.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| count | `number` |  | Number of selected items. The bar is hidden at 0. |
| children? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Action buttons, usually `Button size="sm"`. |
| onClear? | `() => void` |  | Shows a Clear button and is called when it is pressed. |
| label? | `string` | `"Bulk actions"` | Accessible name of the bar. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<BulkActionsBar count={selected.length} onClear={() => setSelected([])}>
  <Button size="sm" variant="outline">Export</Button>
  <Button size="sm" variant="destructive">Delete</Button>
</BulkActionsBar>
```

### ButtonGroup

Joins adjacent `Button`s into one segmented control with shared borders (Day | Week | Month, Copy | ▾).

Use for a few related actions that belong together. Prefer `SegmentedControl` or `ToggleGroup` when exactly one option is selected. Works best with `variant="outline"` buttons. Give the group an `aria-label` so screen readers announce what the buttons are for.

- Name: `button-group` (component, Buttons)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/button-group` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ButtonGroup } from "@/components/ui/button-group"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/button-group"`)
- Related: button, segmented-control, toggle-group
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/button-group (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/button-group.md)

Props (also accepts <div>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| orientation? | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` | `"horizontal"` | Lay the buttons out in a row (default) or a column. |

```tsx
<ButtonGroup aria-label="Invoice actions">
  <Button variant="outline">Send</Button>
  <Button variant="outline">Download</Button>
  <Button variant="outline">Void</Button>
</ButtonGroup>
```

### Button

The Hairline keycap: the kit's one button, in eight variants and nine sizes.

Use `default` (ink) for the primary action, `outline` for secondary, `ghost` in toolbars, `destructive` for irreversible actions, `accent` at most once per screen, `link` for inline text actions. For an icon-only button use `IconButton` (it requires `aria-label`). To render a link that looks like a button, pass `render={<a href="/pricing" />}` (or a Next.js `<Link />`); `nativeButton` is set for you. Disable with `disabled`; Base UI keeps it focusable when you also pass `focusableWhenDisabled`.

Solid variants carry an inner top highlight and bottom edge (shadow-ink), outline a 1px key edge (shadow-key). Hover changes one property, press sinks 0.5px, nothing shifts layout.

Sizes: xs 28px, sm 32px, default 36px, lg 44px, xl 48px; icon, icon-xs, icon-sm, icon-lg are square.

- Name: `button` (component, Buttons)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/button` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/button"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react, class-variance-authority
- Related: icon-button, link, auth-card, button-group, copy-button, email-button, floating-action-button, split-button
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/button (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/button.md)

Props (also accepts ButtonPrimitive props):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant? | `"default" \| "accent" \| "outline" \| "secondary" \| "ghost" \| "soft" \| "destructive" \| "link"` | `"default"` |  |
| size? | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "default" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| "icon" \| "icon-xs" \| "icon-sm" \| "icon-lg"` | `"default"` |  |

```tsx
<Button>Save invoice</Button>
<Button variant="outline" size="sm"><DownloadIcon /> Export</Button>
<Button render={<a href="/pricing" />} variant="accent" size="lg">See pricing</Button>
```

### CalendarAgenda

A day's events as a simple time and title list, with optional meta under each entry.

Use in a sidebar or dashboard card for "Today". Prefer `EventCalendar` for a week or month view with event blocks, and `CalendarMonth` to pick a date. Marked up as a list; times are `<time>`.

### CalendarMonth

A single month grid for picking a day, with real weekday alignment and full keyboard support.

Use inline or inside a `Popover` to pick a date. Prefer `DatePicker` for a form field with a native picker, `DateRangePicker` for from/to, and `EventCalendar` to show events. Selection is controlled: pass `selected` and `onSelect`. Keyboard: one Tab stop; Arrow keys move by day or week, Home/End jump to the first/last day, Enter or Space selects. Each day is announced with its full date, and the selected day is `aria-pressed`.

- Name: `calendar-month` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/calendar-month` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CalendarMonth } from "@/components/ui/calendar-month"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/calendar-month"`)
- Related: popover, date-picker, date-range-picker, event-calendar, calendar-agenda
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/calendar-month (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/calendar-month.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| month? | `Date` | `DEFAULT_MONTH` | Any date inside the month to show. Defaults to September 2026. |
| selected? | `number` |  | Selected day of the month, 1 to 31. |
| onSelect? | `(day: number) => void` |  | Called with the day of the month that was picked. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
const [day, setDay] = React.useState<number>()
<CalendarMonth month={new Date(2026, 10, 1)} selected={day} onSelect={setDay} />
```

### Calendar

A month grid for picking one date, a range or several dates, with arrow-key navigation and a range preview on hover.

Use it inline or inside a Popover when people need to see the month: bookings, report periods, availability. Set `mode` to "single", "range" or "multiple"; `value` is then a `Date`, a `{ from, to }` range or a `Date[]`. `months={2}` shows two months side by side from the `sm` breakpoint, and `presets` adds a rail of ready-made ranges in range mode. Bound it with `min`, `max` and `disabled`. Month and day names come from `Intl.DateTimeFormat` in `locale`. It has no frame, so it sits flush in a Popover or card; on its own add `className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface shadow-raised"`. For a typed native field use DatePicker or DateRangePicker, for a date plus a time use DateTimePicker, and to show events use EventCalendar.

- Name: `calendar` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/calendar` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Calendar } from "@/components/ui/calendar"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/calendar"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react, motion
- Uses: button
- Related: popover, date-picker, date-range-picker, date-time-picker, event-calendar
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/calendar (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/calendar.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mode? | `M` | `"single" as M` | "single" picks one day, "range" a from/to pair, "multiple" any set of days. |
| value? | `CalendarValue<M> \| null` |  | Controlled selection: a Date, a `{ from, to }` range or a Date[], to match `mode`. |
| defaultValue? | `CalendarValue<M> \| null` | `null` | Starting selection when uncontrolled. |
| onValueChange? | `(value: CalendarValue<M>) => void` |  | Fires with the whole new selection on every pick. |
| months? | `1 \| 2` | `1` | Months shown at once. Two sit side by side from the sm breakpoint and stack on phones. |
| defaultMonth? | `Date` |  | The first month shown. Defaults to the selection's month, else the current month. |
| min? | `Date` |  | Earliest day that can be picked. |
| max? | `Date` |  | Latest day that can be picked. |
| disabled? | `Date[] \| ((date: Date) => boolean)` |  | Days that cannot be picked: a list of dates or a test function. |
| weekStartsOn? | `0 \| 1` | `0` | First column of the week: 0 is Sunday, 1 is Monday. |
| locale? | `string` | `"en-US"` | BCP 47 locale for month, weekday and day labels. Fixed by default so server and client render the same text. |
| presets? | `CalendarPreset[]` |  | Ready-made ranges shown in a rail beside the grid. Range mode only. |
| showOutsideDays? | `boolean` | `true` | Show the days of the previous and next month in muted text. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
const [range, setRange] = React.useState<DateRange>()
<Calendar mode="range" months={2} value={range} onValueChange={setRange} defaultMonth={new Date(2026, 10, 1)} />
```

### Callout

A tinted note inside content: optional title and body, in info, success, warning or danger.

Use in docs, forms and settings to point out something the reader should know. Prefer `Banner` for page-level notices, `InlineAlert` for form errors and status with an icon, and `Toast` for transient feedback. It is a static `role="note"`, not a live region.

- Name: `callout` (component, Feedback)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/callout` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Callout } from "@/components/ui/callout"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/callout"`)
- Related: banner, inline-alert, toast, announcement-bar, incident-banner, merge-box, pinned-message, well
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/callout (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/callout.md)

Props (also accepts <div>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tone? | `CalloutTone` | `"info"` | Tint of the border and background. |
| title? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Bold first line. |

```tsx
<Callout tone="warning" title="Invoices are final">Sent invoices cannot be edited, only voided.</Callout>
```

### CancelFlow

A two-step subscription cancel flow: ask why (one reason), then confirm.

Use in billing settings behind a "Cancel plan" button, or inside a `Dialog`. Prefer `AlertDialog` for a one-step confirmation. Reasons are a labelled radio group, Continue is disabled until one is chosen, and focus moves to each new step's heading.

- Name: `cancel-flow` (component, Billing)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/cancel-flow` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CancelFlow } from "@/components/ui/cancel-flow"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/cancel-flow"`)
- Uses: button
- Related: dialog, alert-dialog, downgrade-warning
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/cancel-flow (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/cancel-flow.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| planName? | `string` | `"Premium"` | Plan being cancelled, used in the heading. |
| reasons? | `string[]` | `REASONS` | Reasons to choose from. |
| onConfirm? | `(reason: string) => void` |  | Called with the chosen reason when the user confirms. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<CancelFlow planName="Scale" onConfirm={(reason) => cancelSubscription({ reason })} />
```

### Card

The basic raised surface: a bordered, rounded panel with optional header, content and footer slots.

Compose `Card` > `CardHeader` (`CardTitle`, `CardDescription`, `CardAction`) + `CardContent` + `CardFooter`. Spacing comes from one `--card-spacing` variable, so `size="sm"` tightens every slot at once. A first child `<img>` bleeds to the edges. Use it for any grouped content; prefer `StatCard` for a single KPI and `BlogCard` for a linked article. Server component friendly.

- Name: `card` (component, Layout)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/card` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Card, CardHeader, CardFooter, CardTitle, CardAction, CardDescription, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/card"`)
- Related: stat-card, blog-card, auth-card, credit-card-input, email-card, hover-card, inset, product-card
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/card (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/card.md)

Props (also accepts <div>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| size? | `"default" \| "sm"` | `"default"` | Spacing scale for every slot: default 20px, sm 14px. |

```tsx
<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle>Northwind</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>Customer since 2023</CardDescription>
    <CardAction><Button size="sm" variant="outline">Edit</Button></CardAction>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent>Open balance: $12,400</CardContent>
  <CardFooter><Button size="sm">Send invoice</Button></CardFooter>
</Card>
```

### Carousel

A horizontal, scroll-snapping row of slides with previous/next buttons.

Use for testimonials, product shots or cards that do not fit in one row. Shows about 1.2 slides on phones, 2 on tablets and 3 on desktop; touch users swipe natively. Prefer `Marquee` for an auto-scrolling logo strip. Follows the WAI-ARIA carousel pattern: a labelled region, each slide a group named "2 of 6", Arrow Left/Right scroll when the track is focused, buttons disable at the ends, and scrolling is instant under reduced motion.

- Name: `carousel` (component, Media)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/carousel` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Carousel } from "@/components/ui/carousel"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/carousel"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: icon-button
- Related: marquee, image-gallery, image-lightbox
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/carousel (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/carousel.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `React.ReactNode` |  | One child per slide. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| label? | `string` | `"Carousel"` | Accessible name of the carousel region. |

```tsx
<Carousel label="Customer stories">
  {stories.map((s) => <StoryCard key={s.id} {...s} />)}
</Carousel>
```

### CartLineItem

One product row in a cart or order summary: title, price, a quantity stepper and remove.

Stack rows inside a cart drawer or checkout. Quantity is controlled: pass `quantity` and update it in `onQuantityChange`. The stepper is a group named "Quantity for <title>" so its +/- buttons make sense to screen readers; the remove button only renders with `onRemove`.

- Name: `cart-line-item` (component, E-commerce)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/cart-line-item` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CartLineItem } from "@/components/ui/cart-line-item"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/cart-line-item"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: icon-button, quantity-stepper
- Related: stack
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/cart-line-item (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/cart-line-item.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `string` |  | Product name. |
| price | `string` |  | Pre-formatted price, e.g. "$480.00". |
| quantity | `number` |  | Current quantity (controlled). |
| onQuantityChange? | `(n: number) => void` |  | Called with the new quantity, already clamped to `min`…`max`. |
| min? | `number` |  | Lowest quantity the stepper allows. |
| max? | `number` |  | Highest quantity the stepper allows. |
| onRemove? | `() => void` |  | Shows a remove button and is called when it is pressed. |
| media? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional thumbnail, e.g. a 40px image. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<CartLineItem title="Lumen Pro, annual" price="$480.00" quantity={qty}
  onQuantityChange={setQty} onRemove={() => remove(id)} />
```

### CaseStudyCard

A customer-story card: company eyebrow, headline, one big result figure and an optional delta chip.

Use on marketing and customers pages, one outcome per card. For a live dashboard number use StatCard; for a quote use Testimonial. Only show results the customer has approved; never invent figures.

- Name: `case-study-card` (component, Landing pages)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/case-study-card` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CaseStudyCard } from "@/components/ui/case-study-card"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/case-study-card"`)
- Uses: metric-delta
- Related: stat-card, testimonial
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/case-study-card (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/case-study-card.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| company | `string` |  | Customer name, shown as a small uppercase eyebrow. |
| title | `string` |  | Headline describing the outcome. Rendered as an h3. |
| result | `string` |  | The headline figure, pre-formatted (e.g. "2 days", "$1.2M"). |
| delta? | `number` |  | Optional percent change shown beside the result; negative values render as a decrease. |
| invertDelta? | `boolean` | `false` | Show a fall in `delta` as good (green), for figures like close time or cost. |
| href? | `string` |  | Wraps the card in a link when set, so the whole card opens the full story. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<CaseStudyCard company="Northwind" title="Month-end close in two days" result="2 days" delta={-60} invertDelta />
```

### Center

A layout primitive that centres its children horizontally and vertically in a narrow, text-centred column.

Use for empty states, auth screens and single-message pages. For a page-width wrapper use Container; for a row of items use Cluster; for a vertical list use Stack.


### CharacterCount

A "42/280" counter for a text field that turns red past the limit and tells screen readers only when the limit is near.

Use it for bios, tweets, SMS bodies and meta descriptions, anywhere a limit is part of the content. Place it under a Textarea or Input and point the field's `aria-describedby` at its `id`. It does not block typing; pair it with the field's `maxLength` if you need a hard cap. For a word count and live preview use MarkdownEditor.

- Name: `character-count` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/character-count` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CharacterCount } from "@/components/ui/character-count"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/character-count"`)
- Related: textarea, input, markdown-editor
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/character-count (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/character-count.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `number` | `0` | Current length, usually `value.length`. |
| max | `number` |  | The limit. Past it the count turns red. |
| warnAt? | `number` |  | Remaining characters at which screen readers start hearing the count. Defaults to 10% of `max`. |
| id? | `string` |  | Id for the field's `aria-describedby`. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
const [text, setText] = React.useState("")
<Textarea value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} aria-describedby="bio-count" />
<CharacterCount id="bio-count" value={text.length} max={280} />
```

### ChartCard

A raised card that frames a chart with a title, an optional description and an optional header action.

Wrap AreaChart, BarChart, LineChart and friends in it so every chart on a dashboard shares one header style. The title labels the region for screen readers. For a single KPI with a sparkline use StatSparkline.

- Name: `chart-card` (component, Charts)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/chart-card` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ChartCard } from "@/components/ui/chart-card"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/chart-card"`)
- Related: area-chart, bar-chart, line-chart, stat-sparkline, chart-legend, dashboard-home, report-builder
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/chart-card (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/chart-card.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `React.ReactNode` |  | Card heading, rendered as an h3 that names the region. |
| description? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Secondary line under the title, such as the time range. |
| action? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Rendered at the header's end: a range picker, a menu or a link. |
| children? | `React.ReactNode` |  | The chart, plus any ChartLegend. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<ChartCard title="Revenue" description="Last 12 weeks" action={<Button size="sm" variant="ghost">Export</Button>}>
  <AreaChart data={weekly} />
</ChartCard>
```

### ChartLegend

Pass the same colours your chart uses so the key matches. Swatches are decorative; the label carries the meaning. Use inside ChartCard below the chart.

### ChartTooltipCard

A small raised card for chart hover details: a title and label-value rows with tabular numbers.

Render it inside your chart's hover layer, positioned at the pointer. It is a polite live region, so screen readers hear the values as the hovered point changes. For a tooltip on a button or icon use Tooltip instead.

- Name: `chart-tooltip-card` (component, Charts)

| rows? | `TooltipRow[]` | `SAMPLE_ROWS` | Label-value pairs, values pre-formatted. Labels double as keys, so keep them unique. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<ChartTooltipCard title="Week 12" rows={[{ label: "Revenue", value: "$49,000" }, { label: "Refunds", value: "$1,200" }]} />
```

### ChatThread

A scrolling chat transcript of MessageBubbles that sticks to the newest message unless the reader has scrolled up.

Use for AI chat and support threads. Give it a fixed height (e.g. `className="h-96"`) so it scrolls. It is a `role="log"` region, so screen readers hear new messages politely. Pair with PromptInput or AiComposer below it.

- Name: `chat-thread` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/chat-thread` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ChatThread } from "@/components/ui/chat-thread"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/chat-thread"`)
- Uses: message-bubble
- Related: prompt-input, ai-composer, comment-thread, conversation-sidebar, chat-page
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/chat-thread (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/chat-thread.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| messages | `ChatMessage[]` |  | Messages oldest first. `id` must be stable; `streaming` shows the live cursor on that bubble. |
| empty? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Shown when `messages` is empty. Defaults to a muted "No messages yet". |
| label? | `string` | `"Conversation"` | Accessible name for the log region. Defaults to "Conversation". |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<ChatThread
  className="h-96"
  messages={[
    { id: "1", role: "user", content: "Summarise INV-2041" },
    { id: "2", role: "assistant", content: "Northwind owes $12,400, due Friday.", streaming: true },
  ]}
/>
```

### CheckboxGroup

A labelled group that stacks related Checkboxes, so screen readers announce the group name before each option.

Use for "pick any" choices (notification channels, permissions). For "pick one" use RadioGroup; for filters as chips use ChipFilter. Give it a `label` (visible) or an `aria-label`.

- Name: `checkbox-group` (component, Forms)

```tsx
<CheckboxGroup label="Email me about">
  <Label className="flex items-center gap-2"><Checkbox name="notify" value="invoices" defaultChecked /> Paid invoices</Label>
  <Label className="flex items-center gap-2"><Checkbox name="notify" value="reports" /> Weekly reports</Label>
```
