### Checkbox

An accessible checkbox built on Base UI: 16px box, 44px touch target, accent fill when checked, a dash when indeterminate.

Use for independent on/off choices and multi-select lists; wrap several in CheckboxGroup. For a setting that applies immediately use Switch. Controlled with `checked` + `onCheckedChange(checked: boolean)`, or uncontrolled with `defaultChecked`. Pass `name` and `value` to submit with a form. Label it with a wrapping `<Label>` or `aria-label`; set `aria-invalid` to show the error state.

- Name: `checkbox` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/checkbox` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/checkbox"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react
- Related: checkbox-group, switch, label, row-selection, signature-pad
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/checkbox (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/checkbox.md)

Props: CheckboxPrimitive.Root props.

```tsx
<Label className="flex items-center gap-2"><Checkbox name="terms" required /> I accept the terms</Label>
<Checkbox checked={all} indeterminate={some} onCheckedChange={toggleAll} aria-label="Select all rows" />
```

### CheckoutSummary

A compact checkout panel: line items, a total and one pay button.

Use beside a payment form (CreditCardInput) at the last step of checkout. For a full order breakdown with tax and discounts use OrderSummary. Prices are pre-formatted strings, so format money with Intl.NumberFormat before passing it in.

- Name: `checkout-summary` (component, E-commerce)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/checkout-summary` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CheckoutSummary } from "@/components/ui/checkout-summary"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/checkout-summary"`)
- Uses: button
- Related: credit-card-input, order-summary, coupon-input, invoice-detail
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/checkout-summary (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/checkout-summary.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| items? | `{ name: string; price: string }[]` | `SAMPLE_ITEMS` | Line items. `name` is the React key, so keep names unique. |
| total? | `string` | `"$61"` | Pre-formatted total, e.g. "$61". |
| title? | `string` | `"Order summary"` | Heading. Defaults to "Order summary". |
| payLabel? | `string` | `"Pay now"` | Pay button text. Defaults to "Pay now". |
| onPay? | `() => void` |  | Called when the pay button is pressed. Set `payType="submit"` instead to submit the surrounding form. |
| payType? | `"button" \| "submit"` | `"button"` | Button type. Use "submit" inside a `<form>`. |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  | Disables the pay button, e.g. while card details are invalid or a payment is in flight. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<CheckoutSummary
  items={[{ name: "Pro · monthly", price: "$49" }]}
  total="$49"
  onPay={submit}
  payLabel="Pay $49"
/>
```

### ChipFilter

A row of pill-shaped radio chips for picking one filter, uncontrolled unless a value is passed.

Use above a list or table to switch between a few status filters ("All", "Paid", "Overdue"). For many options use Select; for toggling several filters at once use FacetFilter; for switching views use SegmentedControl or Tabs. Keyboard: Tab enters the group, arrow keys move and select, Home/End jump to the ends.

- Name: `chip-filter` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/chip-filter` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ChipFilter } from "@/components/ui/chip-filter"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/chip-filter"`)
- Related: select, facet-filter, segmented-control, tabs, checkbox-group, context-chip, filter-bar, query-builder
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/chip-filter (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/chip-filter.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| options? | `ChipOption[]` | `SAMPLE_OPTIONS` | Chips in order. `value` must be unique. |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled selection. Leave undefined for an uncontrolled filter. |
| defaultValue? | `string` | `"all"` | Initial selection for the uncontrolled filter. |
| onChange? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called with the chip's `value` whenever the selection changes. |
| label? | `string` | `"Filter"` | Accessible name for the radio group. Defaults to "Filter". |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
const [status, setStatus] = React.useState("all")
<ChipFilter label="Invoice status" options={[{ value: "all", label: "All" }, { value: "paid", label: "Paid" }]} value={status} onChange={setStatus} />
```

### ChoiceCard

A large selectable card button with an optional icon, a title and a description.

Use for onboarding and plan or workspace-type choices where each option needs a sentence of explanation. Pass `selected` to make it a toggle button (`aria-pressed`); wrap a set in a `role="group"` with an `aria-label`. For compact single choice use RadioGroup or SegmentedControl; for pricing use PlanCard.

- Name: `choice-card` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/choice-card` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ChoiceCard } from "@/components/ui/choice-card"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/choice-card"`)
- Related: radio-group, segmented-control, plan-card
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/choice-card (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/choice-card.md)

Props (also accepts <button>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `React.ReactNode` |  | Bold first line. |
| description? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Supporting sentence under the title. |
| selected? | `boolean` |  | Selected state. When defined the card is a toggle button and announces pressed or not pressed. |
| icon? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Leading icon, sized to 20px. |

```tsx
<div role="group" aria-label="Workspace type" className="grid gap-2">
  <ChoiceCard title="Personal" description="Just you." selected={type === "solo"} onClick={() => setType("solo")} />
  <ChoiceCard title="Team" description="Invite up to 10 people." selected={type === "team"} onClick={() => setType("team")} />
</div>
```

### CitationChip

A small inline chip that cites a source in an AI answer: an optional numbered index plus the source name.

Place it inline after the sentence it supports. It renders a button (open a SourceCard or side panel in `onClick`), or a link when `href` is set. Other props (`onClick`, `aria-label`, `id`…) reach either element. For a full source preview use SourceCard; for attached files in a prompt use ContextPill.

- Name: `citation-chip` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/citation-chip` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CitationChip } from "@/components/ui/citation-chip"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/citation-chip"`)
- Related: source-card, context-pill, file-reference, link-preview
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/citation-chip (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/citation-chip.md)

Props (also accepts <button>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| index? | `number` |  | Footnote number shown in accent before the label. |
| href? | `string` |  | Renders an external link (opens in a new tab) instead of a button. |

```tsx
<p>Refunds settle in 5-10 days <CitationChip index={1} href="https://docs.acme.example/refunds">Refund policy</CitationChip></p>
```

### Cluster

A layout primitive that lays children out in a wrapping row with an even gap, like tags, buttons or badges.

Use for horizontal groups that should wrap on narrow screens. For a vertical list use Stack; for centring use Center; for page width use Container. `gap` is in 4px steps, so `gap={2}` is 8px.

- Name: `cluster` (component, Layout)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/cluster` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Cluster } from "@/components/ui/cluster"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/cluster"`)
- Related: stack, center, container
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/cluster (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/cluster.md)

Props (also accepts <div>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| gap? | `number` | `2` | Space between items in 4px steps (2 = 8px). Defaults to 2. |
| align? | `"start" \| "center" \| "end" \| "baseline" \| "stretch"` | `"center"` | Cross-axis alignment. Defaults to "center". |
| justify? | `"start" \| "center" \| "end" \| "between"` | `"start"` | Main-axis distribution. Defaults to "start". |

```tsx
<Cluster gap={2} justify="end"><Button variant="ghost">Cancel</Button><Button>Save</Button></Cluster>
```

### CodeBlock

An ink-well code block in both themes, with lightweight token colouring (strings, keywords, JSX tags, comments) and a copy button.

Use for static snippets in docs, onboarding and API-key screens. It highlights with a tiny built-in tokenizer (no Shiki/Prism), so it suits short JS/TS/JSX/shell snippets. For a live editable area use CodeEditorFrame; for a shell session use TerminalWindow; for a single command with a copy button use CopyButton beside an inline `<code>`.

- Name: `code-block` (component, Dev tools)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/code-block` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CodeBlock } from "@/components/ui/code-block"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/code-block"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Related: code-editor-frame, terminal-window, copy-button, artifact-preview, diff-view, json-viewer, markdown-renderer, notebook-cell
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/code-block (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/code-block.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| code? | `string` | `SAMPLE_CODE` | The source to show and copy. A trailing newline is ignored. |
| language? | `string` | `"tsx"` | Label shown in the header badge, e.g. "tsx", "bash", "json". Does not change highlighting. |
| filename? | `string` |  | File name shown in the header. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| showLineNumbers? | `boolean` | `false` | Prefix each line with its number (not copied). |

```tsx
<CodeBlock filename="install.sh" language="bash" code={"npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/button.json"} />
```

### CodeEditorFrame

A neutral editor chrome: a file-name tab bar over a monospace body that hosts your own editor or code.

Wrap a `<textarea>`, CodeMirror or Monaco in it so the editor matches the kit. For read-only highlighted snippets with a copy button use CodeBlock; for a whole window with traffic lights use WindowChrome.

- Name: `code-editor-frame` (component, Dev tools)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/code-editor-frame` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CodeEditorFrame } from "@/components/ui/code-editor-frame"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/code-editor-frame"`)
- Related: code-block, window-chrome
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/code-editor-frame (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/code-editor-frame.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| filename? | `string` |  | File name shown in the tab bar; also names the region for screen readers. |
| actions? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Controls at the tab bar's end, such as Run or Format buttons. |
| children? | `React.ReactNode` |  | The editor itself. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<CodeEditorFrame filename="schema.sql" actions={<Button size="xs" variant="ghost">Run</Button>}>
  <textarea aria-label="SQL" className="w-full resize-none bg-transparent outline-none" rows={8} />
</CodeEditorFrame>
```

### CollapsibleSidebar

A Sidebar with a built-in collapse toggle on its edge that shrinks it to an icon rail.

Use as the left rail of an app shell. Uncontrolled by default; pass `collapsed` + `onCollapsedChange` to persist the state. Put SidebarNavItem children inside; when collapsed their labels become screen-reader only, so each icon keeps its name. For a full layout use AppShell; on mobile use MobileNavDrawer.

- Name: `collapsible-sidebar` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/collapsible-sidebar` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CollapsibleSidebar } from "@/components/ui/collapsible-sidebar"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/collapsible-sidebar"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: button, sidebar
- Related: sidebar, app-shell, mobile-nav-drawer, conversation-sidebar
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/collapsible-sidebar (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/collapsible-sidebar.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `React.ReactNode` |  | Sidebar content, usually SidebarNavItems. |
| collapsed? | `boolean` |  | Controlled collapsed state. Leave undefined for an uncontrolled sidebar. |
| defaultCollapsed? | `boolean` | `false` | Initial state for the uncontrolled sidebar. |
| onCollapsedChange? | `(collapsed: boolean) => void` |  | Called with the next state when the toggle is pressed. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<CollapsibleSidebar>
  <SidebarNavItem icon={<HomeIcon />} active>Home</SidebarNavItem>
  <SidebarNavItem icon={<ReceiptIcon />}>Invoices</SidebarNavItem>
</CollapsibleSidebar>
```

### Collapsible

A single show-and-hide section built on Base UI: a full-width trigger button and a panel it opens.

Use for one optional block (advanced settings, an address, "show more"). For a stack of sections use Accordion; for a table row that expands use ExpandableRow. The trigger gets `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` automatically.

Key props (on `Collapsible`): `open` / `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange(open)`, `disabled`. Style the open state with `data-panel-open` on the trigger (e.g. rotate a chevron with `group-data-[panel-open]:rotate-180`).

- Name: `collapsible` (component, Layout)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/collapsible` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Collapsible, CollapsibleTrigger, CollapsiblePanel } from "@/components/ui/collapsible"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/collapsible"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react
- Related: accordion, expandable-row, reasoning-block
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/collapsible (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/collapsible.md)

Props: CollapsibleRoot props.

```tsx
<Collapsible defaultOpen>
  <CollapsibleTrigger className="group">Advanced <ChevronDownIcon className="size-4 transition-transform group-data-[panel-open]:rotate-180" /></CollapsibleTrigger>
  <CollapsiblePanel>Webhook retries, idempotency keys and rate limits.</CollapsiblePanel>
</Collapsible>
```

### ColorPicker

A row of colour swatches that works as a radio group: pick one colour, get its CSS colour string back.

Use for labels, tags, calendars and brand accents where a fixed palette beats a free picker. Uncontrolled unless `value` is passed. Each swatch has a spoken name ("Violet"), so pass `{ value, label }` objects for custom palettes. Keyboard: Tab enters the group, arrow keys move and select, Home/End jump to the ends. For a theme switcher use ThemePicker.

- Name: `color-picker` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/color-picker` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ColorPicker } from "@/components/ui/color-picker"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/color-picker"`)
- Related: theme-picker
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/color-picker (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/color-picker.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled selection (a CSS colour string from `colors`). Leave undefined for an uncontrolled picker. |
| defaultValue? | `string` |  | Initial selection for the uncontrolled picker. Defaults to the first colour. |
| onChange? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called with the chosen swatch's CSS colour string. |
| colors? | `(string \| ColorSwatch)[]` | `SWATCHES` | The palette. Plain strings are named by their value, so prefer `{ value, label }` for readable names. |
| label? | `string` | `"Color"` | Accessible name for the group. Defaults to "Color". |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| name? | `string` |  | Submits the chosen colour string in a hidden input under this name. No name by default. |

```tsx
const [color, setColor] = React.useState("oklch(0.52 0.12 150)")
<ColorPicker label="Label colour" value={color} onChange={setColor} />
```

### ColumnVisibilityMenu

A "Columns" button that opens a checklist of table columns to show or hide; uncontrolled unless `visible` is passed.

Put it in a TableToolbar above a DataTable, then filter your DataTable `columns` by the visible ids. Ids always come back in column order. For a full saved-view system use SavedViews.

- Name: `column-visibility-menu` (component, Tables)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/column-visibility-menu` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ColumnVisibilityMenu } from "@/components/ui/column-visibility-menu"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/column-visibility-menu"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: button, dropdown-menu
- Related: table-toolbar, data-table, saved-views
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/column-visibility-menu (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/column-visibility-menu.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| columns? | `Column[]` | `SAMPLE_COLUMNS` | Every toggleable column, in table order. |
| visible? | `string[]` |  | Controlled list of visible column ids. Leave undefined for an uncontrolled menu. |
| defaultVisible? | `string[]` |  | Initial visible ids for the uncontrolled menu. Defaults to every column. |
| onChange? | `(ids: string[]) => void` |  | Called with the visible ids, in column order, after each toggle. |
| label? | `string` | `"Columns"` | Trigger button text. Defaults to "Columns". |
| className? | `string` |  | Classes for the trigger button. |

```tsx
const [visible, setVisible] = React.useState(columns.map((c) => c.id))
<ColumnVisibilityMenu columns={columns.map((c) => ({ id: c.id, label: String(c.header) }))} visible={visible} onChange={setVisible} />
<DataTable columns={columns.filter((c) => visible.includes(c.id))} data={rows} />
```

### Combobox

A select-style button that opens a searchable list: type to filter, arrow keys to move, Enter to pick. Built on Base UI Combobox.

Use when a single choice has more than about 7 options (customers, assignees, countries). For a short fixed list use Select; for several choices use MultiSelect; for free text with suggestions use Autocomplete. Uncontrolled unless `value` is passed. Label it with FormField (pass the same `id` to both) or `aria-label`.

- Name: `combobox` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/combobox` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Combobox } from "@/components/ui/combobox"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/combobox"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react, lucide-react
- Related: select, multi-select, autocomplete, label, form-field, assign-picker, country-select, language-picker
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/combobox (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/combobox.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| items? | `Item[]` | `SAMPLE_ITEMS` | Options. `value` must be unique; `label` is shown and searched. |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled selection (an item's `value`). Leave undefined for an uncontrolled combobox. |
| defaultValue? | `string` |  | Initial selection for the uncontrolled combobox. |
| onChange? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called with the picked item's `value`. |
| placeholder? | `string` | `"Select…"` | Trigger text while nothing is selected. |
| searchPlaceholder? | `string` | `"Filter…"` | Placeholder of the search field inside the popup. Defaults to "Filter…". |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |
| className? | `string` |  | Classes for the trigger button (width defaults to w-64). |
| emptyText? | `string` | `"No results"` | Shown when the filter matches nothing. |
| id? | `string` |  | Id for the trigger, so a `<label htmlFor>` or FormField can name it. |
| name? | `string` |  | Submits the selected `value` under this name inside a `<form>`. |
| required? | `boolean` |  | Requires a selection before the form submits. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name when there is no visible label. |
| aria-describedby? | `string` |  | Ids of the hint or error text. FormField passes this in for you. |
| aria-invalid? | `React.AriaAttributes["aria-invalid"]` |  | Marks the trigger invalid and draws the danger border. FormField sets it when there is an `error`. |

```tsx
const [customer, setCustomer] = React.useState("northwind")
<FormField id="customer" label="Customer">
  <Combobox id="customer" items={[{ value: "northwind", label: "Northwind Traders" }]} value={customer} onChange={setCustomer} />
</FormField>
```

### CommandDialog

A command palette in a dialog; uncontrolled with its own "Search commands" trigger unless `open` is passed.

A thin wrapper over CommandPalette with a plain outline trigger and no ⌘K listener. Prefer CommandPalette directly when you want the ⌘K shortcut or a custom trigger. Commands take `id`, `label`, optional `keywords`, `shortcut` and `onSelect`.

- Name: `command-dialog` (component, Overlays)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/command-dialog` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CommandDialog } from "@/components/ui/command-dialog"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/command-dialog"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: button, command-palette
- Related: command-palette, command-item, command-center
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/command-dialog (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/command-dialog.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| open? | `boolean` |  | Controlled open state. Leave undefined to get a built-in trigger button and internal state. |
| onOpenChange? | `(o: boolean) => void` |  | Called with the next open state. |
| commands? | `Command[]` | `SAMPLE_COMMANDS` | Commands to search; same shape as CommandPalette's. |

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false)
<CommandDialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} commands={[{ id: "new", label: "New invoice", onSelect: createInvoice }]} />
```

### CommandItem

One row of a command list: an optional icon, a label and an optional keyboard shortcut hint.

Use to build your own command or action list. For a ready-made searchable palette use CommandPalette (or CommandDialog for a trigger + dialog); for "/" commands in an editor use SlashCommandMenu. `active` marks the keyboard-highlighted row.

- Name: `command-item` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/command-item` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CommandItem } from "@/components/ui/command-item"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/command-item"`)
- Related: command-palette, command-dialog, slash-command-menu
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/command-item (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/command-item.md)

Props (also accepts <button>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `React.ReactNode` |  | The command label. |
| shortcut? | `string` |  | Shortcut hint shown at the row's end, e.g. "⌘N". Display only; bind the key yourself. |
| active? | `boolean` |  | Highlighted state, for the row the keyboard is on. |
| icon? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Leading icon, sized to 16px. |
| onSelect? | `() => void` |  | Runs when the row is clicked or activated with Enter/Space. |

```tsx
<CommandItem icon={<FilePlusIcon />} shortcut="⌘N" onSelect={createInvoice}>New invoice</CommandItem>
```

### CommandPalette

A searchable command dialog: type to filter, arrow keys to move, Enter to run, opened from a trigger button or ⌘K / Ctrl+K.

Use as the app-wide "do anything" launcher. Uncontrolled it renders its own trigger and listens for ⌘K; pass `open` + `onOpenChange` to launch it from your own button or shortcut. For a ready trigger-plus-dialog pair use CommandDialog; for one row use CommandItem; for "/" commands inside an editor use SlashCommandMenu. Follows the APG combobox-with-listbox pattern.

- Name: `command-palette` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/command-palette` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CommandPalette } from "@/components/ui/command-palette"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/command-palette"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: button, dialog, kbd
- Related: command-dialog, command-item, slash-command-menu, dropdown-menu, search-input, search-with-results, shortcut-cheat-sheet, command-center
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/command-palette (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/command-palette.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| open? | `boolean` |  | Controlled open state. Omit it and the palette manages itself: it renders a trigger and listens for ⌘K / Ctrl+K. |
| onOpenChange? | `(open: boolean) => void` |  | Called with the next open state (Escape, outside click, after running a command). |
| commands? | `Command[]` | `SAMPLE_COMMANDS` | Commands to search. Defaults to a set of Lumen actions. |
| trigger? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Rendered when the palette is uncontrolled. Defaults to a search button with a ⌘K hint. |
| placeholder? | `string` | `"Type a command…"` | Search field placeholder. Defaults to "Type a command…". |
| emptyText? | `string` | `"No commands"` | Shown when nothing matches. Defaults to "No commands". |

```tsx
<CommandPalette
  commands={[
    { id: "new-invoice", label: "Create invoice", shortcut: "⌘N", onSelect: () => router.push("/invoices/new") },
    { id: "theme", label: "Toggle dark mode", keywords: ["theme", "light"], onSelect: toggleTheme },
  ]}
/>
```

### CommentComposer

A comment box: a textarea and a submit button that stays disabled until there is text. ⌘/Ctrl+Enter submits.

Use under a CommentThread or on an issue, invoice or review page. For an AI chat input use PromptInput or AiComposer; for @mentions use MentionInput. It hands you the trimmed text and clears once `onSubmit` returns, or once its promise resolves. A rejected promise keeps the text so people can try again.

- Name: `comment-composer` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/comment-composer` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CommentComposer } from "@/components/ui/comment-composer"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/comment-composer"`)
- Uses: button, textarea
- Related: comment-thread, prompt-input, ai-composer, mention-input
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/comment-composer (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/comment-composer.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onSubmit? | `(value: string) => void \| Promise<void>` |  | Called with the trimmed text when the user submits. Return a promise to clear only after it resolves; a rejection keeps the text. |
| placeholder? | `string` | `"Add a comment…"` |  |
| label? | `string` | `"Comment"` | Accessible name for the textarea. Defaults to "Comment". |
| submitLabel? | `string` | `"Comment"` | Submit button text. Defaults to "Comment". |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<CommentComposer onSubmit={(text) => api.comments.create({ body: text })} submitLabel="Reply" />
```

Use on issues, invoices, reviews and docs. Pair with CommentComposer underneath to add replies. For chat between a person and an AI use ChatThread; for a system event log use ActivityFeed or AuditTrail.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| comments? | `Comment[]` | `SAMPLE_COMMENTS` | Comments in display order. Defaults to a short Lumen thread. |
| label? | `string` | `"Comments"` | Accessible name for the list. Defaults to "Comments". |

```tsx
<CommentThread comments={[{ id: "c1", author: "Maya Chen", body: "Sent the reminder.", time: "2h ago" }]} />
```

### CommitRow

One git commit as a list row: author avatar, message, author and relative time, the short SHA and a copy button.

Stack several inside a bordered container for a commit history on deploy, release or PR screens. For CI status per commit add a CheckRunList; for a code change view use DiffView.

- Name: `commit-row` (component, Dev tools)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/commit-row` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CommitRow } from "@/components/ui/commit-row"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/commit-row"`)
- Uses: avatar, copy-button, relative-time
- Related: stack, check-run-list, diff-view, engineering-console
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/commit-row (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/commit-row.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| sha? | `string` | `"a1b2c3d"` | Short SHA, shown and copied as is. |
| message? | `string` | `"Raise Premium motion bar"` | Commit subject line; truncates to one line. |
| author? | `string` | `"Aman"` | Author display name. Initials are derived for the avatar. |
| date? | `string \| Date` |  | Commit time (ISO string or Date). Pass a fixed value from your data so server and client render the same. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<CommitRow sha="f90e1ab" message="Fix invoice rounding" author="Maya Chen" date="2026-11-12T09:30:00Z" />
```

### ComparisonTable

A feature-by-plan matrix: one row per feature, a check, a dash or a value per plan.

Use under pricing cards to compare plans in detail. For the plan cards themselves use PricingTable or PlanCard; for comparing AI models use ModelCompare. Checks and dashes carry screen-reader text ("Included" / "Not included").

- Name: `comparison-table` (component, Billing)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/comparison-table` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ComparisonTable } from "@/components/ui/comparison-table"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/comparison-table"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Related: pricing-table, plan-card, model-compare
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/comparison-table (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/comparison-table.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| features? | `string[]` | `SAMPLE_FEATURES` | Row labels, in order. Each plan's `values` line up with them by index. |
| plans? | `Plan[]` | `SAMPLE_PLANS` | Columns. A boolean renders a check or a dash, a string renders as text. |
| featureLabel? | `string` | `"Feature"` | Visible heading of the first column. Defaults to "Feature". |
| caption? | `string` | `"Plan comparison"` | Table caption for screen readers, e.g. "Plan comparison". |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<ComparisonTable
  features={["Seats", "Audit log"]}
  plans={[{ name: "Starter", values: ["2", false] }, { name: "Scale", values: ["Unlimited", true] }]}
/>
```

### ConfirmDestructive

A ready-made "are you sure?" flow: a red trigger button that opens an alert dialog with Cancel and a destructive Confirm.

Drop it in wherever one destructive action needs a confirmation step. Pass `open` and `onOpenChange` to open it from a menu item instead. Both buttons close the dialog; `onConfirm` runs on Confirm. Focus starts inside, Escape cancels, and focus returns to the trigger. For custom layouts compose AlertDialog yourself; for type-the-name confirmation use DeleteAccountConfirm; for a settings section use DangerZone.

- Name: `confirm-destructive` (component, Overlays)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/confirm-destructive` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ConfirmDestructive } from "@/components/ui/confirm-destructive"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/confirm-destructive"`)
- Uses: alert-dialog, button
- Related: alert-dialog, delete-account-confirm, danger-zone
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/confirm-destructive (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/confirm-destructive.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| triggerLabel? | `string` | `"Delete"` | Text of the red trigger button. Defaults to "Delete". Not used when `open` is set. |
| title? | `string` | `"Are you sure?"` | Dialog title, phrased as the question. |
| description? | `string` | `"This action cannot be undone."` | The consequence, read when the dialog opens. |
| confirmLabel? | `string` | `"Confirm"` | Confirm button text. Defaults to "Confirm"; prefer the verb, e.g. "Delete invoice". |
| cancelLabel? | `string` | `"Cancel"` | Cancel button text. Defaults to "Cancel". |
| onConfirm? | `() => void` |  | Runs when Confirm is pressed, before the dialog closes. |
| open? | `boolean` |  | Controlled open state. When set, the red trigger is not rendered, so open it from your own button or menu item. |
| onOpenChange? | `(open: boolean) => void` |  | Called with the next open state. |

```tsx
<ConfirmDestructive triggerLabel="Delete invoice" title="Delete INV-2041?" description="This cannot be undone." confirmLabel="Delete" onConfirm={remove} />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| provider | `string` |  | Provider name, e.g. "GitHub". |
| account | `string` |  | The linked account, e.g. an email or handle. |
| icon? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Leading logo or icon, sized to 20px. |
| onDisconnect? | `() => void` |  | Runs when Disconnect is pressed. Confirm first if unlinking loses data. |

### ContextChip

A small toggle chip for adding context to an AI prompt (a file, a page, a selection), shown pressed when active.

Use in a row above PromptInput to let people switch context sources on and off. It is a toggle button (`aria-pressed`). For an attached item with a remove button use ContextPill; for suggested prompts use SuggestionChips; for filters use ChipFilter.

- Name: `context-chip` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/context-chip` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ContextChip } from "@/components/ui/context-chip"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/context-chip"`)
- Related: prompt-input, context-pill, suggestion-chips, chip-filter, user-chip
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/context-chip (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/context-chip.md)

Props (also accepts <button>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| active? | `boolean` |  | Pressed state. When defined the chip announces as a toggle button. |

```tsx
<ContextChip active={useFile} onClick={() => setUseFile((v) => !v)}>invoice.pdf</ContextChip>
```

### ContextMenu

A right-click (or long-press) menu for any surface, built on Base UI: opens at the pointer, arrow keys move, Enter runs, Escape closes.

Wrap a row, card or canvas item and pass `items`; each runs its `onSelect` and closes the menu. Mark irreversible actions `destructive`. Always offer the same actions somewhere visible (a DropdownMenu or row actions) since right-click is hidden from many users. For a menu opened by a button use DropdownMenu.

- Name: `context-menu` (component, Overlays)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/context-menu` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ContextMenu } from "@/components/ui/context-menu"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/context-menu"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react
- Related: dropdown-menu
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/context-menu (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/context-menu.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `React.ReactNode` |  | The surface that opens the menu on right-click or long-press. |
| items | `ContextMenuItem[]` |  | Menu entries in order. `id` must be unique. |
| className? | `string` |  | Classes for the wrapping trigger element. |

```tsx
<ContextMenu items={[{ id: "rename", label: "Rename", shortcut: "F2" }, { id: "delete", label: "Delete", destructive: true, onSelect: remove }]}>
  <FileRow name="Q3-report.pdf" />
</ContextMenu>
```

### ContextPill

A rounded pill naming one item attached to an AI prompt (a file, a URL, a selection), with an optional remove button.

Show a row of them above or inside PromptInput for the context the model will see. Pass `onRemove` to make it dismissible. For on/off context toggles use ContextChip; for attached files with a size use AttachmentChip; for a removable tag use TagsInput.

- Name: `context-pill` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/context-pill` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ContextPill } from "@/components/ui/context-pill"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/context-pill"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Related: prompt-input, context-chip, attachment-chip, tags-input, citation-chip
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/context-pill (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/context-pill.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `React.ReactNode` |  | The item's name; truncates when long. |
| icon? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Leading icon, sized to 12px. |
| onRemove? | `() => void` |  | Shows a remove button that calls this. |
| removeLabel? | `string` |  | Accessible name of the remove button. Defaults to "Remove <children>" when children is text. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<ContextPill icon={<FileTextIcon />} onRemove={() => detach("invoice.pdf")}>invoice.pdf</ContextPill>
```

### ConversationSidebar

A chat app's conversation list: a new-chat button on top, then titled threads with their last activity.

Use as the left rail of an AI chat screen next to ChatThread. Uncontrolled unless `activeId` is passed; the active thread gets `aria-current`. For general app navigation use Sidebar or CollapsibleSidebar.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |

| items? | `Conv[]` |  | Conversations, newest first. Defaults to a few Lumen threads timed relative to now. |
| activeId? | `string` |  | Controlled active conversation. |

```tsx
<ConversationSidebar items={threads} activeId={threadId} onSelect={setThreadId} onNew={startThread} />
```

### CookieBanner

A floating cookie-consent card fixed to the bottom-right, with Reject and Accept buttons of equal reach.

Render it only until the visitor chooses, and store the choice yourself (cookie or localStorage) in `onAccept` / `onReject`. It is a labelled, non-modal region, so the page stays usable. Pass `className="static"` to place it inline. For a site-wide notice bar use AnnouncementBar; for a blocking choice use AlertDialog.

- Name: `cookie-banner` (component, Landing pages)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/cookie-banner` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CookieBanner } from "@/components/ui/cookie-banner"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/cookie-banner"`)
- Uses: button
- Related: announcement-bar, alert-dialog
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/cookie-banner (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/cookie-banner.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onAccept? | `() => void` |  | Called when the visitor accepts non-essential cookies. |
| onReject? | `() => void` |  | Called when the visitor rejects non-essential cookies. |
| children? | `React.ReactNode` | `"We use cookies for analytics and pre...` | The message. Defaults to a one-line analytics and preferences notice. |
| policyHref? | `string` |  | Link to your cookie or privacy policy, shown after the message. |
| acceptLabel? | `string` | `"Accept"` | Accept button text. Defaults to "Accept". |
| rejectLabel? | `string` | `"Reject"` | Reject button text. Defaults to "Reject". |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
{!consent && <CookieBanner onAccept={() => save("all")} onReject={() => save("essential")} policyHref="/privacy" />}
```

### CopyButton

A Button that copies `value` to the clipboard and flips to a check and "Copied" for 1.5s, announced to screen readers.

Use beside API keys, links, install commands and ids. Takes every Button variant and size. For a monospace id that is itself the button use CopyId; for a whole snippet use CodeBlock (it has its own copy button).

- Name: `copy-button` (component, Buttons)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/copy-button` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

| label? | `string` | `"Copy"` | Button text at rest. Defaults to "Copy". |
| copiedLabel? | `string` | `"Copied"` | Button text after a successful copy. Defaults to "Copied". |
| onCopy? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called after the text is on the clipboard. |

```tsx
<CopyButton value="npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/button.json" label="Copy command" />
```

### CopyId

A small monospace chip showing an id (user, invoice, request) that copies it on click.

### CountrySelect

A searchable country picker whose names come from the browser in any language, with emoji flags and no data files.

Use it for billing, shipping and sign-up forms. The value is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("US", "DE"). Search matches the start of any word in the localised or English name, or the exact two-letter code, ignoring accents. Pin the countries most of your users pick with `priority`. Built on Base UI Combobox, styled like Combobox; use Combobox for any other long list and PhoneInput for phone numbers. The `countries(locale)` helper returns the same sorted list for your own fields, such as the country column in TaxFields.

- Name: `country-select` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/country-select` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CountrySelect } from "@/components/ui/country-select"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/country-select"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react, lucide-react
- Related: combobox, phone-input, tax-fields
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/country-select (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/country-select.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled selection, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as "US". Leave undefined for an uncontrolled select. |
| defaultValue? | `string` |  | Initial code for the uncontrolled select. |
| onValueChange? | `(code: string) => void` |  | Called with the picked country's upper-case code. |
| locale? | `string` | `"en"` | BCP 47 locale for the country names and their sort order, for example "de" or "ja". |
| priority? | `string[]` | `[]` | Codes pinned in a "Suggested" group above the rest, in this order. They are not repeated below. |
| exclude? | `string[]` | `[]` | Codes to leave out, for example countries you do not ship to. |
| showFlag? | `boolean` | `true` | Show the emoji flag before each name. |
| placeholder? | `string` | `"Select country"` | Trigger text while nothing is selected. |
| searchPlaceholder? | `string` | `"Search countries…"` | Placeholder of the search field inside the popup. |
| emptyText? | `string` | `"No country found"` | Shown when the search matches nothing. |
| priorityLabel? | `string` | `"Suggested"` | Heading of the `priority` group. |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |
| id? | `string` |  | Id for the trigger, so a `<label htmlFor>` or FormField can name it. |
| name? | `string` |  | Submits the selected code under this name inside a `<form>`. |
| required? | `boolean` |  | Requires a selection before the form submits. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name when there is no visible label. |
| className? | `string` |  | Classes for the trigger button (width defaults to w-64). |

```tsx
const [country, setCountry] = React.useState("US")
<FormField id="country" label="Country">
  <CountrySelect id="country" name="country" value={country} onValueChange={setCountry} priority={["US", "GB", "CA"]} />
</FormField>
```

### CouponInput

A coupon or promo-code field with an Apply button and an inline, announced success or error message.

Use in a checkout or upgrade flow beside CheckoutSummary or OrderSummary. Validate on your server in `onApply`: return `true` for a valid code, `false` or an error string for an invalid one (a Promise works too). Enter applies; it never submits the surrounding form. Without `onApply` it runs a demo check that accepts "HAIRLINE".

- Name: `coupon-input` (component, E-commerce)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/coupon-input` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CouponInput } from "@/components/ui/coupon-input"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/coupon-input"`)
- Uses: button, input
- Related: checkout-summary, order-summary
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/coupon-input (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/coupon-input.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onApply? | `(code: string) => boolean \| string \| Promise<boolean \| string>` |  | Validates the trimmed code. Return true when valid, false or an error message when not. |
| successMessage? | `string` |  | Shown after a valid code. Defaults to "Coupon applied". |
| errorMessage? | `string` | `"Invalid code"` | Shown after an invalid code when `onApply` returns false. Defaults to "Invalid code". |
| label? | `string` | `"Coupon code"` | Input placeholder and accessible name. Defaults to "Coupon code". |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<CouponInput onApply={async (code) => (await fetch(`/api/coupons/${code}`)).ok} successMessage="20% off applied" />
```

### CoverageMeter

A labelled bar for a percentage score such as test coverage, coloured green, amber or red by thresholds.

Use on CI, repo and quality dashboards. It is a `role="meter"`, so screen readers hear the label and percent. For usage against a limit use UsageMeter or QuotaBar; for task progress use Progress.

- Name: `coverage-meter` (component, Dev tools)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/coverage-meter` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CoverageMeter } from "@/components/ui/coverage-meter"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/coverage-meter"`)
- Related: usage-meter, quota-bar, progress
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/coverage-meter (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/coverage-meter.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label? | `string` | `"Line coverage"` | What is measured. Defaults to "Line coverage". |
| value? | `number` | `86` | Percent, 0-100. Values outside are clamped. |
| good? | `number` | `80` | At or above this the bar is green. Defaults to 80. |
| warn? | `number` | `60` | At or above this (and below `good`) the bar is amber; below it, red. Defaults to 60. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<CoverageMeter label="Branch coverage" value={72} good={80} warn={60} />
```

### CreditBalance

- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/credit-balance (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/credit-balance.md)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| balance | `React.ReactNode` |  | Pre-formatted balance, e.g. "1,240" or "$18.40". |
| label? | `string` | `"Credits"` | Label before the number. Defaults to "Credits". |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<CreditBalance label="AI credits" balance={new Intl.NumberFormat().format(1240)} />
```

### CreditCardInput

Card details fields with brand-aware formatting, a Luhn check, auto-advance and inline errors; UI only, never sends card data anywhere.

The number groups by brand (Visa, Mastercard and Discover 4-4-4-4, Amex 4-6-5), the brand shows as a text badge, expiry formats to MM / YY and advances on its own, and the CVC expects 4 digits for Amex. Fields carry cc-* names and autocomplete hints and aria-invalid, and errors appear once a field is left. It formats and checks input in the browser and does not process, tokenize or transmit payments: for real payments prefer your provider's hosted fields (Stripe Elements and the like) for PCI scope, and use this for demos, prototypes or providers that accept raw values. For a saved card use PaymentMethodCard; for a full add-card flow use AddCardForm.

`onChange` receives `{ number, expiry, cvc, brand, name, postalCode, valid }`; `luhn(digits)` is exported for your own checks.

- Name: `credit-card-input` (component, Billing)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/credit-card-input` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CreditCardInput } from "@/components/ui/credit-card-input"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/credit-card-input"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react, motion
- Uses: input
- Related: card, payment-method-card, add-card-form, checkout-summary
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/credit-card-input (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/credit-card-input.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onChange? | `(value: CreditCardValue) => void` |  | Called on every edit with the parsed values. |
| defaultValue? | `Partial<Pick<CreditCardValue, "number" \| "expiry" \| "cvc" \| "name" \| "postalCode">>` | `{}` | Initial field values; `number` and `expiry` may include spaces or a slash. |
| showName? | `boolean` | `true` | Show the name on card field. |
| showPostalCode? | `boolean` | `true` | Show the postal code field. |
| showBrands? | `boolean` | `true` | Show the accepted brands, the detected one highlighted. |
| label? | `string` | `"Card details"` | Visible label of the card fields group. Defaults to "Card details". |
| hint? | `React.ReactNode` | `"Test with 4242 4242 4242 4242 and an...` | Helper line shown while there is no error. |
| disabled? | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<CreditCardInput onChange={(card) => setCanPay(card.valid)} showPostalCode={false} />
```

### CtaBanner

A full-width call-to-action band: a heading, an optional line of copy and one primary action, stacked on mobile.

Use at the end of a marketing page or section. Pass `action.href` for navigation (renders a link) or `action.onClick` for an in-page action. For a hero use Hero; for a dismissible notice use Banner or AnnouncementBar; for an in-app upsell use UpgradePrompt.

- Name: `cta-banner` (component, Landing pages)


### CurrencyInput

A money amount field with the currency code inside on the left, a decimal keypad on mobile and tabular digits.

Use for prices, invoice amounts and payouts. The value is the typed string (digits, ".", "," and "-"); parse it yourself, e.g. `Number(v.replace(/,/g, ""))`, and store minor units on the server. For a stepper with +/- use NumberInput; for quantities use QuantityStepper. Label it with FormField (same `id`) or `aria-label`; without either it is named "Amount in USD".

- Name: `currency-input` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/currency-input` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { CurrencyInput } from "@/components/ui/currency-input"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/currency-input"`)
- Uses: input
- Related: number-input, quantity-stepper, label, form-field, input-affix, input
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/currency-input (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/currency-input.md)

Props:

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled value. Leave undefined for an uncontrolled field. |
| defaultValue? | `string` |  | Initial value for the uncontrolled field. |
| onChange? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called with the sanitised string on every edit. |
| currency? | `string` | `"USD"` | ISO 4217 code shown inside the field, e.g. "USD", "EUR". Defaults to "USD". |
| placeholder? | `string` | `"0.00"` | Defaults to "0.00". |
| name? | `string` |  | Form field name for FormData. |
| required? | `boolean` |  |  |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |

| id? | `string` |  | Id for a `<label htmlFor>` or FormField. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  |  |
| aria-invalid? | `boolean` |  |  |
| aria-describedby? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx

```

### DangerZone

A red-outlined settings section for one irreversible action, whose button asks for confirmation before `onConfirm` runs.

Put it last on a settings page (delete workspace, delete project, transfer ownership). Pass `children` to replace the built-in confirm button with your own actions, such as DeleteAccountConfirm for type-the-name confirmation.

- Name: `danger-zone` (component, Settings)

- Uses: confirm-destructive

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| description? | `string` | `"Delete this workspace and every regi...` | What the action destroys. |
| actionLabel? | `string` | `"Delete workspace"` | Button and confirm text. Defaults to "Delete workspace". |
| onConfirm? | `() => void` |  | Runs after the person confirms in the dialog. |
| children? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Replaces the built-in confirm button. |

```tsx
<DangerZone
  description="Delete Northwind and all of its invoices. This cannot be undone."

```

### DataGrid

An editable spreadsheet grid: arrow keys move between cells, typing edits, and you can paste straight from Excel or Google Sheets.

Use it when people change many values in place: price lists, stock counts, budgets, bulk imports. Columns are text, number, select or checkbox. Shift+arrows select a block, Cmd/Ctrl+C copies it as tab-separated text, Cmd/Ctrl+V pastes a block from a spreadsheet and turns "1,240.50" into a number, Delete clears and Cmd/Ctrl+Z undoes. The grid is controlled: it shows `rows` and hands every edit to `onRowsChange`; without that prop it is read-only. The header and first column stay put while you scroll, and columns resize by dragging the header edge. For sorting, filtering and row selection use DataTable; to edit a single value in a read-only table use InlineCellEdit; for query output use SqlResultTable.

- Name: `data-grid` (component, Tables)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/data-grid` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { DataGrid } from "@/components/ui/data-grid"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/data-grid"`)
- Uses: checkbox, select
- Related: data-table, inline-cell-edit, sql-result-table
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/data-grid (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/data-grid.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| columns | `DataGridColumn<T>[]` |  | Column definitions, left to right. The first column stays visible while scrolling sideways. |
| rows | `T[]` |  | The rows to show. The grid never copies them: edits go to `onRowsChange`. |
| onRowsChange? | `(rows: T[]) => void` |  | Fires with a new rows array after each edit, paste, clear or undo. Leave it out for a read-only grid. |
| getRowId? | `(row: T, index: number) => string` | `(_, i) => String(i)` | Stable key for each row. Defaults to the row index. |
| rowNumbers? | `boolean` | `true` | Show a numbered column on the left. Click a number to select its row. |
| aria-label | `string` |  | Accessible name of the grid, such as "Price list". |
| className? | `string` |  | Size the scroll area here, for example `max-h-[32rem]`. |

```tsx
const [rows, setRows] = React.useState(products)
<DataGrid
  aria-label="Price list"
  rows={rows}
  onRowsChange={setRows}
  getRowId={(r) => r.sku}
  columns={[
    { key: "sku", header: "SKU", readOnly: true },
    { key: "name", header: "Product", width: 220 },
    { key: "price", header: "Price", type: "number" },
    { key: "active", header: "Active", type: "checkbox" },
  ]}
/>
```

### DataTable

A product data table: sortable headers, row selection with a bulk bar, hover row actions, sticky header, density and skeleton loading.

Use for lists of records people scan, sort and act on (invoices, users, deploys). Define `columns` once with a `cell` renderer and an optional `sortValue`; pass `data` and a stable `getRowId`. For a plain static table use Table; for 10k+ rows use VirtualizedList; for SQL output use SqlResultTable. Pair with TableToolbar, ColumnVisibilityMenu and TablePagination around it.

- Name: `data-table` (component, Tables)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/data-table` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { DataTable } from "@/components/ui/data-table"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/data-table"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: checkbox
- Related: table, virtualized-list, sql-result-table, table-toolbar, column-visibility-menu, table-pagination, admin-user-row, api-key-list
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/data-table (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/data-table.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| columns? | `Column<T>[]` | `SAMPLE_COLUMNS` | Column definitions. Defaults, with `data`, to a Lumen invoice table. |
| data? | `T[]` | `SAMPLE_ROWS` | Rows. Defaults, with `columns`, to eight sample invoices. |
| getRowId? | `(row: T, index: number) => string` | `ROW_INDEX` | Stable id per row; selection and React keys use it. Defaults to the row index, which breaks selection when data reorders, so pass one. |
| selectable? | `boolean` |  | Adds a checkbox column. |
| selected? | `string[]` |  | Controlled selected row ids. Leave undefined for internal selection. |
| onSelectedChange? | `(ids: string[]) => void` |  | Called with the selected row ids after every change. |
| bulkActions? | `(ids: string[]) => React.ReactNode` |  | Rendered in the floating bar while rows are selected. |
| rowActions? | `(row: T) => React.ReactNode` |  | Rendered at the row's end, revealed on hover/focus. |
| onRowClick? | `(row: T) => void` |  | Makes rows clickable and focusable; Enter on a focused row also fires it. |
| defaultSort? | `Sort` | `null` | Initial sort for uncontrolled sorting, e.g. { id: "amount", dir: "desc" }. |
| sort? | `Sort` |  | Controlled sort. Pass with `onSortChange`; null means unsorted. |
| onSortChange? | `(sort: Sort) => void` |  | Called when a header is clicked: asc, then desc, then null. |
| density? | `Density` | `"default"` | Row height: compact 36px, default 44px, comfortable 56px. |
| loading? | `boolean` |  | Shows five skeleton rows instead of data and sets aria-busy. |
| maxHeight? | `number \| string` |  | Fixes the height and makes the header sticky. |
| empty? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Shown when `data` is empty. Defaults to "No results". |
| caption? | `string` |  | Screen-reader caption that names the table. Strongly recommended. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
const columns: Column<Invoice>[] = [
  { id: "customer", header: "Customer", cell: (r) => r.customer, sortValue: (r) => r.customer },
  { id: "amount", header: "Amount", align: "right", cell: (r) => money(r.amount), sortValue: (r) => r.amount },
]
<DataTable columns={columns} data={invoices} getRowId={(r) => r.id} selectable caption="Invoices"
  bulkActions={(ids) => <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => archive(ids)}>Archive</Button>} />
```

### DatePicker

A date field on the browser's native date input: a localised format, a built-in calendar popup and full keyboard and screen-reader support for free.

The value is an ISO date string ("2026-11-14"), so store, compare (`a < b`) and send it as is. Uncontrolled unless `value` is passed; set the value to "" to clear. Use `min` / `max` to bound it. For a start-end pair use DateRangePicker; for times use TimePicker; for an always-visible month grid use CalendarMonth. Label it with FormField (same `id`) or `aria-label`.

- Name: `date-picker` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/date-picker` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { DatePicker } from "@/components/ui/date-picker"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/date-picker"`)
- Uses: input
- Related: date-range-picker, time-picker, calendar-month, label, form-field, calendar, date-time-picker
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/date-picker (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/date-picker.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled ISO date ("YYYY-MM-DD"), or "" for empty. Leave undefined for an uncontrolled field. |
| defaultValue? | `string` | `""` | Initial ISO date for the uncontrolled field. |
| onChange? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called with the ISO date string, or "" when cleared. |
| min? | `string` |  | Earliest selectable ISO date. |
| max? | `string` |  | Latest selectable ISO date. |
| name? | `string` |  | Form field name for FormData. |
| required? | `boolean` |  |  |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| id? | `string` |  | Id for a `<label htmlFor>` or FormField. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  |  |
| aria-invalid? | `boolean` |  |  |
| aria-describedby? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
const [due, setDue] = React.useState("2026-11-14")
<FormField id="due" label="Due date"><DatePicker id="due" value={due} onChange={setDue} min="2026-11-01" /></FormField>
```

### DateRangePicker

A start and end date as two native date inputs in one labelled group.

Use for from/to filters, reporting periods and bookings. For a single date use `DatePicker`; for a visible month grid use `CalendarMonth`. Dates are ISO day strings ("2026-11-14"), the format `<input type="date">` uses.

- Name: `date-range-picker` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/date-range-picker` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { DateRangePicker } from "@/components/ui/date-range-picker"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/date-range-picker"`)
- Uses: date-picker
- Related: date-picker, calendar-month, calendar, report-builder
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/date-range-picker (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/date-range-picker.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `DateRange` |  | Controlled range. Leave out to let the picker hold its own state. |
| defaultValue? | `DateRange` |  | Initial range when uncontrolled. |
| onChange? | `(value: DateRange) => void` |  | Called with the whole range whenever either end changes. |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| fromId? | `string` |  | Id for the start input, to point an external <label> at it. |
| toId? | `string` |  | Id for the end input. |
| fromName? | `string` |  | Form field name for the start date, so FormData includes it. No name by default. |
| toName? | `string` |  | Form field name for the end date. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name for the group. |

```tsx
const [range, setRange] = React.useState<DateRange>({ from: "2026-11-01", to: "2026-11-30" })
<DateRangePicker value={range} onChange={setRange} />
<DateRangePicker fromName="from" toName="to" /> // submits both days with a <form>
```

### DateTimePicker

One field for a date and a time: a calendar and a time list in a popover, with past times disabled on today.

Use it for meetings, scheduled sends, deploy windows and deadlines, anywhere a single moment matters. The value is a `Date` (or `null` when empty). Pass `min={new Date()}` to block past days and the past slots of today; slots are `minuteStep` minutes apart. The trigger shows the value through `Intl.DateTimeFormat` (medium date, short time), and the time list follows the locale's 12 or 24 hour clock unless `hour12` is set. Pass `name` to submit it with a form as an ISO string. For a date alone use Calendar or DatePicker; for a time alone use TimePicker.

- Name: `date-time-picker` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/date-time-picker` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { DateTimePicker } from "@/components/ui/date-time-picker"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/date-time-picker"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: button, calendar, popover
- Related: calendar, date-picker, time-picker
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/date-time-picker (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/date-time-picker.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `Date \| null` |  | Controlled value, or `null` for empty. |
| defaultValue? | `Date \| null` | `null` | Starting value when uncontrolled. |
| onValueChange? | `(value: Date \| null) => void` |  | Fires with the new Date, or `null` after Clear. |
| minuteStep? | `5 \| 15 \| 30` | `15` | Minutes between time slots. |
| hour12? | `boolean` |  | Force a 12 or 24 hour clock. Defaults to the locale's clock. |
| min? | `Date` |  | Earliest moment. Days before it and earlier slots on its day are disabled. |
| max? | `Date` |  | Latest moment. Days after it and later slots on its day are disabled. |
| disabled? | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the trigger. |
| placeholder? | `string` | `"Pick a date and time"` | Trigger text while empty. |
| timeZoneLabel? | `string` |  | Time zone note in the popover footer, such as "Times in Europe/Berlin". |
| locale? | `string` | `"en-US"` | BCP 47 locale for the trigger, the calendar and the time labels. |
| weekStartsOn? | `0 \| 1` | `0` | First column of the calendar week: 0 is Sunday, 1 is Monday. |
| name? | `string` |  | Form field name. Submits the value as an ISO 8601 string in UTC, or "" when empty. |
| id? | `string` |  | Id for a `<label htmlFor>` or FormField. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | What the moment is for, such as "Send at". The value is appended to it. |

```tsx
const [when, setWhen] = React.useState<Date | null>(null)
<DateTimePicker value={when} onValueChange={setWhen} min={new Date()} minuteStep={30} timeZoneLabel="Europe/Berlin" aria-label="Send at" />
```

### DensityToggle

A two-option Compact / Comfortable switch for table and list row density.

Use in a `TableToolbar` or view menu to let people fit more rows on screen. It always keeps one option pressed. `DataTable` takes "compact", "default" or "comfortable", so pass the value through or map "comfortable" to "default". For other short option sets use `SegmentedControl`; for on/off settings use `Switch`.

- Name: `density-toggle` (component, Tables)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/density-toggle` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

- Related: table-toolbar, data-table, segmented-control, switch

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `"compact" \| "comfortable"` |  | Controlled density. |
| defaultValue? | `"compact" \| "comfortable"` | `"comfortable"` | Initial density when uncontrolled. |
| onChange? | `(value: "compact" \| "comfortable") => void` |  | Called with the newly chosen density. Never called with an empty selection. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<DensityToggle value={density} onChange={setDensity} />
```

### Dialog

A modal window on a scrim: focus is trapped inside, Escape and the close button dismiss it, focus returns to the trigger.

Compose it from parts. Use for short forms and focused tasks that block the page. For "are you sure?" confirmations use `AlertDialog`; for side panels use `Sheet`; for a bottom sheet on mobile use `Drawer`; for non-modal content anchored to a button use `Popover`. Always render a `DialogTitle` (and ideally a `DialogDescription`) so the dialog has an accessible name.

Controlled: `<Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>`.

- Name: `dialog` (component, Overlays)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/dialog` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogOverlay, DialogPortal, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger } from "@/components/ui/dialog"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/dialog"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react, lucide-react
- Uses: button
- Related: alert-dialog, sheet, drawer, popover, cancel-flow, image-lightbox, inline-cell-edit, mobile-action-sheet
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/dialog (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/dialog.md)

Props: DialogPrimitive.Root props.

```tsx
<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" />}>Edit invoice</DialogTrigger>
  <DialogContent>
    <DialogHeader>
      <DialogTitle>Edit invoice</DialogTitle>
      <DialogDescription>Changes are saved to INV-2041.</DialogDescription>
    </DialogHeader>
    ...fields
    <DialogFooter showCloseButton>
      <Button>Save</Button>
    </DialogFooter>
  </DialogContent>
</Dialog>
```

### DiffView

A unified diff of one file: added lines tinted success, removed lines tinted danger, context muted.

Use to show a code or config change in a review, a deploy or an agent's proposed edit. For a single-line before/after use `InlineCodeDiff`; for plain code use `CodeBlock`. Screen readers hear "added" or "removed" before each changed line.

- Name: `diff-view` (component, Dev tools)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/diff-view` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { DiffView } from "@/components/ui/diff-view"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/diff-view"`)
- Related: inline-code-diff, code-block, commit-row
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/diff-view (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/diff-view.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| lines | `DiffLine[]` |  | Lines in display order. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| filename? | `string` |  | File path shown in the header bar and used in the region's accessible name. |

```tsx
<DiffView
  filename="lib/billing.ts"
  lines={[
    { type: "ctx", text: "export function total(items) {" },
    { type: "del", text: "  return sum(items)" },
    { type: "add", text: "  return sum(items) + tax(items)" },
    { type: "ctx", text: "}" },
  ]}
/>
```

### DonutChart

A single value as a ring filled to a percentage of `max`, with the percentage in the centre.

Use for one ratio at a glance (storage used, goal reached). For several slices use `PieChart`; for concentric rings use `RadialChart`; for a half dial use `GaugeChart`; for a labelled linear bar use `Meter` or `Progress`.

- Name: `donut-chart` (component, Charts)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/donut-chart` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { DonutChart } from "@/components/ui/donut-chart"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/donut-chart"`)
- Related: pie-chart, radial-chart, gauge-chart, meter, progress, heatmap-cell, horizontal-bar-chart
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/donut-chart (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/donut-chart.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `number` |  | Current value, clamped to 0..max. |
| max? | `number` | `100` | Value that fills the ring. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| label? | `string` | `"Donut"` | What the value measures. Used in the accessible name, e.g. "Seats used: 68%". |

```tsx
<DonutChart value={68} label="Seats used" />
<DonutChart value={3.4} max={5} label="Storage, GB" />
```

### DowngradeWarning

An inline card that spells out what a plan downgrade removes, with keep and downgrade actions.

Use on a billing page before a plan change. For a multi-step cancellation use `CancelFlow`; for a modal confirmation use `AlertDialog`; to sell an upgrade instead use `UpgradePrompt`.

- Name: `downgrade-warning` (component, Billing)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/downgrade-warning` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { DowngradeWarning } from "@/components/ui/downgrade-warning"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/downgrade-warning"`)
- Uses: button
- Related: cancel-flow, alert-dialog, upgrade-prompt
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/downgrade-warning (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/downgrade-warning.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title? | `React.ReactNode` | `"Downgrade to Free?"` | Heading of the card. |
| description? | `React.ReactNode` | `"Kinetic heroes, the client showcase ...` | What the user loses by downgrading. |
| keepLabel? | `string` | `"Keep Premium"` | Label of the safe (outline) action. |
| downgradeLabel? | `string` | `"Downgrade"` | Label of the destructive action. |
| onKeep? | `() => void` |  | Called by the safe action. |
| onDowngrade? | `() => void` |  | Called by the destructive action. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<DowngradeWarning
  title="Downgrade to Starter?"
  description="Audit logs and SSO turn off at the end of this billing period."
  onKeep={() => router.back()}
  onDowngrade={() => downgrade("starter")}
/>
```

### Drawer

A bottom sheet for quick actions and mobile forms: a Sheet that slides up from the bottom edge.

Uncontrolled, it renders its own trigger button, or the element you pass as `trigger`, wired to open it. Controlled, pass `open` and `onClose` and render your own trigger. For a side panel use `Sheet`; for a centred modal use `Dialog`; for an iOS style action list use `MobileActionSheet`.

- Name: `drawer` (component, Overlays)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/drawer` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Drawer } from "@/components/ui/drawer"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/drawer"`)
- Uses: button, sheet
- Related: sheet, dialog, mobile-action-sheet
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/drawer (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/drawer.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| open? | `boolean` |  | Controlled open state. Leave it out and the drawer renders its own "Open drawer" button. |
| onClose? | `() => void` |  | Called when the drawer asks to close (Escape, scrim click, close button). |
| side? | `"left" \| "right" \| "top" \| "bottom"` | `"bottom"` | Edge the drawer slides from. |
| title? | `string` |  | Title in the drawer's header bar. |
| children? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Drawer content. Defaults to a Lumen invoice action list. |
| trigger? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Element that opens the drawer when it is uncontrolled; its own onClick still runs. Defaults to an "Open drawer" button. |
| className? | `string` |  | Extra classes for the panel. |

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false)
<Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Invoice actions</Button>
<Drawer open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="Invoice INV-2041">
  ...actions
</Drawer>
```

### DropdownMenu

A menu that opens from a trigger: items with shortcuts, labels, separators, checkbox and radio items, and nested submenus.

Built on Base UI Menu: arrow keys move, typeahead jumps, Escape closes and focus returns to the trigger. Use for action menus on a button. For a right-click menu use `ContextMenu`; for an app menu bar use `Menubar`; to pick one value in a form use `Select`; for searchable commands use `CommandPalette`. With no children it renders a sample account menu.

- Name: `dropdown-menu` (component, Overlays)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/dropdown-menu` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { DropdownMenu } from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/dropdown-menu"`)
- Exports: DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuPortal, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuShortcut, DropdownMenuSub, DropdownMenuSubTrigger, DropdownMenuSubContent
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react, lucide-react
- Uses: button
- Related: context-menu, menubar, select, command-palette, admin-user-row, breadcrumb-ellipsis, mobile-action-sheet, popover
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/dropdown-menu (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/dropdown-menu.md)

Props: MenuPrimitive.Root props.

```tsx
<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" />}>Options</DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent>
    <DropdownMenuItem onClick={edit}>Edit<DropdownMenuShortcut>⌘E</DropdownMenuShortcut></DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuItem variant="destructive" onClick={remove}>Delete</DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
```

### DueDateChip

A small calendar chip for a task or invoice due date, with a danger edge when overdue.

Use inside issue cards, table cells and list rows. For a relative time ("3 days ago") use `RelativeTime`; for a general status label use `StatusBadge`. The overdue state is announced to screen readers, not only shown in colour.

- Name: `due-date-chip` (component, Workflow)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/due-date-chip` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { DueDateChip } from "@/components/ui/due-date-chip"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/due-date-chip"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Related: relative-time, status-badge, workflow-board
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/due-date-chip (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/due-date-chip.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| date | `string` |  | Display text for the date, already formatted, e.g. "Nov 30". |
| overdue? | `boolean` |  | Mark the date as past due. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<DueDateChip date="Nov 30" />
<DueDateChip date="Oct 2" overdue />
```

### EditableHeading

A page or document title that is itself a text input, styled as a heading.

Use for click-to-rename titles (documents, projects, dashboards). Enter commits and leaves the field, Escape restores the text from when editing began. For an editable table cell use `InlineCellEdit`; for a labelled form field use `Input` inside `FormField`.

- Name: `editable-heading` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/editable-heading` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { EditableHeading } from "@/components/ui/editable-heading"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/editable-heading"`)
- Related: inline-cell-edit, input, form-field
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/editable-heading (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/editable-heading.md)

Props (also accepts <input>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled text. |
| defaultValue? | `string` | `""` | Initial text when uncontrolled. |
| onChange? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called with the new text on every keystroke (and on Escape revert). |
| placeholder? | `string` | `"Untitled"` | Shown when empty. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name. Defaults to "Title". |

```tsx
const [title, setTitle] = React.useState("Q4 revenue review")
<EditableHeading value={title} onChange={setTitle} aria-label="Report title" />
```

### EmailButton

It is an <a>, because email clients follow links, not buttons. Use one per email inside `EmailLayout`. For buttons in the app use `Button`.

| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<EmailButton href="https://app.example.com/invoices/2041">View invoice</EmailButton>
```

### EmailCard

A bordered content block inside an email body, with an optional title.

Use inside `EmailLayout` to group a receipt summary, a sign-in code or a callout. It has `mx-6 my-4` built in to line up with `EmailHeader` and `EmailFooter`, so place it directly in the layout, not inside another padded block. For the call to action use `EmailButton`; for cards in the app use `Card`.

- Name: `email-card` (component, Email)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/email-card` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title? | `string` |  | Heading of the block. |
| children | `React.ReactNode` |  | Body text or markup. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<EmailCard title="Invoice INV-2041">$12,400.00 due Nov 30.</EmailCard>
```

### EmailFooter

### EmailHeader

The top band of an email template with the sender's brand name.

Use as the first child of `EmailLayout`, above the body and any `EmailCard`. Pass `children` to replace the brand text with a logo image (absolute URL, fixed width and height, and `alt` set to the brand name). Its 24px side padding lines up with `EmailCard` and `EmailFooter`.

- Name: `email-header` (component, Email)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/email-header` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brand? | `string` | `"MiniDev"` | Brand name shown when no children are passed. |
| children? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Custom content, such as a logo image. Replaces the brand text. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

