### Link

An inline text link in the accent text colour, underlined on hover, with a visible focus ring.

Use it for navigation in running text and help copy. For an action styled as a link use Button with variant="link"; for a link that looks like a button use Button with render={<a href="…" />}; for "back" navigation use BackLink. With target="_blank" it adds rel="noopener noreferrer" unless you pass rel. It renders a plain <a>; for client-side routing use your router's link with the same classes.

- Name: `link` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/link` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Link } from "@/components/ui/link"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/link"`)
- Related: button, back-link
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/link (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/link.md)

Props: <a>.

```tsx
<Link href="/docs/billing">Billing docs</Link>
```

### ListItem

One row of a list: optional leading visual, a heading with an optional description, and optional trailing content.

Use it inside a bordered list or card for settings rows, people, files and search results. It renders a div; put it in an li when the parent is a ul. For a notification use NotificationItem, for a team member with a role use TeamMemberRow, and for a file use FileRow.

- Name: `list-item` (component, Layout)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/list-item` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ListItem } from "@/components/ui/list-item"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/list-item"`)
- Related: notification-item, team-member-row, file-row
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/list-item (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/list-item.md)

Props (also accepts <div>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| heading | `React.ReactNode` |  | Main line, truncated to one line. |
| description? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Secondary line under the heading, truncated. |
| leading? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Visual before the text: an avatar, icon or checkbox. |
| trailing? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Content after the text: a badge, value, menu or button. |

```tsx
<ListItem leading={<Avatar>…</Avatar>} heading="Maya Chen" description="Finance lead" trailing={<Badge>Owner</Badge>} />
```

### LoadingOverlay

A translucent layer with a spinner and label that covers its positioned parent while it refreshes.

Put it inside a relative container (a card, a table) while data reloads, so the stale content stays visible underneath. For a first load with no content yet use Skeleton or LoadingTable; for an inline wait use Spinner.

- Name: `loading-overlay` (component, Feedback)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/loading-overlay` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { LoadingOverlay } from "@/components/ui/loading-overlay"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/loading-overlay"`)
- Uses: spinner
- Related: skeleton, loading-table, spinner
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/loading-overlay (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/loading-overlay.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label? | `string` | `"Loading"` | Visible text and the status message read by screen readers. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<div className="relative">
  <InvoiceList items={items} />
  {isFetching ? <LoadingOverlay label="Refreshing" /> : null}
</div>
```

### LoadingTable

A skeleton table (header plus rows of shimmering cells) shown while table data loads for the first time.

Match rows and cols to the real table to avoid layout shift. For an empty result use EmptyTable, for refreshing a table that already has data use LoadingOverlay, and for any other shape use Skeleton.

- Name: `loading-table` (component, Tables)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/loading-table` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { LoadingTable } from "@/components/ui/loading-table"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/loading-table"`)
- Uses: skeleton
- Related: empty-table, loading-overlay, skeleton
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/loading-table (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/loading-table.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| rows? | `number` | `5` | Body rows to draw. |
| cols? | `number` | `4` | Columns to draw. |
| label? | `string` | `"Loading table"` | Status message read by screen readers. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
{isLoading ? <LoadingTable rows={8} cols={5} /> : <DataTable … />}
```

### MagicLinkForm

Use it as the whole sign-in step for passwordless apps. For email and password use SignUpForm or AuthCard with your own fields, for OAuth buttons use SocialAuthRow, and for entering a one-time code use OtpInput.

### MarkdownEditor

A markdown textarea with a formatting toolbar, Cmd/Ctrl+B, I, E and K shortcuts, write, split and preview modes, a live preview rendered without innerHTML, and a word count.

Use it for release notes, comments, descriptions and docs fields. For rendering markdown only use MarkdownRenderer (or the exported MarkdownPreview), for rich text without markdown syntax use RichTextToolbar, and for chat input use PromptInput. Works controlled (value + onChange) or uncontrolled (defaultValue).

- Name: `markdown-editor` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/markdown-editor` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { MarkdownEditor, MarkdownPreview } from "@/components/ui/markdown-editor"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/markdown-editor"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: segmented-control
- Related: markdown-renderer, rich-text-toolbar, prompt-input, character-count, textarea
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/markdown-editor (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/markdown-editor.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `string` |  | Markdown text (controlled). |
| defaultValue? | `string` | `SAMPLE` | Initial markdown when uncontrolled. Defaults to sample release notes. |
| onChange? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called with the full text on every edit and toolbar action. |
| mode? | `MarkdownEditorMode` |  | View (controlled): write shows the textarea, preview the rendered result, split both. |
| defaultMode? | `MarkdownEditorMode` | `"split"` | Initial view when uncontrolled. |
| onModeChange? | `(mode: MarkdownEditorMode) => void` |  | Called when the view changes. |
| label? | `string` | `"Release notes"` | Accessible name for the textarea. |
| placeholder? | `string` | `"Write in markdown…"` | Shown in the empty textarea. |
| minHeight? | `number` | `300` | Editor and preview height in px before the textarea is resized. |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| name? | `string` |  | Submits the markdown under this name in a hidden input, so it is sent in every mode, including preview. No name by default. |

```tsx
<MarkdownEditor value={notes} onChange={setNotes} label="Release notes" defaultMode="write" />
```

### MarkdownRenderer

Paragraphs and fenced code blocks from a markdown string, with no parser dependency.

Use it for short, trusted text such as AI replies, changelog notes or webhook docs where pulling in a full markdown parser is overkill. It never renders HTML, so the content is safe to show as is. For rich markdown (lists, links, tables) bring a real parser; for a single code sample use CodeBlock.

- Name: `markdown-renderer` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/markdown-renderer` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { MarkdownRenderer } from "@/components/ui/markdown-renderer"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/markdown-renderer"`)
- Related: code-block, markdown-editor, message-bubble
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/markdown-renderer (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/markdown-renderer.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| content? | `string` | `SAMPLE_CONTENT` | Markdown source. Paragraphs and fenced code blocks are rendered; other syntax is shown as plain text. |
| className? | `string` |  | Classes for the root wrapper. |

```tsx
<MarkdownRenderer content={"Install it:\n\n```bash\nnpx shadcn add button\n```"} />
```

### Marquee

A strip that scrolls its children sideways in a seamless loop.

Use it for logo strips, release notes or "trusted by" rows. It pauses on hover and while anything inside has keyboard focus (WCAG 2.2.2), stops under prefers-reduced-motion, and the duplicate copy is hidden from screen readers. For a static row of logos use LogoCloud.

- Name: `marquee` (component, Motion)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/marquee` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Marquee } from "@/components/ui/marquee"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/marquee"`)
- Related: logo-cloud, carousel, typographic-marquee
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/marquee (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/marquee.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `React.ReactNode` |  | Items to loop. They are rendered twice; the second copy is aria-hidden. |
| duration? | `number` | `30` | Seconds for one full loop. Larger is slower. |
| className? | `string` |  | Classes for the outer strip. |

```tsx
<Marquee duration={40}>
  <span>Changelog 0.6</span>
  <span>Base UI 1.8</span>
</Marquee>
```

### MaskedInput

A text field that formats as you type from a mask such as "(999) 999-9999".

Mask tokens: "9" digit, "A" letter, "*" letter or digit, "\\" escapes a token; anything else is a literal. The caret stays where you expect on insert, delete and paste, pasted text is refitted to the mask, and an optional guide shows the characters still to come. onChange returns the masked string, the raw characters and whether the mask is full. Use it for fixed-shape values (dates, plates, IBANs). For phone numbers with no fixed shape use PhoneInput; for one-time codes use OtpInput. Pass `mask` for a single field; without it the component renders `examples`.

- Name: `masked-input` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/masked-input` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { MaskedInput } from "@/components/ui/masked-input"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/masked-input"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: input
- Related: phone-input, otp-input, floating-label-input
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/masked-input (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/masked-input.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mask? | `string` |  | The mask. When omitted, the `examples` list is rendered instead. |
| label? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Visible label above the field. Without one, pass `aria-label`. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name when there is no visible `label`. |
| value? | `string` |  | Raw value (slot characters only), for a controlled field. |
| defaultValue? | `string` | `""` | Initial raw value when uncontrolled. Extra or mismatched characters are dropped. |
| onChange? | `(value: MaskedValue) => void` |  | Fires on every edit with `{ masked, raw, complete }`. |
| guide? | `boolean \| string` | `true` | Show the remaining mask while typing. `true` uses `guideChar`; a string is a template as long as the mask, e.g. "MM/DD/YYYY". |
| guideChar? | `string` | `"_"` | Character drawn for empty slots when `guide` is `true`. |
| uppercase? | `boolean` | `false` | Capitalise letters as they are typed. |
| placeholder? | `string` |  | Shown when empty and unfocused. Defaults to the guide template. |
| hint? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Help text under the field, linked with aria-describedby. Turns danger-coloured when `invalid`. |
| showComplete? | `boolean` | `true` | Show a check once every slot is filled. |
| showRaw? | `boolean` | `true` | Show the raw value (slot characters only) under the field. |
| invalid? | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field invalid (aria-invalid) and colours the hint. |
| disabled? | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| required? | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| id? | `string` |  |  |
| name? | `string` |  | Form field name. The submitted value is the masked string. |
| autoComplete? | `string` | `"off"` |  |
| inputMode? | `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>["inputMode"]` |  | Virtual keyboard hint. Defaults to "numeric" for digit-only masks. |
| examples? | `MaskedInputExample[]` | `EXAMPLES` | Fields rendered when no `mask` is passed. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<MaskedInput
  label="Phone"
  mask="(999) 999-9999"
  onChange={({ raw, complete }) => complete && save(raw)}
/>
```

### MasonryGrid

A masonry layout that keeps source order, for cards of uneven height.

A CSS grid with tiny rows where each item spans as many rows as its measured height. Items flow left to right, so keyboard and screen reader order match what you see, and the column count follows the container width. Use it for galleries, notes and testimonials; for equal-height cards use a plain grid. Each child is measured, so pass one element per item (no fragments). Other div props (aria-label, role, id) go on the grid element.

- Name: `masonry-grid` (component, Layout)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/masonry-grid` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { MasonryGrid } from "@/components/ui/masonry-grid"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/masonry-grid"`)
- Related: image-gallery
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/masonry-grid (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/masonry-grid.md)

Props (also accepts <div>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children? | `React.ReactNode` |  | One element per tile. Keyed children keep their measured height when reordered. |
| minColumnWidth? | `number` | `180` | Minimum column width in pixels. |
| gap? | `number` | `12` | Gap between tiles in pixels, both directions. Keep it on the 4px grid. |
| className? | `string` |  | Classes for the grid. |

```tsx
<MasonryGrid minColumnWidth={220} gap={16}>
  {posts.map((p) => <PostCard key={p.id} post={p} />)}
</MasonryGrid>
```

### MentionInput

A comment box that suggests people when you type "@" and inserts the handle you pick.

The suggestion list follows the caret, so mentions work mid-sentence, not only at the end. Keyboard: ArrowUp/ArrowDown move, Enter or Tab inserts, Escape closes; the textarea keeps focus and announces the active option through aria-activedescendant. Controlled or uncontrolled. Use TagsInput for a list of chips instead of free text.

- Name: `mention-input` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/mention-input` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { MentionInput } from "@/components/ui/mention-input"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/mention-input"`)
- Uses: input
- Related: tags-input, comment-composer
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/mention-input (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/mention-input.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled text. |
| defaultValue? | `string` | `""` | Initial text when uncontrolled. |
| onChange? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Fires with the full text on every edit, including when a suggestion is inserted. |
| onMention? | `(handle: string) => void` |  | Fires with the handle (without "@") when a suggestion is inserted. |
| suggestions? | `string[]` | `[]` | Handles offered after "@", filtered by what follows it. At most six show at once. |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |
| className? | `string` |  | Classes for the wrapper. |
| id? | `string` |  | Pair with a visible <label htmlFor>. |
| placeholder? | `string` | `"Write a comment… use @ to mention"` |  |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name. Defaults to "Comment" when there is no `id` to hang a label on. |

```tsx
const [text, setText] = React.useState("")
<label htmlFor="reply">Reply</label>
<MentionInput id="reply" value={text} onChange={setText} suggestions={["maya", "theo", "priya"]} />
```

### Menubar

A desktop-style row of menus (File, Edit, View) built on Base UI Menubar.

Arrow keys move between menus and through items, typing jumps to an item, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger. Use it for app chrome in editors and dashboards; for a single menu behind a button use DropdownMenu, for site navigation use NavigationMenu.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/menubar` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

- Related: dropdown-menu, navigation-menu
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/menubar (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/menubar.md)

Props: MenubarPrimitive props.

```tsx
<Menubar>
  <MenubarMenu>
    <MenubarTrigger>File</MenubarTrigger>
    <MenubarContent>
      <MenubarItem onClick={newFile}>New file <MenubarShortcut>⌘N</MenubarShortcut></MenubarItem>
      <MenubarSeparator />
      <MenubarItem variant="destructive">Delete</MenubarItem>
    </MenubarContent>
  </MenubarMenu>

```

### MergeBox

The merge panel at the foot of a pull request: check status plus the merge button.

When `canMerge` is false the callout turns to a warning and the button is disabled. Use it in code review and deploy UIs; for a generic status message use Callout.

- Uses: button, callout
- Related: callout, engineering-console

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| canMerge? | `boolean` | `true` | All required checks passed. False shows the pending warning and disables the button. |
| onMerge? | `() => void` |  | Called when the merge button is pressed. |
| message? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Text under the "Ready to merge" or "Checks pending" title. |
| actionLabel? | `string` | `"Merge pull request"` | Button label. |

```tsx
<MergeBox canMerge={checks.every((c) => c.ok)} onMerge={merge} />
```

### MessageActions

The copy, retry, thumbs up and thumbs down row under an AI reply.

Place it under a MessageBubble with role="assistant". It holds no state: each button only calls its handler, so copy the text in `onCopy` and pass the stored vote back as `feedback` to show the pressed thumb. A button renders only when its handler is set (the thumbs also when `feedback` is set), so pass just the actions you support. For a vote that toggles itself use `FeedbackThumbs`; for a "Not quite right?" footer with Regenerate use `RegenerateBar`.

- Name: `message-actions` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/message-actions` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { MessageActions } from "@/components/ui/message-actions"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/message-actions"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: icon-button
- Related: message-bubble, feedback-thumbs, regenerate-bar, message-branch
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/message-actions (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/message-actions.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onCopy? | `() => void` |  | Copy the reply. |
| onRetry? | `() => void` |  | Regenerate the reply. |
| onGood? | `() => void` |  | Thumbs up. |
| onBad? | `() => void` |  | Thumbs down. |
| feedback? | `"good" \| "bad" \| null` | `null` | The vote already given, shown as a pressed thumb. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<MessageActions
  onCopy={() => navigator.clipboard.writeText(reply)}
  onRetry={regenerate}
  feedback={vote}
  onGood={() => setVote("good")}
  onBad={() => setVote("bad")}
/>
```

### MessageBranch

The "‹ 2 / 3 ›" switcher that moves between the versions of an AI reply after a regenerate or an edited prompt.

Wrap the assistant reply: pass every version in `versions` (or as children) and it shows one, with a compact selector underneath. The selector hides itself while there is only one version, and in uncontrolled mode a newly added version is shown straight away. Put MessageActions in `actions` to get the selector and the copy, retry and vote buttons on one row. For the "Not quite right?" footer use RegenerateBar.

- Name: `message-branch` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/message-branch` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { MessageBranch } from "@/components/ui/message-branch"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/message-branch"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react, motion
- Uses: icon-button
- Related: message-actions, regenerate-bar
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/message-branch (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/message-branch.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| versions? | `React.ReactNode[]` |  | Every version of the reply, oldest first. When omitted, each child is one version. |
| children? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Versions as children, used when `versions` is not passed. |
| index? | `number` |  | Controlled index of the version shown (0-based). |
| defaultIndex? | `number` |  | Starting index when uncontrolled. Defaults to the newest version. |
| onIndexChange? | `(index: number) => void` |  | Fires with the new 0-based index when the user switches version. |
| hideWhenSingle? | `boolean` | `true` | Hide the selector while there is only one version. |
| label? | `string` | `"Response"` | What one version is called in the screen reader text: "Response 2 of 3", "Previous response". |
| actions? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Rendered on the selector row after the switcher, for example MessageActions. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<MessageBranch
  versions={replies.map((r) => <Markdown key={r.id}>{r.text}</Markdown>)}
  actions={<MessageActions onRetry={regenerate} />}
/>
```

### MessageBubble

One chat turn: user turns sit in a sunken capsule, assistant turns are plain prose, system turns are a quiet rule.

Use it for AI chat transcripts. Set `streaming` while tokens arrive to show a blinking cursor and mark the turn aria-busy. Put MessageActions under assistant turns; render markdown inside with MarkdownRenderer.

- Name: `message-bubble` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/message-bubble` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { MessageBubble } from "@/components/ui/message-bubble"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/message-bubble"`)
- Uses: streaming-cursor
- Related: message-actions, markdown-renderer, streaming-cursor
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/message-bubble (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/message-bubble.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| role? | `"user" \| "assistant" \| "system"` | `"assistant"` | Who is speaking. "user" aligns right in a capsule; "assistant" is left-aligned prose; "system" is a centred note. |
| streaming? | `boolean` |  | Tokens are still arriving: shows a cursor and sets aria-busy. |
| children | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<MessageBubble role="user">Summarise invoice INV-2041</MessageBubble>
<MessageBubble role="assistant" streaming={isStreaming}>{reply}</MessageBubble>
```

### Meter

A labelled bar showing how much of a known range is used (storage, quota, seats).

Exposes role="meter" with the value and a percentage text. Use Meter for a level that can go up and down; use Progress for a task moving toward done, and QuotaBar when the fill should turn warning or danger near a limit. Pass `valueText` with units ("42 of 50 GB") so screen readers hear the amount.

- Name: `meter` (component, Feedback)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/meter` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Meter } from "@/components/ui/meter"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/meter"`)
- Related: progress, quota-bar, donut-chart, gauge-chart, goal-ring, heatmap-cell, usage-meter
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/meter (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/meter.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `number` |  | Current amount, in the same unit as `max`. Clamped to 0..max for display. |
| max? | `number` | `100` | Top of the range. |
| label? | `string` |  | Visible label above the bar; also its accessible name. |
| valueText? | `string` |  | What screen readers hear for the value, e.g. "42 of 50 GB". Defaults to the percentage. |
| showValue? | `boolean` | `false` | Show `valueText` (or the percentage) beside the label. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<Meter label="Storage" value={42} max={50} valueText="42 of 50 GB" showValue />
```

### MetricDelta

A small arrow and percentage showing how a metric moved, green for good and red for bad.

Positive values point up, negative point down, zero is neutral with no arrow. Set `invert` for metrics where down is good (latency, churn, cost). Screen readers hear "Up 12%" or "Down 3%". Use it inside StatCard or a KPI row.

- Name: `metric-delta` (component, Dashboard)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/metric-delta` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { MetricDelta } from "@/components/ui/metric-delta"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/metric-delta"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Related: stat-card
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/metric-delta (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/metric-delta.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | `number` |  | Change in percent. 12 means +12%. The sign sets the arrow. |
| invert? | `boolean` | `false` | Down is good: negative values turn green and positive values red. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<MetricDelta value={12.4} />
<MetricDelta value={-8} invert />  // latency fell: shown green
```

### MobileActionSheet

An iOS-style sheet of full-width actions with a separate Cancel row, for phone-sized screens.

Built on Base UI Dialog: focus moves into the sheet and is trapped there, the page is scroll-locked and inert, Escape or a tap on the scrim cancels, and focus returns to the trigger. Use it for a short list of verbs on one object; for forms or longer content use Drawer, for desktop menus use DropdownMenu.

- Name: `mobile-action-sheet` (component, Overlays)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/mobile-action-sheet` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { MobileActionSheet } from "@/components/ui/mobile-action-sheet"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/mobile-action-sheet"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react
- Uses: button
- Related: dialog, drawer, dropdown-menu
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/mobile-action-sheet (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/mobile-action-sheet.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| open? | `boolean` |  | Controlled open state. Leave it out and the sheet manages itself behind a trigger button. |
| onClose? | `() => void` |  | Called on Cancel, Escape, a scrim tap or after an action runs. Set `open` to false here. |
| actions? | `SheetAction[]` | `SAMPLE_ACTIONS` | Rows in order. Put destructive actions last. |
| title? | `string` |  | Optional heading above the actions; also the dialog's accessible name. |
| cancelLabel? | `string` | `"Cancel"` | Label of the Cancel row. |
| triggerLabel? | `string` | `"Open action sheet"` | Label of the trigger button, shown only when the sheet is uncontrolled. |
| className? | `string` |  | Classes for the action panel. |

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false)
<Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Invoice actions</Button>
<MobileActionSheet
  open={open}
  onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
  title="Invoice INV-2041"
  actions={[
    { id: "send", label: "Send reminder", onSelect: send },
    { id: "void", label: "Void invoice", destructive: true, onSelect: voidInvoice },
  ]}
/>
```

### MobileNavDrawer

A hamburger button that opens site navigation in a panel from the right edge.

Built on Sheet (Base UI Dialog), so focus is trapped, Escape and the scrim close it, the page is scroll-locked and focus returns to the hamburger. Links close the drawer when followed. Show it below your desktop breakpoint (e.g. className="md:hidden") next to NavMarketing or a NavigationMenu.

- Name: `mobile-nav-drawer` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/mobile-nav-drawer` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { MobileNavDrawer } from "@/components/ui/mobile-nav-drawer"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/mobile-nav-drawer"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: button, sheet
- Related: sheet, dialog, nav-marketing, navigation-menu, collapsible-sidebar, sidebar
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/mobile-nav-drawer (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/mobile-nav-drawer.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| links? | `MobileNavLink[]` | `LINKS` | Destinations in order. Rendered with next/link. |
| brand? | `string` | `"MiniDev UI"` | Title in the drawer header. |
| className? | `string` |  | Classes for the wrapper around the hamburger button. |

```tsx
<MobileNavDrawer
  className="md:hidden"
  brand="Lumen"
  links={[{ href: "/pricing", label: "Pricing" }, { href: "/docs", label: "Docs" }]}
/>
```

### ModelCompare

A compact table of AI models by latency, cost and quality, with latency colour coded.

Exposes table semantics (role="table", rows, column headers) so screen readers can move by cell. Use it on model settings or pricing pages; to choose one model use ModelPicker.

```tsx
<ModelCompare rows={[{ name: "Mini", latencyMs: 84, cost: "$0.15 / 1M", quality: "Good" }]} />
```

### ModelPicker

A select for choosing an AI model, controlled or uncontrolled.

Built on the kit's Select (Base UI): full keyboard support, typeahead and a labelled trigger. Use it in chat composers and AI settings; to compare models side by side use ModelCompare.

- Name: `model-picker` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/model-picker` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ModelPicker } from "@/components/ui/model-picker"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/model-picker"`)
- Uses: select
- Related: select, model-compare
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/model-picker (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/model-picker.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled model id. |
| defaultValue? | `string \| null` | `models[0]?.id` | Initial model id when uncontrolled; pass null to start on the placeholder. |
| onChange? | `(v: string) => void` |  | Fires with the chosen model id. |
| models? | `Model[]` | `SAMPLE_MODELS` | Options in display order. |
| placeholder? | `string` | `"Select model"` | Trigger text when nothing is selected. |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |
| name? | `string` |  | Form field name; when set, the chosen model id is submitted with the form. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name for the trigger. Defaults to "Model". |
| className? | `string` |  | Classes for the trigger. Defaults to a 224px width. |

```tsx
const [model, setModel] = React.useState("lumen-pro")
<ModelPicker value={model} onChange={setModel} models={[{ id: "lumen-pro", label: "Lumen Pro" }]} />
```

### MorphPanel

A button that stretches into the panel it opens on a spring, with a built-in feedback form.

One surface grows from a pill into a panel, its corners easing from 10 to 16px, while the label blurs out and the content blurs in. No popover, no jump. Escape and an outside click close it and focus returns to the trigger; with reduced motion it swaps instantly. Default content is a feedback form with a sent state; pass a render function as `children` for your own panel. For a plain anchored panel use Popover; for a modal use Dialog.

- Name: `morph-panel` (component, Motion)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/morph-panel` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { MorphPanel } from "@/components/ui/morph-panel"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/morph-panel"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react, motion
- Related: popover, dialog
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/morph-panel (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/morph-panel.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label? | `React.ReactNode` | `"Feedback"` | Trigger text; also the panel's accessible name when it is a string. |
| icon? | `React.ReactNode` | `<MessageSquareIcon />` | Icon before the label. |
| width? | `number` | `340` | Panel width in px. |
| anchor? | `Anchor` | `"top-left"` | Which corner of the trigger the panel grows from. |
| open? | `boolean` |  | Controlled open state. |
| defaultOpen? | `boolean` | `false` | Initial open state when uncontrolled. |
| onOpenChange? | `(open: boolean) => void` |  | Fires when the panel opens or closes. |
| children? | `(api: { close: () => void }) => React.ReactNode` |  | Custom panel as a render function. Receives close(), which also returns focus to the trigger. |
| onSubmit? | `(text: string) => void \| Promise<void>` |  | Called with the text by the default feedback form. Return a promise to show "Sending…"; reject to let the user retry. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<MorphPanel label="Feedback" onSubmit={(text) => api.feedback(text)} />
<MorphPanel label="New note" width={300}>{({ close }) => <NoteForm onDone={close} />}</MorphPanel>
```

### MultiSelect

A popover list with check marks and removable chips for the chosen items.

Each option is a toggle button (aria-pressed), so Tab and Space/Enter work without a custom keyboard model; chips under the trigger remove an item in one click and are labelled "Remove <name>". Use it for 2 to ~20 options; for long or searchable lists use Combobox, for free-form entry use TagsInput.

- Name: `multi-select` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/multi-select` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { MultiSelect } from "@/components/ui/multi-select"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/multi-select"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: popover
- Related: combobox, tags-input, facet-filter, filter-bar
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/multi-select (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/multi-select.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| items? | `Item[]` | `SAMPLE_ITEMS` | Options in display order. |
| value? | `string[]` |  | Controlled selection. |
| defaultValue? | `string[]` |  | Initial selection when uncontrolled. |
| onChange? | `(value: string[]) => void` |  | Fires with the full new selection after every toggle or chip removal. |
| placeholder? | `string` | `"Select…"` | Trigger text when nothing is selected. |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name for the trigger, e.g. "Reviewers". The current selection is read after it. |
| className? | `string` |  | Classes for the trigger button. |
| name? | `string` |  | Submits each selected value as its own hidden input under this name, so `FormData.getAll(name)` returns the array. No name by default. |

```tsx
const [reviewers, setReviewers] = React.useState<string[]>([])
<MultiSelect
  aria-label="Reviewers"
  items={[{ value: "maya", label: "Maya Chen" }, { value: "theo", label: "Theo Okafor" }]}
  value={reviewers}
  onChange={setReviewers}
/>
```

### NavMarketing

A sticky top bar for marketing sites: brand, a few links and sign-in / get-started buttons.

The links hide below the md breakpoint; pair it with MobileNavDrawer there. Pass `actions` to replace the default buttons. For app navigation with dropdown panels use NavigationMenu; for an app sidebar use Sidebar.

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brand? | `React.ReactNode` | `"MiniDev"` | Brand text at the left. |
| brandHref? | `string` | `"/"` | Where the brand links to. |
| links? | `NavMarketingLink[]` | `LINKS` | Primary destinations. Hidden below md. |
| actions? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Right-hand controls. Defaults to "Sign in" and "Get started" buttons. |

```tsx
<NavMarketing
  brand="Lumen"
  links={[{ label: "Pricing", href: "/pricing" }, { label: "Docs", href: "/docs" }]}
```

### NavigationMenu

A site navigation bar whose items open rich dropdown panels, built on Base UI NavigationMenu.

Panels share one viewport that resizes between items; hover or click opens, arrow keys move between triggers, Escape closes and returns focus. Render NavigationMenuViewport once inside NavigationMenu. Use it for marketing and docs headers with grouped links; for app commands use Menubar, for a simple bar of links use NavMarketing.

- Name: `navigation-menu` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/navigation-menu` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { NavigationMenu, NavigationMenuList, NavigationMenuItem, NavigationMenuTrigger, NavigationMenuContent, NavigationMenuLink, NavigationMenuViewport } from "@/components/ui/navigation-menu"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/navigation-menu"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react
- Related: menubar, nav-marketing, mobile-nav-drawer
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/navigation-menu (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/navigation-menu.md)

Props: Nav.Root props.

```tsx
<NavigationMenu>
  <NavigationMenuList>
    <NavigationMenuItem>
      <NavigationMenuTrigger>Product</NavigationMenuTrigger>
      <NavigationMenuContent>
        <NavigationMenuLink href="/invoices">Invoices</NavigationMenuLink>
      </NavigationMenuContent>
    </NavigationMenuItem>
    <NavigationMenuItem>
      <NavigationMenuLink href="/pricing">Pricing</NavigationMenuLink>
    </NavigationMenuItem>
  </NavigationMenuList>
  <NavigationMenuViewport />
</NavigationMenu>
```

### NestedNav

A collapsible tree of navigation groups that indents with depth, for settings and docs sidebars.

Groups are disclosure buttons (aria-expanded); leaves are links when they have an `href`, buttons otherwise. The node matching `activeId` gets aria-current="page". Use it for two or three levels of navigation; for a file-style tree with arrow-key navigation and selection use TreeView.

- Name: `nested-nav` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/nested-nav` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { NestedNav } from "@/components/ui/nested-nav"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/nested-nav"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Related: tree-view, org-chart, sidebar-section
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/nested-nav (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/nested-nav.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| nodes? | `NavNode[]` | `SAMPLE_NODES` | Tree of nodes; any node with children becomes a collapsible group. |
| activeId? | `string` |  | Id of the current page's node; it is highlighted and marked aria-current="page". |
| onSelect? | `(node: NavNode) => void` |  | Called when a leaf is activated (link or button). |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<NestedNav
  activeId="invoices"
  nodes={[{ id: "billing", label: "Billing", children: [{ id: "invoices", label: "Invoices", href: "/billing/invoices" }] }]}
/>
```

### NewsletterSignup

An email field and Subscribe button that stack on phones and sit in one row from sm up.

Uses native email validation. If `onSubmit` returns a promise the button shows "Subscribing…" until it settles, then a polite status line confirms success or reports the error; a rejected promise keeps the email so the user can retry. Use it in footers and blog sidebars; for a full sign-up flow use a form block.

- Name: `newsletter-signup` (component, Landing pages)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/newsletter-signup` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

- Uses: button, input
- Related: waitlist-hero
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/newsletter-signup (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/newsletter-signup.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onSubmit? | `(email: string) => void \| Promise<unknown>` |  | Receives the email. Return a promise to show the pending and success states. |
| successMessage? | `string` | `"Thanks. Check your inbox to confirm."` | Status text after a successful submit. |
| buttonLabel? | `string` | `"Subscribe"` | Button label. |
| placeholder? | `string` | `"you@company.com"` | Placeholder in the field. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<NewsletterSignup onSubmit={(email) => fetch("/api/subscribe", { method: "POST", body: email })} />
```

### NotebookCell

A Jupyter-style cell: a run button, the code in an editor frame, and its output below.

While `running` is true the run button is disabled and the cell is aria-busy; the output region is a labelled, keyboard-scrollable live region so results are announced. Use it for data and AI playgrounds; for static code use CodeBlock.

- Name: `notebook-cell` (component, Dev tools)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/notebook-cell` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { NotebookCell } from "@/components/ui/notebook-cell"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/notebook-cell"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: code-editor-frame, icon-button
- Related: code-block
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/notebook-cell (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/notebook-cell.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| code | `string` |  | Source shown in the editor frame. Line breaks and indentation are kept; long lines wrap. |
| output? | `string \| null` |  | Result text. Omit (or pass null) to hide the output area. |
| onRun? | `() => void` |  | Called by the run button. |
| running? | `boolean` | `false` | The cell is executing: disables run and marks the cell busy. |
| filename? | `string` | `"cell.ts"` | File name in the editor frame's title bar. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<NotebookCell code={source} output={result} running={busy} onRun={run} filename="query.sql" />
```

### NotificationInbox

A bell with an unread count that opens an inbox popover with All and Mentions tabs, unread dots and mark-all-read.

Built on Base UI Popover: focus moves in on open, Escape closes and returns focus to the bell, whose accessible name includes the unread count. Opening a row marks it read. Use it in app headers; for a single row use NotificationItem, for settings use NotificationPreferences.

- Name: `notification-inbox` (component, Overlays)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/notification-inbox` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { NotificationInbox } from "@/components/ui/notification-inbox"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/notification-inbox"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react, lucide-react
- Related: popover, notification-item, notification-preferences, notification-center
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/notification-inbox (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/notification-inbox.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| notes? | `Note[]` | `SAMPLE` | Initial notifications, newest first. The inbox then tracks read state itself. |
| onOpenNote? | `(note: Note) => void` |  | Called when a notification is opened (it is also marked read). |
| onMarkAllRead? | `() => void` |  | Called after "Mark all read". |
| viewAllHref? | `string` | `"#"` | Footer link to the full activity page. Omit to hide the footer. |
| className? | `string` |  | Classes for the bell trigger. |

```tsx
<NotificationInbox
  notes={[{ id: "1", kind: "mention", who: "Mira Sato", text: "mentioned you in Q3 roadmap", time: "2m", unread: true }]}
  onOpenNote={(n) => router.push(`/inbox/${n.id}`)}
  viewAllHref="/activity"
/>
```

### NotificationItem

One row of a notification list: title, body, relative time and an unread dot.

The time renders with RelativeTime ("42m ago") and is hydration-safe. Unread rows get a tinted background, an accent dot and "Unread" for screen readers. Stack rows in a list; for the bell-and-popover inbox use NotificationInbox.

- Name: `notification-item` (component, Feedback)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/notification-item` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { NotificationItem } from "@/components/ui/notification-item"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/notification-item"`)
- Uses: relative-time
- Related: relative-time, stack, notification-inbox, list-item, notification-center
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/notification-item (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/notification-item.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title? | `string` | `"Invoice INV-2041 paid"` | One-line headline; truncates. |
| body? | `string` | `"Northwind paid $12,400.00 by bank tr...` | Supporting sentence under the title. |
| date? | `string \| Date` |  | When it happened. Defaults to 42 minutes ago. |
| unread? | `boolean` |  | Highlights the row and adds an unread dot. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<NotificationItem title="Invoice INV-2041 paid" body="Northwind paid $12,400.00." date={paidAt} unread />
```

### NotificationPreferences

A list of labelled on/off switches for notification channels (email digests, product updates, security alerts).

Each row's label is wired to its switch, ids are unique per instance, and `onCheckedChange` reports which channel changed. Switches are uncontrolled from `defaultChecked`; persist changes in the callback. Use it on settings pages.

- Name: `notification-preferences` (component, Settings)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/notification-preferences` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { NotificationPreferences } from "@/components/ui/notification-preferences"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/notification-preferences"`)
- Uses: label, switch
- Related: feature-flag-toggle, notification-inbox, feature-flags
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/notification-preferences (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/notification-preferences.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| items? | `NotificationPreference[]` | `ITEMS` | Channels in display order. |
| onCheckedChange? | `(id: string, checked: boolean) => void` |  | Fires with the channel id and its new state. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<NotificationPreferences
  items={[{ id: "email", label: "Email digests", defaultChecked: true }, { id: "sms", label: "SMS alerts" }]}
  onCheckedChange={(id, on) => savePreference(id, on)}
/>
```

### NumberInput

A numeric field with minus and plus buttons, clamped to min and max.

Typing is free while the field has focus (you can clear it or type "15" past a min of 10); the value is clamped and committed on blur or Enter. ArrowUp/ArrowDown step natively, buttons disable at the bounds, and decimal steps avoid float drift (0.1 + 0.2 stays 0.3). Controlled or uncontrolled. Use Slider for a rough value on a range; use it for exact counts like seats or quantities.

- Name: `number-input` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/number-input` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { NumberInput } from "@/components/ui/number-input"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/number-input"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: icon-button, input
- Related: slider, currency-input, input, quantity-stepper
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/number-input (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/number-input.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `number` |  | Controlled value. |
| defaultValue? | `number` | `0` | Initial value when uncontrolled. |
| onChange? | `(value: number) => void` |  | Fires with each committed, clamped value. |
| min? | `number` |  | Lowest allowed value. |
| max? | `number` |  | Highest allowed value. |
| step? | `number` | `1` | Amount the buttons and arrow keys add or remove. |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |
| className? | `string` |  | Classes for the wrapper. |
| id? | `string` |  | Pair with a visible <label htmlFor>. |
| name? | `string` |  | Form field name. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name. Defaults to "Number" when there is no `id` to hang a label on. |

```tsx
const [seats, setSeats] = React.useState(5)
<NumberInput value={seats} onChange={setSeats} min={1} max={50} aria-label="Seats" />
```

### NumberRoll

An odometer number whose digits roll on a spring when the value changes.

Each digit is a strip of 0-9 that springs to its place, so changing $1,284 to $1,391 rolls only the digits that changed. Digits keep their identity from the right, so 999 → 1,000 grows a column instead of reshuffling. Screen readers get the plain formatted value; with reduced motion the number swaps instantly. Use it for live totals, prices and KPI values; for a static number just render it with tabular-nums.

- Name: `number-roll` (component, Motion)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/number-roll` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { NumberRoll } from "@/components/ui/number-roll"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/number-roll"`)
- Dependencies: motion
- Related: credit-balance, split-flap, flip-stat-board, launch-countdown, stats-counter
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/number-roll (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/number-roll.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `number` | `1284` | The number to show. Change it to roll. |
| format? | `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` |  | Intl.NumberFormat options, e.g. { style: "currency", currency: "USD" }. |
| locale? | `string` | `"en-US"` | BCP 47 locale for formatting, e.g. "de-DE". |
| trend? | `boolean` |  | Briefly tint up/down changes with success/danger. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<NumberRoll value={mrr} format={{ style: "currency", currency: "USD" }} trend />
```


### OnboardingChecklist

A "Get started" card of tickable setup tasks with a done count.

Each task is a checkbox (role="checkbox", aria-checked) toggled by click, Space or Enter; the header shows "2 of 4" progress. State is kept inside from `items`; persist it with `onToggle`. Use it on empty dashboards; for a strict linear flow use OnboardingWizard.

### OnboardingWizard

A three-step first-run flow: create a workspace, invite members, done.

A Stepper shows progress; when the step changes, focus moves to the new step so keyboard and screen reader users land on the fresh content. Use it as a starting point for a linear setup flow; for optional tasks in any order use OnboardingChecklist.

### OrderSummary

Label and value lines above a separator and a bold total, for checkout and invoices.

Marked up as a description list (dt/dd) so each amount is read with its label. Values are preformatted strings: format money with Intl.NumberFormat before passing it in. Use it beside a checkout form; for a full price table use PricingTable.

### OrgChart

A collapsible organisation chart with connector lines, initials avatars, team colours, per node counts and arrow key navigation.

Cards carry an initials avatar, name, role and a team coloured stripe; a pill under each manager shows how many people report up and folds the branch on a spring. Connectors are plain CSS borders and the tree scrolls sideways when wider than its container. Keyboard: one tab stop; ArrowLeft/Right walk siblings, ArrowDown opens or enters reports, ArrowUp goes to the manager, Home/End jump, Enter/Space selects and toggles. Use it for people directories and admin consoles; for a file-style hierarchy use TreeView, for a sidebar menu use NestedNav.

- Name: `org-chart` (component, Dashboard)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/org-chart` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { OrgChart } from "@/components/ui/org-chart"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/org-chart"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react, motion
- Related: tree-view, nested-nav
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/org-chart (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/org-chart.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data? | `OrgNode` | `SAMPLE` | The root person. Defaults to Northwind's leadership, four levels deep with the lower branches folded. |
| defaultExpandDepth? | `number` | `0` | Nodes at or above this depth start expanded. The root is depth 0. |
| defaultExpanded? | `string[]` | `data === SAMPLE ? ["theo"] : []` | Extra node ids that start expanded. |
| selectedId? | `string` |  | Controlled selected node id. |
| defaultSelectedId? | `string` |  | Initially selected node id when uncontrolled. |
| onSelect? | `(node: OrgNode) => void` |  | Called when a node is clicked or activated. |
| teamTones? | `Partial<Record<string, OrgTone>>` |  | Pin team names to colours. Unlisted teams are coloured in order. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name for the tree. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<OrgChart
  data={{ id: "ceo", name: "Maya Chen", role: "CEO", children: [{ id: "cto", name: "Theo Okafor", role: "CTO", team: "Engineering" }] }}
  defaultExpandDepth={1}
  onSelect={(node) => openProfile(node.id)}
/>
```

### OrgSwitcher

A popover list of organizations with the current one checked and its plan beside it.

The trigger reads "<current org>, switch organization"; the current option carries aria-current. Picking one closes the popover and returns focus to the trigger. Controlled (`value`) or uncontrolled (`defaultValue`). Use it at the top of a Sidebar; for a plain list of options use Select.

| value? | `string` |  | Controlled organization id. Omit it and the switcher keeps its own selection. |
| defaultValue? | `string` |  | Initially selected organization id when uncontrolled. |


### OtpInput

A one-time code field drawn as separate slots, with SMS autofill, paste and a shake on error.

One real <input> sits invisibly over the slots, so paste, SMS autofill (autocomplete="one-time-code"), backspace, selection and screen readers all behave natively. The slots are pure paint: a fake caret, a glyph that settles in, a shake when `status` turns "invalid". Use it for 2FA and email verification codes; for other fixed-shape values use MaskedInput.

- Name: `otp-input` (component, Auth)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/otp-input` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { OtpInput } from "@/components/ui/otp-input"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/otp-input"`)
- Related: masked-input, input, magic-link-form, two-factor-verify, sign-in-page
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/otp-input (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/otp-input.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| length? | `number` | `6` | Number of characters in the code. |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled code. |
| defaultValue? | `string` | `""` | Initial code when uncontrolled. |
| onChange? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Fires with the cleaned code on every edit. |
| onComplete? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Fires once when every slot is filled. |
| groups? | `number[]` |  | Split the slots into groups, e.g. [3, 3] renders "123 – 456". Must sum to `length`. |
| pattern? | `"numeric" \| "alphanumeric"` | `"numeric"` | Allowed characters. "alphanumeric" upper-cases letters. |
| status? | `Status` | `"idle"` | "invalid" shakes and turns the slots red (aria-invalid); "success" turns them green. |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |
| autoFocus? | `boolean` |  |  |
| name? | `string` |  | Form field name for the hidden input. |
| id? | `string` |  | Id for the real input, so a `<label htmlFor>` can name it. With `id` set, the default aria-label is dropped. |
| size? | `"default" \| "lg"` | `"default"` | Slot size: "default" 40×44, "lg" 48×56. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name. Defaults to "One-time code" when there is no `id`. |

```tsx
<OtpInput length={6} groups={[3, 3]} onComplete={verify} status={error ? "invalid" : "idle"} />
```

### Pagination

Previous / page numbers / Next controls for a paged list, with ellipses for long ranges.

Always shows the first and last page plus the current page's neighbours, and keeps a constant seven slots so the bar never changes width as you page. The current page has aria-current="page"; every button has a spoken label ("Page 4"). The component is controlled: keep `page` in state (1-based) and update it in onPageChange. For infinite feeds use a "Load more" button instead.

- Name: `pagination` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/pagination` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Pagination } from "@/components/ui/pagination"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/pagination"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: button
- Related: infinite-scroll, table-pagination
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/pagination (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/pagination.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| page | `number` |  | Current page, 1-based. |
| pageCount | `number` |  | Total number of pages. Zero or one hides nothing but disables both arrows. |
| onPageChange | `(p: number) => void` |  | Fires with the requested 1-based page. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
const [page, setPage] = React.useState(1)
<Pagination page={page} pageCount={Math.ceil(total / pageSize)} onPageChange={setPage} />
```

### PasswordInput

A password field with an eye button that shows or hides what was typed.

Accepts every native input prop (name, autoComplete, required, value, onChange…). The toggle is a real button labelled "Show password" / "Hide password" that controls the field via aria-controls. Use autoComplete="current-password" on sign-in and "new-password" on sign-up; for a strength meter use PasswordStrength.

- Name: `password-input` (component, Forms)

```tsx

<PasswordInput id="pw" name="password" autoComplete="current-password" required />
```

### PasswordStrength

A new-password field with a four segment strength meter and a live checklist of rules.

The score is announced politely as it changes, rules are plain text for screen readers ("(met)" / "(not met)"), and nothing blocks typing. Swap in your own scorer (for example zxcvbn) with the `score` prop and your own policy with `rules`. Use it on sign-up and change-password forms; on sign-in use PasswordInput alone.

- Name: `password-strength` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/password-strength` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { PasswordStrength } from "@/components/ui/password-strength"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/password-strength"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: password-input
- Related: password-input
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/password-strength (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/password-strength.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled password. |
| defaultValue? | `string` | `""` | Initial password when uncontrolled. |
| onChange? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Fires with the password on every edit. |
| rules? | `Rule[]` | `DEFAULT_RULES` | Rules shown in the checklist. |
| score? | `(value: string) => number` |  | Override the built in 0 to 4 score. |
| label? | `string` | `"Password"` | Visible label above the field. |
| id? | `string` |  | Input id; also prefixes the meter and checklist ids. |
| name? | `string` |  | Form field name. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<PasswordStrength
  label="New password"
  onChange={setPassword}
  rules={[{ label: "At least 12 characters", test: (v) => v.length >= 12 }]}
/>
```

### PaymentMethodCard

Screen readers hear "Visa ending in 4242, expires 09/28" instead of the dots. Never pass a full card number; only the last four. Use it on billing settings pages; to collect a new card use your payment provider's hosted fields.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brand? | `string` | `"Visa"` | Card network, e.g. "Visa". |
| last4? | `string` | `"4242"` | Last four digits only. |
| exp? | `string` | `"09/28"` | Expiry as MM/YY. |
| onEdit? | `() => void` |  | Called by the Edit button. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<PaymentMethodCard brand="Mastercard" last4="4444" exp="11/27" onEdit={openBillingPortal} />
```

### PeekPanel

A non-modal side panel for previewing a record beside a list, with a title bar and close button.

It is a labelled landmark (aside) that leaves the rest of the page usable; Escape inside it calls `onClose`, and the close button only renders when `onClose` is given. Place it in a flex row next to the list. For a modal overlay that traps focus use Sheet; for a resizable split use a resizable panel layout.

- Name: `peek-panel` (component, Overlays)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/peek-panel` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { PeekPanel } from "@/components/ui/peek-panel"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/peek-panel"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: icon-button
- Related: sheet
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/peek-panel (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/peek-panel.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `string` |  | Heading in the title bar; also the landmark's accessible name. |
| children | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| onClose? | `() => void` |  | Called by the close button and by Escape inside the panel. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<div className="flex h-[600px]">
  <IssueList className="flex-1" onOpen={setIssue} />
  {issue ? <PeekPanel title={issue.title} onClose={() => setIssue(null)}>{issue.body}</PeekPanel> : null}
</div>
```

### PermissionChip

A small uppercase chip showing an access level: admin, write or read.

Admin is accent-tinted, write is filled, read is quiet, so levels scan at a glance in member tables. Screen readers hear "admin access". For arbitrary labels use Badge; for live status use StatusBadge.

- Name: `permission-chip` (component, Settings)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/permission-chip` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { PermissionChip } from "@/components/ui/permission-chip"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/permission-chip"`)
- Related: badge, status-badge, permission-denied
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/permission-chip (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/permission-chip.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| level? | `PermissionLevel` | `"read"` | Access level shown on the chip. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<PermissionChip level="write" />
```

### PermissionDenied

A centred panel explaining that the user lacks access, with buttons to request it or go elsewhere.

Say which role is needed in `description`. Pass `actions` with real handlers (the defaults are inert placeholders). For a missing page use NotFoundState; for a single locked control use PermissionChip or a disabled button with a Tooltip.

- Name: `permission-denied` (component, Feedback)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/permission-denied` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { PermissionDenied } from "@/components/ui/permission-denied"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/permission-denied"`)
- Uses: button
- Related: not-found-state, permission-chip, tooltip
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/permission-denied (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/permission-denied.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title? | `React.ReactNode` | `"Permission denied"` | Heading text. |
| description? | `React.ReactNode` | `"You need admin on this workspace to ...` | Which permission is missing and who can grant it. |
| actions? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Buttons. Defaults to inert "Request access" and "Switch workspace" buttons. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<PermissionDenied
  description="You need the Billing admin role to view invoices."
  actions={<Button size="sm" onClick={requestAccess}>Request access</Button>}
/>
```

### PhoneInput

A telephone field with the phone keypad on mobile and tel autofill, free-form so any country's format works.

Accepts every native input prop (name, required, aria-invalid…); onChange gives the string. Validate and normalise (e.g. to E.164) on submit, not while typing. For a fixed national format with live formatting use MaskedInput with "(999) 999-9999".

- Name: `phone-input` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/phone-input` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { PhoneInput } from "@/components/ui/phone-input"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/phone-input"`)
- Uses: input
- Related: masked-input, country-select
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/phone-input (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/phone-input.md)

Props (also accepts <input>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled value. Leave it out for an uncontrolled field (use defaultValue). |
| onChange? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Fires with the raw text on every edit. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name. Defaults to "Phone number" when there is no `id` to hang a label on. |

```tsx
<label htmlFor="phone">Phone</label>
<PhoneInput id="phone" name="phone" value={phone} onChange={setPhone} />
```

### PieChart

An SVG pie chart with leader line labels, a legend and slices that pull out on hover or focus.

Hover or focus a slice and it pulls out on a spring while the readout shows its value and share. Slices are one tab stop; arrow keys, Home and End move between them, and a visually hidden table carries the data for screen readers. Labels hide below 320px wide. Use it for 2 to 6 parts of a whole; for more categories or comparisons over time use BarChart, for a ring with a centre total use DonutChart.

- Name: `pie-chart` (component, Charts)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/pie-chart` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { PieChart } from "@/components/ui/pie-chart"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/pie-chart"`)
- Dependencies: motion
- Related: bar-chart, donut-chart, waffle-chart
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/pie-chart (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/pie-chart.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data? | `PieDatum[]` | `SAMPLE` | Slices in clockwise order, starting at the top. |
| title? | `string` | `"Revenue by plan"` | Heading shown above the chart and used as the accessible name. |
| caption? | `string` | `"Monthly recurring revenue"` | Caption under the total when no slice is active. |
| format? | `(value: number) => string` | `defaultFormat` | Formats values in the readout, legend and table. |
| showLabels? | `boolean` | `true` | Labels outside the slices with leader lines. Hidden automatically when the chart is narrow. |
| showLegend? | `boolean` | `true` | Legend with values under the chart. |
| pullOut? | `number` | `6` | Distance a hovered or focused slice pulls out, in chart units. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<PieChart
  title="Revenue by plan"
  data={[{ label: "Pro", value: 22400 }, { label: "Business", value: 31600 }]}
  format={(n) => `$${n.toLocaleString()}`}
/>
```

### PinnedMessage

An accent-tinted note pinned to the top of a channel or thread, with its author.

### PlanCard

A pricing tier with price per period, feature list and a call to action; highlighted tiers get the accent ring.

Lay several side by side for a pricing page; mark the recommended one `highlighted` and give it a `badge`; mark the customer's plan `current` to disable its button. Prices are preformatted strings. For a full feature matrix use PlanComparison, for a monthly/yearly switch use PricingToggle.

- Name: `plan-card` (component, Billing)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/plan-card` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { PlanCard } from "@/components/ui/plan-card"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/plan-card"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: button
- Related: plan-comparison, pricing-toggle, choice-card, comparison-table, pricing-table, product-card, billing-page, morph-price
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/plan-card (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/plan-card.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name? | `string` | `"Pro"` | Tier name. |
| price? | `string` | `"$49"` | Preformatted price, e.g. "$49". |
| period? | `string` | `"mo"` | Billing period after the slash, e.g. "mo" or "yr". |
| features? | `string[]` | `SAMPLE_FEATURES` | What the tier includes, one line each. |
| cta? | `string` | `"Choose plan"` | Button label. |
| highlighted? | `boolean` |  | Recommended tier: accent ring and a solid button. |
| badge? | `string` |  | Small label beside the name, e.g. "Most popular". |
| current? | `boolean` | `false` | The customer's plan today: the button is disabled but stays focusable. Defaults to false. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| onCta? | `() => void` |  | Called by the button. |

```tsx
<PlanCard name="Pro" price="$49" period="mo" features={["10 seats", "Bank sync"]} highlighted badge="Most popular" onCta={() => checkout("pro")} />
```

### PlanComparison

A feature-by-plan table with check marks, dashes or short values in each cell.

A real <table> with column and row headers; icon cells carry "Included" / "Not included" for screen readers. Pass `plans` for the columns and `rows` with one value per plan: true, false, or a string such as "10 seats". Scrolls sideways on narrow screens. Pair it with PlanCard tiers above.

- Name: `plan-comparison` (component, Billing)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/plan-comparison` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { PlanComparison } from "@/components/ui/plan-comparison"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/plan-comparison"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Related: plan-card, feature-grid, upgrade-prompt, pricing-page
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/plan-comparison (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/plan-comparison.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| plans? | `string[]` | `PLANS` | Column headings, one per plan. |
| rows? | `PlanComparisonRow[]` | `ROWS` | Feature rows. |
| caption? | `string` | `"Plan comparison"` | Accessible caption for the table. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<PlanComparison
  plans={["Free", "Pro", "Business"]}
  rows={[
    { feature: "Seats", values: ["1", "10", "Unlimited"] },
    { feature: "SSO", values: [false, false, true] },
  ]}
/>
```

### Popover

A floating panel anchored to its trigger, built on Base UI; without children it shows a demo trigger and panel.

Click or Enter opens it, focus moves inside, Escape or an outside click closes it and focus returns to the trigger. The panel is non-modal and labelled by PopoverTitle. Use it for small interactive content (share links, filters, quick edits); for read-only hints use Tooltip, for a list of commands use DropdownMenu, for blocking decisions use Dialog.

- Name: `popover` (component, Overlays)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/popover` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Popover, PopoverClose, PopoverContent, PopoverDescription, PopoverHeader, PopoverTitle, PopoverTrigger } from "@/components/ui/popover"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/popover"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react
- Uses: button
- Related: tooltip, dropdown-menu, dialog, calendar-month, calendar, emoji-picker, hover-card, morph-panel
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/popover (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/popover.md)

Props: PopoverPrimitive.Root props.

```tsx
<Popover>
  <PopoverTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" />}>Share</PopoverTrigger>
  <PopoverContent align="start">
    <PopoverHeader>
      <PopoverTitle>Share report</PopoverTitle>
      <PopoverDescription>Anyone with the link can view.</PopoverDescription>
    </PopoverHeader>
    <PopoverClose render={<Button size="sm" />}>Done</PopoverClose>
  </PopoverContent>
</Popover>
```

### PricingToggle

A Monthly / Yearly segmented switch with a savings note underneath.

Use it above a PricingTable to flip prices between billing periods. For any other two or three way choice use SegmentedControl directly.

- Name: `pricing-toggle` (component, Billing)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/pricing-toggle` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { PricingToggle } from "@/components/ui/pricing-toggle"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/pricing-toggle"`)
- Uses: segmented-control
- Related: pricing-table, segmented-control, plan-card
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/pricing-toggle (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/pricing-toggle.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `BillingCadence` |  | Controlled billing period. Leave unset to let the toggle keep its own state. |
| defaultValue? | `BillingCadence` | `"monthly"` | Starting period when uncontrolled. |
| onChange? | `(value: BillingCadence) => void` |  | Fires with the newly picked period. |
| note? | `React.ReactNode` | `"Save 20% with yearly"` | Line under the switch. Pass an empty string or null to hide it. Use your real discount. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
const [cadence, setCadence] = React.useState<BillingCadence>("monthly")
<PricingToggle value={cadence} onChange={setCadence} note="Two months free on yearly" />
```

### PriorityPicker

A row of four pill radios (Low, Medium, High, Urgent) for an issue or task priority.

Use it in issue forms and task sidebars. Arrow keys move and select, like any radio group. Pass `name` to submit the value with a form. For an arbitrary option list use SegmentedControl or RadioGroup.

- Name: `priority-picker` (component, Workflow)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/priority-picker` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { PriorityPicker } from "@/components/ui/priority-picker"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/priority-picker"`)
- Related: segmented-control, radio-group, workflow-board
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/priority-picker (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/priority-picker.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `Priority \| (string & {})` |  | Controlled priority: "low" \| "medium" \| "high" \| "urgent". Leave unset for uncontrolled. |
| defaultValue? | `Priority` |  | Starting priority when uncontrolled. Nothing is selected by default. |
| onChange? | `(value: Priority) => void` |  | Fires with the picked priority. |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |
| name? | `string` |  | Form field name. When set, a hidden input submits the current priority ("" when none). Unset by default. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name of the group. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
const [priority, setPriority] = React.useState<Priority>("medium")
<PriorityPicker value={priority} onChange={setPriority} />
```

### ProductCard

A square product image, title, price and an optional Add to cart button.

Use it in shop grids and recommendation rails. `price` and `badge` are display strings, so format money before passing it in. The button only renders with `onAdd`, and it is described by the title so it reads "Add to cart, Linen tote". Pair it with WishlistButton for saving. For a pricing tier use PlanCard; for a generic content tile use Card.

- Name: `product-card` (component, E-commerce)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/product-card` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ProductCard } from "@/components/ui/product-card"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/product-card"`)
- Uses: aspect-ratio, button
- Related: wishlist-button, plan-card, card
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/product-card (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/product-card.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `string` |  | Product name, rendered as an h3. |
| price | `string` |  | Display price, already formatted, e.g. "$48" or "€42,00". |
| image? | `string` |  | Image URL, shown square and cropped to cover. |
| imageAlt? | `string` | `""` | Alt text for the image. Empty by default because the title sits right under it. |
| badge? | `string` |  | Short corner tag such as "New" or "-20%". |
| onAdd? | `() => void` |  | Shows the add button when set. |
| addLabel? | `string` | `"Add to cart"` | Text of the add button. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<ProductCard title="Linen tote" price="$48" image="/tote.jpg" imageAlt="Natural linen tote bag" badge="New" onAdd={() => addToCart("tote")} />
```

### ProgressCircle
