Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title? | `string` | `"DESIGN.md"` | Source name, e.g. a document title. |
| url? | `string` | `"local://DESIGN.md"` | URL or path shown under the title. |
| href? | `string` |  | Opens the source; makes the title a link. |
| snippet? | `string` | `"Hairline · Geist Sans · accent hue 2...` | The quoted passage the answer relied on. |
| badge? | `React.ReactNode` | `"source"` | Badge text in the corner. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<SourceCard title="Billing API" url="docs.acme.com/billing" href="https://docs.acme.com/billing" snippet="Invoices are finalised after 1 hour." />
```

### SpeechInput

A mic button that turns speech into text with the browser's Web Speech API, with a ring that follows your voice.

Put it in the toolbar of PromptInput or AiComposer. Click to start, click again or press Escape to stop. `onTranscript(text, { final })` fires with grey-preview text (`final: false`) while you speak and with settled text (`final: true`) when a phrase ends: append final text, replace the preview. It needs `SpeechRecognition`, which Chrome, Edge and Safari have and Firefox does not; there the button is disabled with a tooltip that says so. It calls no service of its own and needs no API key. To record an audio file instead of text use AudioRecorder.

- Name: `speech-input` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/speech-input` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { SpeechInput } from "@/components/ui/speech-input"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/speech-input"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react, motion
- Uses: icon-button, kbd, tooltip
- Related: prompt-input, ai-composer, audio-recorder
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/speech-input (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/speech-input.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onTranscript? | `(text: string, meta: { final: boolean }) => void` |  | Fires with recognised text. `final: false` is a live guess that will be replaced; `final: true` is settled. |
| lang? | `string` |  | BCP 47 language to recognise, e.g. "en-GB" or "hi-IN". Defaults to the browser language (`navigator.language`). |
| continuous? | `boolean` | `true` | Keep listening across pauses until stopped. When false, it stops after the first phrase. |
| interim? | `boolean` | `true` | Send interim guesses (`final: false`) while the user speaks. |
| onError? | `(error: string) => void` |  | Fires with the Web Speech error code: "not-allowed", "audio-capture", "network", "no-speech"... |
| onUnsupported? | `() => void` |  | Fires once after mount when the browser has no speech recognition. |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  | Disables the button and stops listening if it is on. |
| size? | `"sm" \| "md"` | `"md"` | 32px (sm) or 36px (md). |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name of the button, also its tooltip. Defaults to "Dictate". |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
const [preview, setPreview] = React.useState("")
<SpeechInput onTranscript={(text, { final }) => {
  if (final) { setPrompt((p) => `${p} ${text.trim()}`.trim()); setPreview("") } else setPreview(text)
}} />
```

### SplitButton

A primary action with an attached chevron that opens a menu of related actions.

Use it when one action is the obvious default and two to five close variants sit behind it ("Save" / "Save draft", "Merge" / "Squash and merge"). For unrelated actions use DropdownMenu on its own; for a single action use Button.

- Name: `split-button` (component, Buttons)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/split-button` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { SplitButton } from "@/components/ui/split-button"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/split-button"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: button, dropdown-menu
- Related: dropdown-menu, button
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/split-button (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/split-button.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label? | `React.ReactNode` | `"Save invoice"` | The primary action's label. |
| onPrimaryClick? | `() => void` |  | Called by the primary (left) button. |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  | Disables both halves. |
| menuLabel? | `string` | `"More actions"` | Accessible name for the chevron that opens the menu. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| items? | `SplitButtonItem[]` | `SAMPLE_ITEMS` | Secondary actions in the menu; the menu matches the button's width. |

```tsx
<SplitButton
  label="Merge"
  onPrimaryClick={merge}

/>
```

### SplitFlap

A departure-board display where each character flips through the alphabet to its target, rippling across the row like a Solari board.

Top half falls over the bottom with a staggered start per column. Screen readers get the final text once; the flipping is decoration.

The board is always dark (it scopes the dark tokens to itself). Supported characters: A-Z, 0-9, space and : . - ' / ·; anything else shows blank. Use it for a headline status or a launch moment; for a changing number in a dashboard use NumberRoll, which is quieter.

- Name: `split-flap` (component, Motion)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/split-flap` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { SplitFlap } from "@/components/ui/split-flap"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/split-flap"`)
- Dependencies: motion
- Related: number-roll
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/split-flap (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/split-flap.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `string` | `"NOW BOARDING"` | Text to flip to. Change it to flip again from the current characters. |
| length? | `number` |  | Pad or cut to this many cells. |
| speed? | `number` | `70` | Milliseconds per single flip. |
| stagger? | `number` | `28` | Extra delay per column, for the ripple. |
| size? | `"sm" \| "default" \| "lg"` | `"default"` | Cell size: 24px, 32px or 48px tall. |
| tone? | `"default" \| "accent" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger"` | `"default"` | Colour of the characters. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<SplitFlap value="GATE 12" length={8} tone="accent" />
```

### SsoProviderCard

A settings card for one SSO identity provider (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace): name, status badge, enable switch and Configure button.

Render one per provider in an organisation's security settings. The switch is controlled: pass `enabled` and update it in `onEnabledChange`. `configured` only changes the badge, so block enabling an unconfigured provider in your handler. For a third-party app connection use IntegrationCard; for the sign-in screen itself use SignInPage or AuthCard.

- Name: `sso-provider-card` (component, Auth)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/sso-provider-card` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { SsoProviderCard } from "@/components/ui/sso-provider-card"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/sso-provider-card"`)
- Uses: button, status-badge, switch
- Related: integration-card, sign-in-page, auth-card, connected-account, admin-console
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/sso-provider-card (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/sso-provider-card.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name | `string` |  | Provider name, e.g. "Okta". |
| description | `string` |  | Protocol or a one-line note, e.g. "SAML 2.0 · 12 users". |
| enabled? | `boolean` |  | Whether sign-in through this provider is on. |
| configured? | `boolean` |  | Shows "Configured" (success) instead of "Not set". |
| onEnabledChange? | `(enabled: boolean) => void` |  | Called with the new value when the switch is toggled. |
| onConfigure? | `() => void` |  | Called by the Configure button. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<SsoProviderCard name="Okta" description="SAML 2.0" configured enabled={on} onEnabledChange={setOn} onConfigure={openSetup} />
```

### StackTrace

A scrollable, monospaced error stack in the danger tone, preserving line breaks and indentation.

Use it in error pages, logs and AI tool-call failures. For general code use CodeBlock; for an error summary with retry use ServerErrorState.

| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<StackTrace stack={error.stack ?? String(error)} />
```

### Stack

A vertical flex column with a fixed gap from the 4px spacing scale.

Use it to space sibling blocks evenly without margin utilities: form sections, card bodies, a heading over text over a button. Children stretch to full width, so add `items-start` for buttons. For a row that wraps use Cluster, for a centred column use Center, for page width use Container, and for a page grid use CSS grid.

- Name: `stack` (component, Layout)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/stack` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Stack } from "@/components/ui/stack"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/stack"`)
- Related: cluster, center, container, admin-user-row, cart-line-item, commit-row, connected-account, notification-item
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/stack (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/stack.md)

Props (also accepts <div>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| gap? | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| 8` | `3` | Gap in 4px steps: 1 = 4px, 3 = 12px, 8 = 32px. A `gap-*` class in className also works. |

```tsx
<Stack gap={4}><Heading /><Text /><Button>Continue</Button></Stack>
```

### StackedBarChart

Vertical bars stacked by series, with a legend, for comparing revenue mix across periods.

Screen readers get the numbers as a hidden data table. Use it for part-to-whole over time with 2 to 4 series; use BarChart for one series and AreaChart for continuous trends.

- Name: `stacked-bar-chart` (component, Charts)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/stacked-bar-chart` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

- Related: bar-chart, area-chart, horizontal-bar-chart
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/stacked-bar-chart (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/stacked-bar-chart.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data? | `Stack[]` | `SAMPLE_DATA` | One stack per period; `values` line up with `seriesLabels`. Defaults to eight months of Lumen revenue. |
| seriesLabels? | `string[]` | `SAMPLE_SERIES` | Names of the stacked series, bottom to top. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| label? | `string` | `"Stacked bar chart"` | Chart title for screen readers. |

```tsx
<StackedBarChart
  label="Revenue mix by month"
  seriesLabels={["Subscriptions", "Usage"]}
  data={[{ label: "Jan", values: [48, 14] }, { label: "Feb", values: [52, 16] }]}
/>
```

### StatCard

Label, a big tabular value, and a delta chip that colours itself.

The delta tone comes from its leading sign: "+", "▲" read as up (success), "-", "−", "▼" as down (danger); set `invertDelta` where down is good. For a value with a trend line use StatSparkline; for several numbers in one row use StatsStrip.

- Name: `stat-card` (component, Dashboard)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/stat-card` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { StatCard } from "@/components/ui/stat-card"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/stat-card"`)
- Related: label, stat-sparkline, stats-strip, admin-stat-strip, card, case-study-card, credit-balance, kpi-row
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/stat-card (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/stat-card.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `React.ReactNode` |  | Metric name. |
| value | `React.ReactNode` |  | Pre-formatted value, e.g. "$48,200". |
| delta? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Change as a signed string, e.g. "+8.2%" or "−3". |
| icon? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Small icon before the label. |
| footnote? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Muted line under the value, e.g. "vs last month". |
| invertDelta? | `boolean` |  | For metrics where down is good (churn, latency). |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<StatCard label="MRR" value="$48,200" delta="+8.2%" footnote="vs last month" />
<StatCard label="p95 latency" value="182 ms" delta="-12%" invertDelta />
```

### StatSparkline

A KPI card with a big number, a coloured delta and a trend sparkline bleeding off the bottom edge.

Exported as `StatWithSparkline`. Use it for one headline metric with its trend; use StatCard without a chart, and SparklineSet for a grid of several. Set `invert` when down is good.

- Name: `stat-sparkline` (component, Dashboard)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/stat-sparkline` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { StatWithSparkline, StatSparkline } from "@/components/ui/stat-sparkline"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/stat-sparkline"`)
- Uses: area-chart
- Related: stat-card, sparkline-set, admin-stat-strip, chart-card, interactive-area-chart, kpi-row, latency-badge, line-chart
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/stat-sparkline (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/stat-sparkline.md)

```tsx
<StatWithSparkline label="MRR" value="$48,200" delta="+8.2%" points={[31, 34, 33, 38, 41, 48]} />
```

### StatusBadge

A status pill with a tinted fill, hairline edge and a leading dot, in six tones that share lightness.

Tones share lightness so a row of badges reads as one set.

Use it for the state of a record ("Paid", "Failed", "Draft"); the text carries the meaning, the colour reinforces it. For counts and categories use Badge; for a bare dot use StatusDot.

- Name: `status-badge` (component, Feedback)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/status-badge` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

- Related: badge, status-dot, due-date-chip, env-badge, health-indicator, permission-chip, presence-dot, version-badge
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/status-badge (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/status-badge.md)

Props (also accepts <span>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tone? | `"neutral" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "accent" \| "info"` | `"neutral"` |  |

```tsx
<StatusBadge tone="success">Paid</StatusBadge>

```

### StatusDot

An 8px coloured dot for status beside text: online, degraded, failed.

Decorative by default (the adjacent text says the status). When the dot stands alone, pass `label` so screen readers hear it. For a dot inside a pill use StatusBadge.

- Name: `status-dot` (component, Feedback)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tone? | `"neutral" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "accent"` | `"neutral"` |  |
| label? | `string` |  | Accessible name when the dot is shown without text; leave out when text sits beside it. |

### StepProgress

A row of labelled segments that fill as a multi-step flow advances, for onboarding and checkout.

Use above a multi-step form (signup, checkout, workspace setup) to show how far along people are. Keep `current` in your form state; earlier steps are marked done. It is read-only progress, not navigation. Use `Stepper` for the numbered variant ("1. Details"), `Progress` for a single percentage and `OnboardingChecklist` when tasks can be done in any order.

- Name: `step-progress` (component, Workflow)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/step-progress` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { StepProgress } from "@/components/ui/step-progress"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/step-progress"`)
- Related: stepper, progress, onboarding-checklist
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/step-progress (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/step-progress.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| steps? | `string[]` | `SAMPLE_STEPS` | Step labels in order. Defaults to Lumen's workspace setup. |
| current? | `number` | `2` | Zero-based index of the active step; earlier steps count as done. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<StepProgress steps={["Account", "Company", "Review"]} current={1} />
```

### Stepper

A numbered progress bar for multi-step forms: one segment per step, filled up to the current one, with "1. Details" style labels.

Read-only progress, not navigation. Use StepProgress for the unnumbered, smaller-label variant. Keep `current` in your form state and render the step's fields below.

- Name: `stepper` (component, Workflow)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/stepper` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Stepper } from "@/components/ui/stepper"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/stepper"`)
- Related: step-progress, account-setup-progress, build-pipeline, onboarding-wizard
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/stepper (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/stepper.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| steps? | `string[]` | `["Details", "Members", "Billing"]` | Step labels in order. |
| current? | `number` | `0` | Zero-based index of the active step; earlier steps count as done. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<Stepper steps={["Details", "Members", "Billing"]} current={step} />
```

### StickyBar

A bar pinned to the bottom of its scroll container for page-level actions: "3 selected · Delete", "Unsaved changes · Save".

Opaque surface with a hairline top edge, no blur. Put it last inside the scrolling element. Give it `role="region"` and an `aria-label` when it holds important actions. For one floating action use FloatingActionButton.

- Name: `sticky-bar` (component, Layout)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/sticky-bar` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { StickyBar } from "@/components/ui/sticky-bar"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/sticky-bar"`)
- Related: floating-action-button, sticky-cta-bar
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/sticky-bar (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/sticky-bar.md)

Props: <div>.

```tsx
<StickyBar aria-label="Unsaved changes">
  <span className="text-sm text-fg-muted">Unsaved changes</span>
  <Button size="sm">Save</Button>
</StickyBar>
```

### StickyColumn

A cell wrapper that stays pinned to the left or right edge while a wide table or board scrolls horizontally.

Use it in a wide div-based grid, board or timeline to keep the name column (or an actions column, with `side="right"`) in view while the rest scrolls. Opaque so scrolled content passes underneath, with a hairline on the inner edge. The scroll container needs `overflow-x-auto`. It renders a `div`, so inside `Table` put `sticky left-0 bg-surface` on the `TableCell` instead.

- Name: `sticky-column` (component, Tables)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/sticky-column` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { StickyColumn } from "@/components/ui/sticky-column"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/sticky-column"`)
- Related: table
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/sticky-column (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/sticky-column.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| side? | `"left" \| "right"` | `"left"` | Edge to pin to. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<div className="flex overflow-x-auto">
  <StickyColumn className="w-40 p-3">Customer</StickyColumn>
  <div className="min-w-[800px]">…</div>
</div>
```

### StopGenerating

An outline button with a stop square that cancels an in-flight AI response.

Show it only while a response streams, next to the StreamingMessage or in the composer; wire `onClick` to your AbortController. AiComposer swaps its send button for a stop button itself.

- Name: `stop-generating` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/stop-generating` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { StopGenerating } from "@/components/ui/stop-generating"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/stop-generating"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: button
- Related: streaming-message, ai-composer
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/stop-generating (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/stop-generating.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onClick? | `() => void` |  | Called when pressed; abort the request here. |
| label? | `string` | `"Stop generating"` | Button text. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
{isStreaming ? <StopGenerating onClick={() => controller.abort()} /> : null}
```

### StreakCalendar

A 7-column grid of day tiles, filled in accent on active days, for habit and contribution streaks.

Use on a profile or dashboard card for a month of habit or activity days. Days are numbered from 1 and fill rows of seven with no weekday labels. Screen readers hear a summary ("17 of 28 days active"). For a year-long contribution graph build rows of HeatmapCell.

- Name: `streak-calendar` (component, Dashboard)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/streak-calendar` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

- Related: heatmap-cell
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/streak-calendar (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/streak-calendar.md)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| active? | `number[]` | `[1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9, 10, 12, 15, 16]` | Active day numbers, 1-based. |
| days? | `number` | `28` | How many days to show, in rows of seven. |
| title? | `string` |  | Heading above the grid. Defaults to "{days}-day streak". |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<StreakCalendar active={[1, 2, 3, 5, 8]} days={28} />
```

### StreamingCursor

A blinking 2px accent caret to append after text that is still streaming in.

Decorative (aria-hidden). Render it after your own streamed text only while tokens arrive, and remove it when the stream ends. `MessageBubble` and `StreamingMessage` already render it when `streaming` is set. Use `TypingIndicator` before the first token arrives. The blink comes from the `caret-blink` keyframes in the kit stylesheet.

- Name: `streaming-cursor` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/streaming-cursor` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { StreamingCursor } from "@/components/ui/streaming-cursor"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/streaming-cursor"`)
- Related: message-bubble, streaming-message, typing-indicator
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/streaming-cursor (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/streaming-cursor.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<p>{text}{isStreaming ? <StreamingCursor /> : null}</p>
```

### StreamingMessage

An assistant message bubble that shows text as it streams, with a blinking caret while `streaming` is true.

Marked `aria-busy` while streaming so screen readers wait for the finished text instead of reading every token. Pair with StopGenerating; render finished markdown in your own message view.

- Name: `streaming-message` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/streaming-message` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { StreamingMessage } from "@/components/ui/streaming-message"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/streaming-message"`)
- Uses: streaming-cursor
- Related: stop-generating, streaming-cursor
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/streaming-message (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/streaming-message.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| content? | `React.ReactNode` | `"Three tests fail because the fixture...` | The text received so far. |
| streaming? | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the caret and marks the message busy. Set false when the stream ends. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<StreamingMessage content={partialText} streaming={!done} />
```

### SuggestionChips

### Switch

Hairline track with a raised thumb that leans on press, then springs across. While pressed the thumb stretches toward where it is about to go. The track only changes colour. 44px hit area via ::after. Pass `label` (+ `description`) for a settings row where the whole row is clickable.

Use Switch for a setting that applies immediately; use Checkbox for a choice submitted with a form, and ToggleGroup for picking one of several options. Controlled with `checked` + `onCheckedChange`, or uncontrolled with `defaultChecked`. Without `label`, give it an `aria-label`.

- Name: `switch` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/switch` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/switch"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react, lucide-react, motion
- Related: checkbox, toggle-group, density-toggle, feature-flag-toggle, label, slider, toggle
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/switch (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/switch.md)

Props (also accepts SwitchPrimitive.Root props):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| size? | `Size` | `"default"` | Track size: 16x28 or 20x36. |
| loading? | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a spinner in the thumb. Stays focusable but can't be toggled. |
| label? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Renders a settings row: label on the left, switch on the right, whole row clickable. |
| description? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Muted helper line under `label`; linked with aria-describedby. |

```tsx
<Switch aria-label="Dark mode" checked={dark} onCheckedChange={setDark} />
<Switch label="Email alerts" description="A digest every morning." defaultChecked />
```

### TableOfContents

A table of contents for long pages. It reads h2 and h3 headings from a container, or takes explicit items, then watches the nearest scroll area and moves an accent marker to the heading you are reading. Clicking an item scrolls there smoothly and hands focus to the heading. With no props it renders a scrollable Lumen docs article next to the list so the spy can be seen working.

- Name: `table-of-contents` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/table-of-contents` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { TableOfContents } from "@/components/ui/table-of-contents"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/table-of-contents"`)
- Dependencies: motion
- Related: toc, scroll-progress-rail
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/table-of-contents (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/table-of-contents.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| items? | `TocItem[]` |  | Headings to list. When absent, h2 and h3 elements are read from `selector` after mount. |
| selector? | `string` |  | CSS selector of the container to read headings from when `items` is absent. Headings without an id get one. |
| title? | `string` | `"On this page"` | Small label above the list. Empty hides it. |
| offset? | `number` | `24` | Pixels between the top of the scroll area and a heading for it to count as reached. |
| onActiveChange? | `(id: string) => void` |  | Called when the active heading changes. |
| sticky? | `boolean` | `true` | Keep the list in view while the page scrolls (position sticky). |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

### TablePagination

Previous/next pagination for a data table, with a "Page 2 of 9" readout.

Pages are 1-based and controlled: keep `page` in state and set it in `onPageChange`. A `page` outside 1..pageCount is shown and stepped from the nearest valid page. Page changes are announced to screen readers. For numbered page links on content pages use Pagination.

- Name: `table-pagination` (component, Tables)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/table-pagination` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { TablePagination } from "@/components/ui/table-pagination"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/table-pagination"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: button
- Related: pagination, data-table, sql-result-table, table-toolbar, table
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/table-pagination (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/table-pagination.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| page | `number` |  | Current page, 1-based. Clamped to 1..pageCount for display and stepping. |
| pageCount | `number` |  | Total pages; 0 is shown as 1. |
| onPageChange | `(page: number) => void` |  | Called with the requested page number. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<TablePagination page={page} pageCount={Math.ceil(total / 20)} onPageChange={setPage} />
```

### TableToolbar

The bar above a data table: a search field on the left, your filters and actions on the right.

Use it right above `Table` or `DataTable`. Search is controlled: pass `search` and update it in `onSearchChange`, then filter rows yourself. Put `ColumnVisibilityMenu`, `DensityToggle` or a New button in `children`. Pair with SortableHeader and TablePagination; for a bordered strip of filters with a Clear button use `FilterBar`.

- Name: `table-toolbar` (component, Tables)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/table-toolbar` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { TableToolbar } from "@/components/ui/table-toolbar"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/table-toolbar"`)
- Uses: search-input
- Related: table, data-table, column-visibility-menu, density-toggle, sortable-header, table-pagination, filter-bar, audit-filter-bar
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/table-toolbar (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/table-toolbar.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| children? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Filters and actions, right-aligned. |
| search? | `string` |  | Current search text. |
| onSearchChange? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called with the new search text on every keystroke. |
| searchPlaceholder? | `string` | `"Search…"` | Placeholder for the search field. |
| searchLabel? | `string` | `"Search table"` | Accessible name for the search field. |

```tsx
<TableToolbar search={q} onSearchChange={setQ} searchPlaceholder="Search invoices…">
  <Button size="sm">New invoice</Button>
</TableToolbar>
```

### Table

A semantic HTML table with hairline row dividers, a hover tint and horizontal scroll on narrow screens.

Compose Table > TableHeader/TableBody/TableFooter > TableRow > TableHead/TableCell, plus an optional TableCaption. Numbers line up (tabular-nums). Add SortableHeader inside a TableHead (set `aria-sort` on the TableHead), TableToolbar above and TablePagination below. Mark a selected row with `data-selected` or `aria-selected`. For SQL output use SqlResultTable.

- Name: `table` (component, Tables)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/table` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableHead, TableRow, TableCell, TableCaption } from "@/components/ui/table"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/table"`)
- Related: sortable-header, table-toolbar, table-pagination, sql-result-table, bulk-actions-bar, data-table, description-list, inline-cell-edit
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/table (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/table.md)

Props: <table>.

```tsx
<Table>
  <TableHeader><TableRow><TableHead>Invoice</TableHead><TableHead className="text-right">Amount</TableHead></TableRow></TableHeader>
  <TableBody><TableRow><TableCell>INV-2041</TableCell><TableCell className="text-right">$12,400.00</TableCell></TableRow></TableBody>
</Table>
```

### Tabs

A raised thumb or accent underline that glides to the active tab. Base UI for roving focus and panels. The active tab carries one indicator per list (a raised thumb, or a 2px accent underline for `line`) that glides between tabs on a spring, the way segmented-control does.

Keyboard per WAI-ARIA tabs: Arrow keys move between tabs, Home/End jump, Tab moves into the panel. Use Tabs to switch between panels of content in place; use SegmentedControl for a compact value picker without panels, and links (not tabs) when each view has its own URL. Every TabsTrigger `value` needs a TabsContent with the same `value`.

- Name: `tabs` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/tabs` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from "@/components/ui/tabs"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/tabs"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react, class-variance-authority, motion
- Related: segmented-control, accordion, chip-filter, saved-views, vertical-tabs, floating-nav, animated-tabs, dock
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/tabs (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/tabs.md)

Props: TabsPrimitive.Root props.

```tsx
<Tabs defaultValue="overview">
  <TabsList variant="line">
    <TabsTrigger value="overview">Overview</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="invoices" badge={12}>Invoices</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="overview">…</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="invoices">…</TabsContent>
</Tabs>
```

### TagsInput

A text field that turns typed entries into removable tag chips (Enter or comma adds, Backspace removes the last).

Use it for free-form labels, emails or keywords. Reach for `MultiSelect` when values must come from a fixed list, or `MentionInput` for @mentions inside text.

- Name: `tags-input` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/tags-input` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { TagsInput } from "@/components/ui/tags-input"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/tags-input"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Related: multi-select, mention-input, badge, context-pill, ip-allowlist
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/tags-input (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/tags-input.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `string[]` |  | Controlled tags. Pair with `onChange`. |
| defaultValue? | `string[]` | `[]` | Initial tags for the uncontrolled field. |
| onChange? | `(tags: string[]) => void` |  | Called with the full next list whenever a tag is added or removed. |
| placeholder? | `string` | `"Add tag"` | Shown only while there are no tags. |
| max? | `number` | `Infinity` | Most tags allowed; further entries are ignored. |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  |  |
| id? | `string` |  | Id for the inner text input, so a `<Label htmlFor>` can point at it. |
| name? | `string` |  | Submits each tag as its own hidden input under this name, so `FormData.getAll(name)` returns the list. No name by default. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |
| aria-label? | `string` |  |  |
| aria-invalid? | `boolean` |  |  |

```tsx
<TagsInput defaultValue={["finance", "q3"]} onChange={setTags} aria-label="Invoice labels" />
```

### TaxFields

Country and tax ID fields side by side, for checkout and billing-details forms.

Use it in checkout and billing settings when invoices need the buyer's country and VAT, GST or EIN number. The inputs are uncontrolled and named `country` and `taxId` (after `namePrefix`), so they submit with a plain `<form>` or a Server Action. Country is free text with autofill; swap in `Select` for a fixed list. Pair it with `BillingAddress` for the postal address.

- Name: `tax-fields` (component, Billing)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/tax-fields` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { TaxFields } from "@/components/ui/tax-fields"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/tax-fields"`)
- Uses: input
- Related: select, billing-address, country-select
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/tax-fields (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/tax-fields.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| defaultCountry? | `string` | `"United States"` | Initial country. |
| defaultTaxId? | `string` |  | Initial VAT, GST or EIN number. |
| namePrefix? | `string` | `""` | Prefix for the field names: `${namePrefix}country` and `${namePrefix}taxId`. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<form action={saveBilling}><TaxFields defaultCountry="Germany" /></form>
```

### Testimonial

A quote card with the customer's avatar, name and role, for landing pages and case studies.

Renders a semantic `<figure>` with `<blockquote>` and `<figcaption>`; without `src` the avatar shows the person's initials. Use it for one or a few static quotes in a grid. Use `PressQuote` for a publication pull quote, TestimonialCarousel to rotate longer quotes, and MarqueeQuotes or SocialProofWall for many at once. Only quote real customers.

- Name: `testimonial` (component, Landing pages)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/testimonial` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/testimonial (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/testimonial.md)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |

| name? | `string` | `"Maya Chen"` | Person quoted. Also drives the avatar initials. |

```tsx
<Testimonial quote="Month-end close went from six days to two." name="Maya Chen" role="Head of Finance, Northwind" />
```

### Text

Body copy: a 14px paragraph with the kit's line height, in default, muted, subtle or mono flavours.

Use it for the body copy in app UI: card descriptions, help text, empty-state messages and ids or amounts (`mono`). Renders a `<p>` and accepts every paragraph prop, so never nest block elements in it. Use `Heading` for titles and `Prose` for long-form rich text such as rendered markdown.

- Name: `text` (component, Layout)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/text` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Text } from "@/components/ui/text"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/text"`)
- Related: heading, prose, visually-hidden, hyper-text, sparkles-text
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/text (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/text.md)

Props (also accepts <p>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| muted? | `boolean` |  | Secondary text colour (`text-fg-muted`, at least 7:1). |
| subtle? | `boolean` |  | Tertiary text colour (`text-fg-subtle`, at least 4.5:1) for hints and meta. |
| mono? | `boolean` |  | Geist Mono at 13px, for ids, amounts and code-like values. |

```tsx
<Text muted>Invoices are emailed to billing@northwind.com.</Text>
```

### Textarea

A multi-line text field styled like `Input`: hairline border, accent focus halo, invalid and read-only states.

Accepts every `<textarea>` prop. Set `autoResize` to grow with the content. Use `PromptInput` for chat composers and `MarkdownEditor` for formatted text.

- Name: `textarea` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/textarea` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

Props (also accepts <textarea>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| autoResize? | `boolean` |  | Grow with the content (CSS `field-sizing: content`); `rows` sets the minimum height. Browsers without support keep a fixed height. |

```tsx
<Textarea id="note" placeholder="Add a note to the customer" rows={4} autoResize aria-invalid={!!error} />
```

### ThemePicker

A three-way Light / Dark / System radio group. Pass `applyToDocument` to have it toggle the `dark` class on `<html>`.

Works uncontrolled, or controlled with `value` + `onChange` when you persist the choice (cookie, localStorage). Arrow keys move and select, per the WAI-ARIA radio group pattern. Use `SegmentedControl` for any other small exclusive choice.

- Name: `theme-picker` (component, Settings)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/theme-picker` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ThemePicker } from "@/components/ui/theme-picker"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/theme-picker"`)
- Related: segmented-control, color-picker
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/theme-picker (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/theme-picker.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `ThemeMode` |  | Controlled mode. Pair with `onChange`. |
| defaultValue? | `ThemeMode` | `"system"` | Initial mode for the uncontrolled picker. |
| onChange? | `(value: ThemeMode) => void` |  | Called with the chosen mode. |
| applyToDocument? | `boolean` | `false` | Toggle the `dark` class on `<html>` when the mode changes. Off by default so demos and apps that apply the theme themselves are not affected. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<ThemePicker applyToDocument value={mode} onChange={(m) => { setMode(m); localStorage.theme = m }} />
```

### TimePicker

A native time field (`<input type="time">`) in the kit's input styling; the value is a 24-hour "HH:mm" string.

The browser supplies the locale-aware picker and keyboard support. Works controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled (`defaultValue`), and passes through `name`, `min`, `max`, `step` and `required`. Use `DatePicker` for dates.

- Name: `time-picker` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/time-picker` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { TimePicker } from "@/components/ui/time-picker"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/time-picker"`)
- Uses: input
- Related: date-picker, date-time-picker
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/time-picker (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/time-picker.md)

Props (also accepts <input>):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled value, "HH:mm" (or "HH:mm:ss" with a seconds `step`). Use "" for empty. |
| defaultValue? | `string` |  | Initial value for the uncontrolled field. |
| onChange? | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called with the new "HH:mm" string, or "" when cleared. |
| size? | `"sm" \| "default" \| "lg"` | `"default"` | Field height. |

```tsx
<TimePicker value={time} onChange={setTime} min="09:00" max="17:00" aria-label="Standup time" />
```

### Timeline

A vertical list of dated events on a hairline, for activity feeds and audit logs.

Renders an ordered list, newest first. Use `ActivityFeed` when each event needs an avatar, and `AuditTrail` for who-did-what logs.

```tsx
<Timeline items={[{ title: "Invoice INV-2041 paid", description: "$12,400 from Northwind", time: "09:41", dateTime: "2026-03-12T09:41" }]} />
```

### TimezoneSelect

A searchable IANA time zone picker that shows each zone's UTC offset and current local time.

Use it in scheduling, settings and onboarding forms. Search by city ("new york"), zone id ("america/"), offset ("+5:30", "-8") or abbreviation ("PST"). The user's own zone is pinned at the top as Detected and is the default value. All data comes from the browser's `Intl` API, so there is no time zone file to ship or update. Built on Base UI Combobox; for any other searchable list use Combobox, and for languages use LanguagePicker.

- Name: `timezone-select` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/timezone-select` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { TimezoneSelect } from "@/components/ui/timezone-select"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/timezone-select"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react, lucide-react
- Related: combobox, language-picker
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/timezone-select (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/timezone-select.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled IANA zone id, e.g. "America/New_York". |
| defaultValue? | `string` |  | Starting zone when uncontrolled. Defaults to the browser's zone (`Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone`). |
| onValueChange? | `(timeZone: string) => void` |  | Fires with the picked IANA zone id. |
| zones? | `string[]` |  | Zone ids to offer. Defaults to every zone the browser knows (`Intl.supportedValuesOf("timeZone")`). |
| showCurrentTime? | `boolean` | `true` | Show each zone's current local time in the list. |
| groupByRegion? | `boolean` | `true` | Group zones under their region (America, Europe...). When false, one list sorted by offset. |
| placeholder? | `string` | `"Select a time zone"` | Trigger text while nothing is selected. |
| disabled? | `boolean` |  | Disables the trigger. |
| id? | `string` |  | Id for the trigger, so a `<label htmlFor>` or FormField can name it. |
| name? | `string` |  | Submits the selected zone id under this name inside a `<form>`. |
| required? | `boolean` |  | Requires a selection before the form submits. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name when there is no visible label. Defaults to "Time zone" when no `id` is passed. |
| className? | `string` |  | Classes for the trigger button (width defaults to w-72). |

```tsx
const [tz, setTz] = React.useState("Europe/Berlin")
<FormField id="tz" label="Time zone">
  <TimezoneSelect id="tz" value={tz} onValueChange={setTz} />
</FormField>
```

- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/toast (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/toast.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| description? | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| tone? | `Tone` | `"neutral"` | Sets the glyph and the live role: "danger" is announced assertively (role="alert"), the rest politely. |
| action? | `{ label: string; onClick: () => void }` |  | One inline action, e.g. Undo or View. |
| onDismiss? | `() => void` |  | Shows a dismiss button (on hover or focus) when provided. |
| role? | `React.AriaRole` |  | Override the live role. The Toaster passes "none" because its list is already the live region. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<Toast title="Saved" description="Changes are live." tone="success" />
```

### Toc

An indented table of contents for a docs page, with the current section highlighted.

Links jump to `#id` anchors. Pass `activeId` from your own scroll-spy (IntersectionObserver) to follow the reader; without it the last clicked entry is marked. Use `TableOfContents` for built-in scroll-spy and a sticky rail.

- Name: `toc` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/toc` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Toc } from "@/components/ui/toc"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/toc"`)
- Related: table-of-contents, docs-page, docs-marketing
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/toc (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/toc.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| items? | `TocItem[]` | `SAMPLE_ITEMS` | Headings in page order. Defaults to the Lumen API guide. |
| activeId? | `string` |  | The id of the section in view. Without it, clicks track the active entry. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<Toc items={[{ id: "install", title: "Install" }, { id: "usage", title: "Usage", level: 2 }]} activeId={visibleId} />
```

### ToggleGroup

A row of `Toggle` buttons that share pressed state, built on Base UI: single-select by default, `multiple` for formatting bars.

`value` is always an array of the pressed toggles' `value`s. Arrow keys move focus between toggles. Use `SegmentedControl` for a view switch with a sliding thumb, and `RadioGroup` inside forms.

- Name: `toggle-group` (component, Buttons)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/toggle-group` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ToggleGroup } from "@/components/ui/toggle-group"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/toggle-group"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react
- Related: toggle, segmented-control, radio-group, button-group, suggestion-chips, switch
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/toggle-group (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/toggle-group.md)

Props: ToggleGroupPrimitive props.

```tsx
<ToggleGroup defaultValue={["left"]} aria-label="Text alignment">
  <Toggle value="left" aria-label="Align left"><AlignLeftIcon /></Toggle>
  <Toggle value="center" aria-label="Align center"><AlignCenterIcon /></Toggle>
</ToggleGroup>
```

### Toggle

A two-state button (pressed or not) for toolbar actions such as bold or "show archived", built on Base UI.

Controlled with `pressed` + `onPressedChange`, or uncontrolled with `defaultPressed`. Icon-only toggles need an `aria-label`. Use `Switch` for settings that take effect immediately, and `ToggleGroup` for a set of related toggles.

- Name: `toggle` (component, Buttons)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/toggle` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Toggle } from "@/components/ui/toggle"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/toggle"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react, class-variance-authority
- Related: switch, toggle-group, wishlist-button
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/toggle (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/toggle.md)

Props (also accepts TogglePrimitive props):

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| size? | `"sm" \| "default" \| "lg"` | `"default"` |  |

```tsx
<Toggle aria-label="Bold" pressed={bold} onPressedChange={setBold}><BoldIcon /></Toggle>
```

### TokenUsageMeter

A card showing LLM tokens used against a budget: label, "used / limit" in mono, a progress bar and a note.

Use it on AI usage and billing pages. Use `UsageMeter` for a bare labelled bar, `UsageBreakdown` for several resources, and `CreditBalance` for prepaid credits.

- Name: `token-usage-meter` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/token-usage-meter` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { TokenUsageMeter } from "@/components/ui/token-usage-meter"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/token-usage-meter"`)
- Uses: progress
- Related: usage-meter, usage-breakdown, credit-balance
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/token-usage-meter (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/token-usage-meter.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| used? | `number` | `128_400` | Tokens used so far. |
| limit? | `number` | `200_000` | Token budget. The bar caps at 100%. |
| label? | `React.ReactNode` | `"Token usage"` | Heading; also labels the progress bar for screen readers. |
| note? | `React.ReactNode` | `"of monthly budget · resets on the 1st"` | Line under the bar, after the percentage. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<TokenUsageMeter used={128400} limit={200000} note="Resets on the 1st" />
```

### ToolCallCard

One tool invocation inside an agent turn: tool name, argument preview, status pill, duration and a collapsible output.

Children are the output (plain text or `<pre>`); without children the header is static. Use `ToolCallCollapsed` for a minimal one-line disclosure, `ToolResultPanel` to show JSON output, and `AgentTrace` for a whole run.

- Name: `tool-call-card` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/tool-call-card` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ToolCallCard } from "@/components/ui/tool-call-card"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/tool-call-card"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Related: tool-call-collapsed, tool-result-panel, agent-trace, thinking-block
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/tool-call-card (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/tool-call-card.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name | `string` |  | Tool or function name, shown in mono. |
| status? | `"running" \| "done" \| "error"` | `"done"` | "running" shows a spinner and hides the duration. |
| args? | `string` |  | Short argument preview, e.g. `path="DESIGN.md"`. |
| duration? | `string` |  | Wall time, e.g. "0.4s". Hidden while running. |
| children? | `React.ReactNode` |  | The output. Makes the card collapsible. |
| open? | `boolean` |  | Controlled open state. Pair with `onOpenChange`. |
| defaultOpen? | `boolean` | `true` | Initial open state for the uncontrolled card. |
| onOpenChange? | `(open: boolean) => void` |  |  |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<ToolCallCard name="get_invoice" args='id="INV-2041"' status="done" duration="0.3s"><pre>{JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)}</pre></ToolCallCard>
```

### ToolCallCollapsed

A quiet one-line disclosure for a tool call: chevron and mono tool name, with the details hidden until opened.

Use it when tool calls should stay out of the way in a chat transcript. It starts closed and is uncontrolled (`defaultOpen` only); without children the row is static. Use `ToolCallCard` when status, duration or a controlled open state matter, and `ThinkingBlock` for model reasoning.

- Name: `tool-call-collapsed` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/tool-call-collapsed` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { ToolCallCollapsed } from "@/components/ui/tool-call-collapsed"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/tool-call-collapsed"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Related: tool-call-card, thinking-block
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/tool-call-collapsed (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/tool-call-collapsed.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name | `string` |  | Tool or function name, shown in mono. |
| children? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Details revealed when opened. |
| defaultOpen? | `boolean` | `false` | Start open. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<ToolCallCollapsed name="search_customers">Found 3 customers matching "northwind".</ToolCallCollapsed>
```

### ToolResultPanel

A panel showing an AI tool call's name, a status badge and its output as highlighted JSON.

Pass `output` as a string or any JSON-serialisable value; objects are pretty-printed. Use `ToolCallCard` for a collapsible call inside a chat turn, and `JsonViewer` for large, foldable payloads.

- Name: `tool-result-panel` (component, AI chat)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/tool-result-panel` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name? | `string` | `"lookup_invoice"` | The tool that ran. |
| status? | `"success" \| "error" \| "running"` | `"success"` |  |
| output? | `unknown` | `SAMPLE_OUTPUT` | Raw output: a string is shown as-is, anything else is JSON.stringified. Defaults to a Lumen invoice lookup. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<ToolResultPanel name="lookup_invoice" status="success" output={{ invoice: "INV-2041", status: "paid" }} />
```

### Tooltip

An ink label with an arrow that appears on hover and keyboard focus, built on Base UI.

Compose `Tooltip` > `TooltipTrigger` + `TooltipContent`; use `render` to make your own button the trigger. Wrap a toolbar in `TooltipProvider` so neighbouring tooltips open instantly. Tooltips are hints only: never put interactive content or the only copy of important text in one. Use `HoverCard` or `Popover` for rich or clickable content. `<Tooltip />` with no children renders a demo.

- Name: `tooltip` (component, Overlays)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/tooltip` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider } from "@/components/ui/tooltip"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/tooltip"`)
- Dependencies: @base-ui/react
- Uses: button
- Related: hover-card, popover, chart-tooltip-card, icon-button, permission-denied, animated-tooltip
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/tooltip (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/tooltip.md)

Props: TooltipPrimitive.Root props.

```tsx
<Tooltip>
  <TooltipTrigger render={<IconButton aria-label="Archive invoice" />}><ArchiveIcon /></TooltipTrigger>
  <TooltipContent side="bottom">Archive <Kbd>E</Kbd></TooltipContent>
</Tooltip>
```

### Topbar

A 56px app header bar with a title (or custom left content) and a right-hand slot for actions.

Renders a `<header>`. Use it at the top of an `AppShell` content area. Use `PageHeader` for a page title with description and actions inside the content, and `NavMarketing` for a marketing site nav.

- Name: `topbar` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/topbar` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { Topbar } from "@/components/ui/topbar"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/topbar"`)
- Related: app-shell, page-header, nav-marketing, floating-nav
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/topbar (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/topbar.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Page or section name, used when `left` is not given. |
| left? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Replaces the title, e.g. breadcrumbs or an org switcher. |
| right? | `React.ReactNode` |  | Actions on the right: search, buttons, avatar menu. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<Topbar title="Invoices" right={<><SearchInput /><Button size="sm">New invoice</Button></>} />
```

### TraceWaterfall

A distributed-trace waterfall: one row per span with its name (indented by depth), a bar placed on a shared time axis, and its duration.

Times are in milliseconds from the start of the trace. Use it for request traces and agent step timing. Use `GanttChart` for calendar schedules and `AgentTrace` for a step-by-step agent run.

- Name: `trace-waterfall` (component, Dev tools)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/trace-waterfall` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { TraceWaterfall } from "@/components/ui/trace-waterfall"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/trace-waterfall"`)
- Related: gantt-chart, agent-trace, gantt-row, latency-badge, engineering-console
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/trace-waterfall (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/trace-waterfall.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| spans? | `TraceSpan[]` | `SAMPLE_SPANS` | Spans in display order. Defaults to a four-span API request. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<TraceWaterfall spans={[{ name: "POST /invoices", start: 0, duration: 120 }, { name: "db.insert", start: 18, duration: 40, depth: 1 }]} />
```

### TreeView

A keyboard-navigable tree of nested nodes, all open by default, for file browsers, folders and org charts.

Follows the WAI-ARIA tree pattern: one tab stop, Up/Down move, Right opens or enters a branch, Left closes or goes to the parent, Home/End jump, Enter/Space selects (and toggles a branch). Use `FileTree` for files with icons and status, and `NestedNav` for sidebar navigation links.

- Name: `tree-view` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/tree-view` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { TreeView } from "@/components/ui/tree-view"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/tree-view"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Related: file-tree, nested-nav, org-chart
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/tree-view (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/tree-view.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| nodes? | `TreeNode[]` | `SAMPLE_NODES` | Root nodes. Defaults to the Lumen web app's source tree. |
| defaultExpanded? | `string[]` |  | Branch ids open at first render. Omit to open every branch. |
| selectedId? | `string` |  | Controlled selected node id. |
| onSelect? | `(node: TreeNode) => void` |  | Called when a node is clicked or chosen with Enter or Space. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name for the tree. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<TreeView nodes={[{ id: "src", label: "src", children: [{ id: "app", label: "app.tsx" }] }]} onSelect={(node) => open(node.id)} aria-label="Project files" />
```

### TreemapChart

A squarified treemap. Groups get a header strip and their cells share one hue at falling strengths, labels appear only where they fit, and hovering or focusing a cell lifts it and shows its value and share in a tooltip. Cells are keyboard focusable with arrow keys; a hidden table carries the data.

- Name: `treemap-chart` (component, Charts)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/treemap-chart` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { TreemapChart } from "@/components/ui/treemap-chart"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/treemap-chart"`)
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/treemap-chart (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/treemap-chart.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data? | `TreemapNode[]` | `SAMPLE` | Top level items. A node with `children` renders as a group with a header strip. |
| title? | `string` | `"Revenue by product line"` | Heading above the chart and the accessible name. |
| caption? | `string` | `"October, by plan"` | Shown next to the total. |
| height? | `number` | `320` | Chart height in px. The width follows the container. |
| format? | `(value: number) => string` | `defaultFormat` | Formats values in the tooltip, labels and table. Defaults to compact USD ("$48.2K"). |
| valueLabel? | `string` | `"Revenue"` | Name of the measure in the tooltip, e.g. "Revenue", "Storage", "Users". |
| minLabelSize? | `number` | `44` | Hide labels in cells narrower or shorter than this, in px. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

### TwoFactorSetup

The enable-2FA step: a QR code slot, the manual setup key, a 6-digit code field and a verify button.

Render your QR (for example with `QrCode`) in `qr` and the base32 secret in `secret`. `onVerify` receives the code once all six digits are in. Use `TwoFactorVerify` for the sign-in challenge after 2FA is on.

- Name: `two-factor-setup` (component, Auth)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/two-factor-setup` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { TwoFactorSetup } from "@/components/ui/two-factor-setup"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/two-factor-setup"`)
- Uses: auth-card, button, otp-input
- Related: qr-code, two-factor-verify
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/two-factor-setup (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/two-factor-setup.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| qr? | `React.ReactNode` |  | The QR code for the authenticator app. Shows a placeholder when omitted. |
| secret? | `string` |  | Setup key for manual entry, shown in mono under the QR. |
| onVerify? | `(code: string) => void` |  | Called with the 6-digit code when the form is submitted. |
| invalid? | `boolean` |  | Shows the field as invalid, e.g. after a wrong code. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<TwoFactorSetup qr={<QrCode value={otpauthUrl} />} secret="JBSW Y3DP EHPK 3PXP" onVerify={(code) => enable2fa(code)} />
```

### TwoFactorVerify

The sign-in 2FA challenge: a card with a 6-digit code field that submits itself when the last digit is typed.

`onVerify` receives the code. Set `invalid` after a wrong code to shake the field red. Use `TwoFactorSetup` to enrol a device, and `OtpInput` alone for other one-time codes.

- Name: `two-factor-verify` (component, Auth)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/two-factor-verify` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { TwoFactorVerify } from "@/components/ui/two-factor-verify"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/two-factor-verify"`)
- Uses: auth-card, button, otp-input
- Related: two-factor-setup, otp-input
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/two-factor-verify (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/two-factor-verify.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onVerify? | `(code: string) => void` |  | Called with the 6-digit code on completion or submit, once per code: editing the code allows the next call. |
| invalid? | `boolean` |  | Shows the field as invalid, e.g. after a wrong code. |
| description? | `React.ReactNode` | `"Enter the 6-digit code from your aut...` | Line under the title. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<TwoFactorVerify onVerify={async (code) => setInvalid(!(await verify(code)))} invalid={invalid} />
```

### UsageBreakdown

A stack of labelled usage bars, each showing used against limit, for plan and billing pages. Bars turn amber at 90% and red at the limit.

Use it to show several metered resources at once. Use `UsageMeter` for a single bar, `QuotaBar` for one quota with a legend, and `ResourceQuotaGrid` for many quotas as cards.

### UsageMeter

One labelled usage bar with "used/limit" on the right, for seats, storage or API calls.

The bar caps at 100%. Use `UsageBreakdown` for several resources, `TokenUsageMeter` for an LLM token budget card, and `Meter` for a value in a known range that is not usage.

- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/usage-meter` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { UsageMeter } from "@/components/ui/usage-meter"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/usage-meter"`)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | `string` |  | Resource name; also labels the bar for screen readers. |
| used | `number` |  |  |
| limit | `number` |  |  |


### UserChip

A pill with an avatar and a name, optionally removable, for assignee pickers and share lists.

Passing `onRemove` adds an "x" button labelled "Remove {name}". Use `AttachmentChip` for files, `ContextChip` for AI context items, and `AvatarGroup` for a compact stack of people.

- Name: `user-chip` (component, Forms)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/user-chip` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`

- Uses: avatar

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name? | `string` | `"Maya Chen"` | Display name. Also drives the initials fallback and the remove label. |
| src? | `string` |  | Avatar image; initials are used when absent. |
| onRemove? | `() => void` |  | Shows a remove button when provided. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<UserChip name="Priya Raman" src="/avatars/priya.jpg" onRemove={() => unassign("priya")} />
```

### VersionBadge

A mono version tag ("v2.4.1") with an optional release-channel pill: stable, beta or canary.

Use it in changelogs, release notes, footers and package or API headers to show which release something belongs to. Pass the version with or without a leading "v". Use `EnvBadge` for deploy environments, `StatusBadge` for a state, and `Badge` for anything else.

- Name: `version-badge` (component, Dev tools)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/version-badge` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { VersionBadge } from "@/components/ui/version-badge"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/version-badge"`)
- Related: env-badge, status-badge, badge
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/version-badge (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/version-badge.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| version | `string` |  | Semver string, e.g. "2.4.1" or "v2.4.1". |
| channel? | `"stable" \| "beta" \| "canary"` |  | Release channel pill. Omit to hide. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<VersionBadge version="2.4.1" channel="beta" />
```

### VerticalTabs

A left-hand tab list with the active panel beside it, for settings pages; stacks above the panel on small screens.

Follows the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern: one tab stop, Up/Down (and Left/Right) move and select, Home/End jump. Use `Tabs` for horizontal tabs, `SettingsLayout` for a full settings page with routes, and `SegmentedControl` for switching a view in place.

- Name: `vertical-tabs` (component, Navigation)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/vertical-tabs` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { VerticalTabs } from "@/components/ui/vertical-tabs"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/vertical-tabs"`)
- Related: tabs, settings-layout, segmented-control
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/vertical-tabs (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/vertical-tabs.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tabs? | `VerticalTab[]` | `SAMPLE_TABS` | Tabs in order. Defaults to Lumen's workspace settings. |
| value? | `string` |  | Controlled selected tab id. Pair with `onChange`. |
| defaultValue? | `string` |  | Initially selected tab id for the uncontrolled tabs. Defaults to the first tab. |
| onChange? | `(id: string) => void` |  | Called with the id of the newly selected tab. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name for the tab list. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<VerticalTabs defaultValue="billing" tabs={[{ id: "general", label: "General", content: <GeneralForm /> }, { id: "billing", label: "Billing", content: <BillingForm /> }]} />
```

### VideoPlayerChrome

Presentational video-player chrome: a 16:9 stage with a play/pause button and a bottom bar with progress and title.

It draws the controls only; wire `playing`, `onToggle` and `progress` to your `<video>` element, or put the video in `children`. Uncontrolled, the button just toggles its own state. Use `AudioPlayer` for audio.

- Name: `video-player-chrome` (component, Media)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/video-player-chrome` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { VideoPlayerChrome } from "@/components/ui/video-player-chrome"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/video-player-chrome"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Uses: icon-button
- Related: audio-player
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/video-player-chrome (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/video-player-chrome.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title? | `string` |  | Shown in the bottom bar. |
| playing? | `boolean` |  | Controlled playing state. Pair with `onToggle`. |
| defaultPlaying? | `boolean` | `false` | Initial state for the uncontrolled player. |
| onToggle? | `(playing: boolean) => void` |  | Called with the next playing state when the button is pressed. |
| progress? | `number` | `0` | Playback position, 0–100. `NaN` (before metadata loads) shows as 0. |
| children? | `React.ReactNode` |  | The media, e.g. a `<video>`; it fills the stage behind the button. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<VideoPlayerChrome title="Q3 close walkthrough" playing={playing} onToggle={() => (playing ? ref.current.pause() : ref.current.play())} progress={pct}><video ref={ref} src="/q3.mp4" /></VideoPlayerChrome>
```

### VirtualList

A windowed list that renders only the rows in view, with fixed or measured row heights, overscan, keyboard row navigation and scroll to index.

Use it for thousands of rows (logs, invoices, search results). Generic over the row type: pass `items`, `renderRow` and `getKey`. Set `rowHeight="auto"` for rows of varying height. A ref exposes `scrollToIndex` and `setActiveIndex`. Use `VirtualizedList` for a bare fixed-height list without header or keyboard model, `DataTable` for sortable columns under ~1,000 rows, and `InfiniteScroll` to load pages as the reader scrolls.

- Name: `virtual-list` (component, Tables)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/virtual-list` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { VirtualList } from "@/components/ui/virtual-list"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/virtual-list"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Related: virtualized-list, data-table, infinite-scroll
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/virtual-list (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/virtual-list.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| items? | `T[]` | `SAMPLE_INVOICES as unknown as T[]` | Rows to render. Defaults to 10,000 Lumen invoices. |
| rowHeight? | `number \| "auto"` | `40` | Row height in px, or "auto" to measure every row (estimatedRowHeight is used until a row has been measured). |
| estimatedRowHeight? | `number` | `40` | Height assumed for rows that have not been measured yet, in "auto" mode. |
| overscan? | `number` | `6` | Extra rows rendered above and below the viewport so fast scrolling never shows a gap. |
| height? | `number` | `360` | Viewport height in px. |
| renderRow? | `(item: T, index: number, state: { active: boolean }) => React.ReactNode` | `defaultRender` | Renders one row. Defaults to an invoice row. |
| getKey? | `(item: T, index: number) => React.Key` | `defaultKey` | Stable key per row. Defaults to item.id, then the index. |
| describeRow? | `(item: T, index: number) => string` | `defaultDescribe` | Plain text for the screen reader announcement of the active row. |
| activeIndex? | `number` |  | Controlled active row. |
| defaultActiveIndex? | `number` | `0` |  |
| onActiveChange? | `(index: number) => void` |  |  |
| onSelect? | `(item: T, index: number) => void` |  | Called on click, Enter or Space on a row. |
| title? | `string` | `"Invoices"` | Header title. Pass an empty string to hide the header. |
| showJump? | `boolean` | `true` | Show the "Jump to row" field in the header. |
| showFooter? | `boolean` | `true` | Show the "Rows a to b of n" footer. |
| ref? | `React.Ref<VirtualListHandle>` |  | Imperative handle with scrollToIndex and setActiveIndex. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  |  |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<VirtualList items={logs} rowHeight={32} getKey={(l) => l.id} renderRow={(l, i, { active }) => <LogRow log={l} active={active} />} onSelect={(l) => open(l.id)} title="Logs" />
```

### VirtualizedList

A bare fixed-row-height windowed list that renders only the rows in view; ten thousand rows cost about twenty DOM nodes.

Use it to show thousands of same-height rows already in memory, such as a log or ledger, without rendering them all. Pass `count`, `itemHeight` and `renderItem(index)`; every row must be exactly `itemHeight` px. Use `VirtualList` for a header, measured row heights, keyboard row navigation and scroll-to-index, `InfiniteScroll` to fetch pages as people scroll, and `DataTable` for sortable columns.

- Name: `virtualized-list` (component, Tables)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/virtualized-list` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { VirtualizedList } from "@/components/ui/virtualized-list"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/virtualized-list"`)
- Related: virtual-list, infinite-scroll, data-table
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/virtualized-list (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/virtualized-list.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| count? | `number` | `10000` | Total number of rows. |
| itemHeight? | `number` | `40` | Height of every row, in px. Rows must not be taller. |
| height? | `number` | `320` | Viewport height, in px. |
| renderItem? | `(index: number) => React.ReactNode` | `sampleRow` | Renders the row at `index`. Defaults to a sample invoice row. |
| aria-label? | `string` |  | Accessible name for the scrollable list. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<VirtualizedList count={rows.length} itemHeight={40} height={320} renderItem={(i) => <Row row={rows[i]} />} aria-label="Transactions" />
```

### VisuallyHidden

Text that screen readers announce but sighted users never see (Tailwind `sr-only`), e.g. a label for an icon-only control.

Accepts every `<span>` prop, so it can carry an `id` for `aria-describedby`. Prefer `aria-label` on the control when the text is short. Use `SkipLink` for a skip-to-content link that appears on focus.

- Name: `visually-hidden` (component, Layout)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/visually-hidden` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { VisuallyHidden } from "@/components/ui/visually-hidden"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/visually-hidden"`)
- Related: text, skip-link
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/visually-hidden (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/visually-hidden.md)

Props: <span>.

```tsx
<button><TrashIcon aria-hidden /><VisuallyHidden>Delete invoice INV-2041</VisuallyHidden></button>
```

### VoteControl

A vertical up/down vote control with the score between, for feature boards and Q&A. Pressing the active arrow again clears the vote.

The arrows are toggle buttons (`aria-pressed`). `score` is displayed as given, so include the viewer's vote in it. Use `FeedbackThumbs` for rating an AI answer and `ReactionBar` for emoji reactions.

- Name: `vote-control` (component, Feedback)
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @minidev/vote-control` or `npm i minidev-ui-kit`
- Import: `import { VoteControl } from "@/components/ui/vote-control"` (npm: `"minidev-ui-kit/ui/vote-control"`)
- Dependencies: lucide-react
- Related: feedback-thumbs, reaction-bar
- Docs: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/vote-control (Markdown: https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/vote-control.md)

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| score? | `number` | `0` | Net score to display, including the viewer's vote. |
| value? | `Vote` |  | Controlled vote. Pair with `onChange`. |
| defaultValue? | `Vote` | `null` | Initial vote for the uncontrolled control. |
| onChange? | `(value: Vote) => void` |  | Called with the new vote; null when cleared. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<VoteControl score={score} value={vote} onChange={(v) => { setScore(score - delta(vote) + delta(v)); setVote(v) }} />
```

### WaffleChart

A 10-column grid of squares with the first `value` filled, for "42 of 100" style part-to-whole stats.

Keep `total` at 100 or less so each square stays countable. Use `ProgressCircle` or `GoalRing` for a single percentage and `PieChart` for several parts.

Props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value? | `number` | `42` | Filled squares. Clamped to 0…total. |
| total? | `number` | `100` | Total squares, ten per row. |
| label? | `string` | `"Adoption"` | Name of the stat; also the accessible name. |
| className? | `string` |  |  |

```tsx
<WaffleChart label="Invoices paid on time" value={42} total={100} />
```

### WishlistButton

A heart toggle button for saving a product to a wishlist; the heart fills when active.

It is a toggle (`aria-pressed`) with a fixed label, so screen readers hear "Save to wishlist, pressed". Works controlled (`active` + `onToggle`) or uncontrolled (`defaultActive`). Use `Toggle` for generic toolbar toggles.

### ApiDocsPage

An API reference page: section nav, base URL with a copy button, the endpoint list, and a curl sample.

Use for REST reference docs. Each endpoint shows its method, path and one-line purpose. For prose guides with a table of contents use DocsPage; for an in-app API key screen use ApiKeyList. The nav collapses above the content on small screens.

### BentoLive

A product feature grid where every tile runs a small live piece of the product (a ticking metric, a typed answer, alerts) instead of a screenshot.

Use as the main "features" section of a landing page, with 4–6 tiles on a 6-column grid. Live tiles only tick while on screen and sit still under reduced motion. Tiles rise in once as the grid enters view and lift on hover. For a text-only grid use FeatureGrid; for a premium animated bento use FeatureBentoMotion.

- Name: `bento-live` (block, Landing pages)

### ChatPage

A full-height AI chat screen: titled header, a scrolling transcript that follows new messages, and a composer.

Use for an assistant or support chat that owns the page. Sent messages append to the thread; wire `onSend` to your model and push its reply into your own state when you copy the block. For just the transcript use ChatThread; for a composer with attachments and model picker use AiComposer. Give the block a height.

- Name: `chat-page` (block, AI chat)

### CommerceCheckout

A two-column checkout: line items and billing address on the left, a live order summary and Pay on the right.
